5.186.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
caturthe divase prāpte tato yajñasamudbhave ..
ṛtvigbhiryājñikaṃ karma prārabdhaṃ tadanaṃtaram .. 1 ..
5.186.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
चतुर्थे दिवसे प्राप्ते ततो यज्ञसमुद्भवे ..
ऋत्विग्भिर्याज्ञिकं कर्म प्रारब्धं तदनंतरम् .. 1 ..
5.186.m: Sūta said: / “When the fourth day arrived in the course of that sacrifice, / the sacrificial rite was thereupon commenced by the officiating priests, // 1

5.186.s:
somapānādikaṃ sarvaṃ paśorhiṃsādikaṃ tathā ..
paśorgudaṃ samādāya prasthātā ca vyadhārayat .. 2 ..
5.186.d:
सोमपानादिकं सर्वं पशोर्हिंसादिकं तथा ..
पशोर्गुदं समादाय प्रस्थाता च व्यधारयत् .. 2 ..
5.186.m: including the drinking of soma and the immolation of the animal. / Taking the rectum of the sacrificial animal, the assistant priest held it up // 2

5.186.s:
ekāṃte sadaso madhye homārthaṃ dvijasattamāḥ ..
tasminvyākulatāṃ yāte brāhmaṇaḥ kaścidāgataḥ .. 3 ..
5.186.d:
एकांते सदसो मध्ये होमार्थं द्विजसत्तमाः ..
तस्मिन्व्याकुलतां याते ब्राह्मणः कश्चिदागतः .. 3 ..
5.186.m: in an isolated spot in the midst of the assembly hall for the sake of the oblation, O best of twice-borns. / While that state of intense bustle was taking place, a certain brahmin arrived.” // 3

5.186.s:
yuvā tatra praviṣṭastu māṃsa bhakṣaṇalālasaḥ ..
tato gudaṃ paśordṛṣṭvā bhakṣayāmāsa cotsukaṃ .. 4 ..
5.186.d:
युवा तत्र प्रविष्टस्तु मांस भक्षणलालसः ..
ततो गुदं पशोर्दृष्ट्वा भक्षयामास चोत्सुकं .. 4 ..
5.186.m: A young man entered there, eager to eat meat. / Then, seeing the entrails of the sacrificial beast, he eagerly ate them.

5.186.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāptaḥ prasthātā tasya saṃnidhau ..
bhakṣamāṇaṃ samālokya taṃ śaśāpa tataḥ param .. 5 ..
5.186.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्तः प्रस्थाता तस्य संनिधौ ..
भक्षमाणं समालोक्य तं शशाप ततः परम् .. 5 ..
5.186.m: At that moment, the pratiprasthātṛ priest arrived beside him. / Seeing him eating, he then cursed him:

5.186.s:
dhigdhikpāpasamācāra homārthaṃ yadgudaṃ dhṛtam ..
tattvayā dūṣitaṃ laulyādyajñavighnakaraṃ kṛtam .. 6 ..
5.186.d:
धिग्धिक्पापसमाचार होमार्थं यद्गुदं धृतम् ..
तत्त्वया दूषितं लौल्याद्यज्ञविघ्नकरं कृतम् .. 6 ..
5.186.m: “Fie, fie, evildoer! The entrails that were kept for the sake of the oblation / have been defiled by you out of greed, creating an obstacle to the sacrifice!

5.186.s:
ucchiṣṭena mayā homaḥ kartavyo naiva sāṃpratam ..
rākṣasānāmidaṃ karma yattvayā samanuṣṭhitam .. 7 ..
5.186.d:
उच्छिष्टेन मया होमः कर्तव्यो नैव सांप्रतम् ..
राक्षसानामिदं कर्म यत्त्वया समनुष्ठितम् .. 7 ..
5.186.m: I certainly cannot offer an oblation now with what is leftover from eating! / This deed that you have performed is the conduct of rākṣasas.

5.186.s: tasmāttvaṃ mama vākyena rākṣaso bhava mā ciram .. 8 ..
5.186.d: तस्मात्त्वं मम वाक्येन राक्षसो भव मा चिरम् .. 8 ..
5.186.m: Therefore, by my word, become a rākṣasa without delay!”

5.186.s:
etasminneva kāle tu hyūrdhvakeśo'bhavaddhi saḥ ..
raktākṣaḥ śaṃkukarṇaśca kṛṣṇadanto'tibhairavaḥ .. 9 ..
5.186.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु ह्यूर्ध्वकेशोऽभवद्धि सः ..
रक्ताक्षः शंकुकर्णश्च कृष्णदन्तोऽतिभैरवः .. 9 ..
5.186.m: At that very moment, his hair indeed stood erect; / he became red-eyed, with peg-shaped ears, black-toothed, and exceedingly terrifying,

5.186.s:
lamboṣṭho vikarālāsyo māṃsamedovivarjitaḥ ..
tvagasthisnāyuśeṣaśca. cāmuṇḍākṛtireva ca .. 6.187.10 ..
5.186.d:
लम्बोष्ठो विकरालास्यो मांसमेदोविवर्जितः ..
त्वगस्थिस्नायुशेषश्च. चामुण्डाकृतिरेव च .. 6.187.10 ..
5.186.m: with a hanging lower lip, a frightfully gaping mouth, devoid of flesh and fat, / reduced to mere skin, bone, and sinew, possessing the very form of Cāmuṇḍā.

5.186.s:
sa ca viśvāvasurnāma pulastyasya suto muniḥ ..
maṃtrapūtasya māṃsasya bhakṣaṇārthaṃ samāgataḥ .. 11 ..
5.186.d:
स च विश्वावसुर्नाम पुलस्त्यस्य सुतो मुनिः ..
मंत्रपूतस्य मांसस्य भक्षणार्थं समागतः .. 11 ..
5.186.m: Now he was a sage named Viśvāvasu, the son of Pulastya, / who had come for the sake of eating meat consecrated by mantras.

5.186.s:
vedavedāṃgatattvajaḥ pautrastu parameṣṭhinaḥ ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasākāraṃ vitresuḥ sarvato dvijāḥ .. 12 ..
5.186.d:
वेदवेदांगतत्त्वजः पौत्रस्तु परमेष्ठिनः ..
तं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसाकारं वित्रेसुः सर्वतो द्विजाः .. 12 ..
5.186.m: He was a knower of the truth of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, and the grandson of the Supreme Lord [Brahmā]. / Seeing him in the form of a rākṣasa, the brahmins trembled on all sides.

5.186.s:
rākṣoghnāni ca sūktāni jajapuścāpare tathā ..
keciccharaṇamāpannā viṣṇo rudrasya cāpare .. 13 ..
5.186.d:
राक्षोघ्नानि च सूक्तानि जजपुश्चापरे तथा ..
केचिच्छरणमापन्ना विष्णो रुद्रस्य चापरे .. 13 ..
5.186.m: Others chanted hymns that slay rākṣasas; / some sought refuge in Viṣṇu, others in Rudra,

5.186.s:
pitāmahasya cānye tu gāyatryāḥ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ..
rakṣarakṣeti jalpanto bhayasaṃtrastamānasāḥ .. 14 ..
5.186.d:
पितामहस्य चान्ये तु गायत्र्याः शरणं गताः ..
रक्षरक्षेति जल्पन्तो भयसंत्रस्तमानसाः .. 14 ..
5.186.m: and others fled for protection to the Grandfather [Brahmā] and to Gāyatrī, / crying out, “Protect us, protect us!”, their minds terrified with fear.

5.186.s:
so'pi dṛṣṭvā tadātmānaṃ gataṃ rākṣasatāṃ dvijāḥ ..
bāṣpapūrṇekṣaṇo dīnaḥ pitāmahamupādravat .. 15 ..
5.186.d:
सोऽपि दृष्ट्वा तदात्मानं गतं राक्षसतां द्विजाः ..
बाष्पपूर्णेक्षणो दीनः पितामहमुपाद्रवत् .. 15 ..
5.186.m: He too, seeing himself reduced to the state of a rākṣasa, O brahmins, / wretched, with eyes full of tears, rushed to the Grandfather.

5.186.s: sa praṇamya tato vākyaṃ kṛtāṃjaliruvāca tam .. 16 .. .
5.186.d: स प्रणम्य ततो वाक्यं कृतांजलिरुवाच तम् .. 16 .. .
5.186.m: Having bowed, he then spoke these words to him with folded hands:

5.186.s:
pautro'haṃ tava deveśa pulastyasya suto dvijaḥ ..
nīto rākṣasatāmadya prasthātrā kopato vibho .. 17 ..
5.186.d:
पौत्रोऽहं तव देवेश पुलस्त्यस्य सुतो द्विजः ..
नीतो राक्षसतामद्य प्रस्थात्रा कोपतो विभो .. 17 ..
5.186.m: “I am your grandson, O Lord of the gods, a brahmin and the son of Pulastya. / Today I have been reduced to the state of a rākṣasa out of wrath by the priest, O Lord!

5.186.s:
jihvālaulyena deveśa paśorgudamajānatā ..
bhakṣitaṃ tanmayā deva homārthaṃ yatprakalpitam .. 18 ..
5.186.d:
जिह्वालौल्येन देवेश पशोर्गुदमजानता ..
भक्षितं तन्मया देव होमार्थं यत्प्रकल्पितम् .. 18 ..
5.186.m: Through greed of the tongue, O Lord of the gods, not knowing, / the entrails of the sacrificial beast that were intended for the oblation were eaten by me, O god.

5.186.s:
tasmānmānuṣatāprāptyai mama dehe dayāṃ kuru ..
rākṣasatvaṃ yathā yāti tathā nītirvidhīyatām .. 19.. '
5.186.d:
तस्मान्मानुषताप्राप्त्यै मम देहे दयां कुरु ..
राक्षसत्वं यथा याति तथा नीतिर्विधीयताम् .. 19.. '
5.186.m: Therefore, show mercy upon my body so that I may regain human state! / Let an expedient be devised so that this state of a rākṣasa may depart.”

5.186.s:
tacchrutvā jalpitaṃ tasya dayāṃ kṛtvā pitāmahaḥ ..
pratiprasthātaraṃ sāmavākyametaduvāca ha .. 6.187.20 ..
5.186.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा जल्पितं तस्य दयां कृत्वा पितामहः ..
प्रतिप्रस्थातरं सामवाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 6.187.20 ..
5.186.m: Hearing his speech, the Grandfather took pity / and spoke these conciliatory words to the pratiprasthātṛ priest:

5.186.s:
bālo'yaṃ mama pautrastu kṛtyākṛtyaṃ na vetti ca ..
tasmāttvaṃ rākṣasaṃ bhāvaṃ harasvāsya dvijottama .. 21 ..
5.186.d:
बालोऽयं मम पौत्रस्तु कृत्याकृत्यं न वेत्ति च ..
तस्मात्त्वं राक्षसं भावं हरस्वास्य द्विजोत्तम .. 21 ..
5.186.m: “This boy is my grandson, and he does not know what ought and ought not to be done. / Therefore, remove his rākṣasa condition, O best of brahmins!”

5.186.s:
tacchrutvā sa muniḥ prāha prāyaścittaṃ makhe tava ..
anena janitaṃ deva gudaṃ dūṣayatā vibho .. 22 ..
5.186.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा स मुनिः प्राह प्रायश्चित्तं मखे तव ..
अनेन जनितं देव गुदं दूषयता विभो .. 22 ..
5.186.m: Hearing that, the sage said: “In your sacrifice, O god, / a ritual expiation has been occasioned by this one defiling the entrails, O Lord.

5.186.s:
tasmādeṣa mayā śapto yajñavighnakaro mama ..
nāhamasya hariṣyāmi rākṣasatvaṃ kathaṃcana .. 23 ..
5.186.d:
तस्मादेष मया शप्तो यज्ञविघ्नकरो मम ..
नाहमस्य हरिष्यामि राक्षसत्वं कथंचन .. 23 ..
5.186.m: Therefore, he was cursed by me as a maker of obstacles to my sacrifice. / In no way shall I take away his rākṣasa state!

5.186.s: narmaṇāpi mayā proktaṃ kadācinnānṛtaṃ vacaḥ .. 24 .. ..
5.186.d: नर्मणापि मया प्रोक्तं कदाचिन्नानृतं वचः .. 24 .. ..
5.186.m: Even in jest, an untrue word has never been spoken by me.”

5.186.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
prāyaścittaṃ kariṣye'haṃ yajñasyāsya prasiddhaye ..
dakṣiṇā gauryathoktā ca kṛtvā homaṃ vidhānataḥ ..
tvamasya rākṣasaṃ bhāvaṃ 'harasva mama vākyataḥ .. 25 ..
5.186.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
प्रायश्चित्तं करिष्येऽहं यज्ञस्यास्य प्रसिद्धये ..
दक्षिणा गौर्यथोक्ता च कृत्वा होमं विधानतः ..
त्वमस्य राक्षसं भावं ऽहरस्व मम वाक्यतः .. 25 ..
5.186.m: Brahmā said: / “I shall perform an expiation for the successful completion of this sacrifice, / having performed the oblation according to rule and given the prescribed dakṣiṇā of a cow. / Remove his rākṣasa condition at my word!”

5.186.s:
so'bravīcchītalo vahniryadi syāduṣṇaguḥ śaśī ..
tanme syādanyathā vākyaṃ vyāhṛtaṃ prapitāmaha .. 26 ..
5.186.d:
सोऽब्रवीच्छीतलो वह्निर्यदि स्यादुष्णगुः शशी ..
तन्मे स्यादन्यथा वाक्यं व्याहृतं प्रपितामह .. 26 ..
5.186.m: He said: “If fire should become cold, or if the moon should become hot-rayed, / only then could the word spoken by me turn out otherwise, O great-grandfather!”

5.186.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā jñātvā caiva tu niścitam..
viśvāvasuṃ vidhiḥ prāha tato rākṣasarūpiṇam .. 27 ..
5.186.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ज्ञात्वा चैव तु निश्चितम्..
विश्वावसुं विधिः प्राह ततो राक्षसरूपिणम् .. 27 ..
5.186.m: Hearing his statement and realizing it was indeed irrevocable, / Brahmā then spoke to Viśvāvasu who was in the form of a rākṣasa:

5.186.s:
tvaṃ vatsānena rūpeṇa tiṣṭha tāvadvaco mama ..
kuruṣva te prayacchāmi yena sthānamanuttamam .. 28 ..
5.186.d:
त्वं वत्सानेन रूपेण तिष्ठ तावद्वचो मम ..
कुरुष्व ते प्रयच्छामि येन स्थानमनुत्तमम् .. 28 ..
5.186.m: “Child, remain for now in this form, and obey my word. / I shall grant you that by which you obtain an unsurpassed abode.

5.186.s:
camatkārapurasyāsya paścimasthānamāśritāḥ ..
santyanye rākṣasāstatra maryādāyāṃ vyavasthitāḥ .. 29 ..
laṃkāyāṃ rākṣasāścaiva prārthayanto'tra sadgatim ..
te cāgatya tamuddeśaṃ tapaḥ kurvaṃti suvratāḥ ..6.187.3...
5.186.d:
चमत्कारपुरस्यास्य पश्चिमस्थानमाश्रिताः ..
सन्त्यन्ये राक्षसास्तत्र मर्यादायां व्यवस्थिताः .. 29 ..
लंकायां राक्षसाश्चैव प्रार्थयन्तोऽत्र सद्गतिम् ..
ते चागत्य तमुद्देशं तपः कुर्वंति सुव्रताः ..6.187.3...
5.186.m:
Residing in the western part of this city of Camatkārapura, / there are other rākṣasas stationed there within proper bounds.
Rākṣasas in Laṅkā who desire a good destination here, / having arrived at that place, perform austerities, observing good vows.

5.186.s:
tatra prabhutvamātiṣṭha nāgarāṇāṃ hite sthitaḥ ..
rākṣasā bahavaḥ saṃti kūṣmāṃḍāśca piśācakāḥ .. 31 ..
5.186.d:
तत्र प्रभुत्वमातिष्ठ नागराणां हिते स्थितः ..
राक्षसा बहवः संति कूष्मांडाश्च पिशाचकाः .. 31 ..
5.186.m: Assume sovereignty there, remaining intent on the welfare of the Nāgaras. / There are many rākṣasas, kūṣmāṇḍas, and piśācas [there].

5.186.s:
ye cānye rākṣasāḥ kecidduṣṭabhāvasamāśritāḥ ..
tatra gacchaṃti ye sarve nigṛhṇaṃti ca tatkṣaṇāt .. 32 ..
5.186.d:
ये चान्ये राक्षसाः केचिद्दुष्टभावसमाश्रिताः ..
तत्र गच्छंति ये सर्वे निगृह्णंति च तत्क्षणात् .. 32 ..
5.186.m: Whatever other rākṣasas have resorted to a wicked disposition / and go there, they restrain them all instantly.

5.186.s:
bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca kūṣmāṃḍāśca viśeṣataḥ..
nāgaraṃ tu puro dṛṣṭvā tadbhayādyāṃti dūrataḥ .. 33 ..
5.186.d:
भूताः प्रेताः पिशाचाश्च कूष्मांडाश्च विशेषतः..
नागरं तु पुरो दृष्ट्वा तद्भयाद्यांति दूरतः .. 33 ..
5.186.m: Bhūtas, pretas, piśācas, and especially kūṣmāṇḍas, / upon seeing a N競争agara in front of them, flee far away out of fear of him.

5.186.s:
tadgaccha putra tatra tvaṃ sarveṣāmadhipo bhava ..
rākṣasānāṃ mayā dattaṃ tava rājyaṃ ca sāṃpratam .. 34 ..
5.186.d:
तद्गच्छ पुत्र तत्र त्वं सर्वेषामधिपो भव ..
राक्षसानां मया दत्तं तव राज्यं च सांप्रतम् .. 34 ..
5.186.m: Therefore go there, son, and become the overlord of them all! / The kingdom over the rākṣasas has now been given to you by me.”

5.186.s:
.. rākṣasa uvāca .. ..
ādhipatye sthitasyaivaṃ rākṣasānāṃ pitāmaha ..
kiṃ mayā tatra bhoktavyaṃ tebhyo deyaṃ ca kiṃ vada .. 35 ..
5.186.d:
.. राक्षस उवाच .. ..
आधिपत्ये स्थितस्यैवं राक्षसानां पितामह ..
किं मया तत्र भोक्तव्यं तेभ्यो देयं च किं वद .. 35 ..
5.186.m: The rākṣasa said: / “When I am established in this way in lordship over the rākṣasas, O Grandfather, / tell me, what is to be eaten by me there, and what is to be given to them?

5.186.s:
rājñā caiva yato deyaṃ bhṛtyānāṃ bhojanaṃ vibho ..
tanmamācakṣva deveśa dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari .. 36 ..
5.186.d:
राज्ञा चैव यतो देयं भृत्यानां भोजनं विभो ..
तन्ममाचक्ष्व देवेश दयां कृत्वा ममोपरि .. 36 ..
5.186.m: For food must be provided by a king to his servants, O Lord; / therefore tell me that, O Lord of the gods, taking pity on me.

5.186.s:
na karoti ca yo rājā. bhṛtyavargasya poṣaṇam..
rauravaṃ narakaṃ yāti sa evaṃ hi śrutaṃ mayā .. 37 ..
5.186.d:
न करोति च यो राजा. भृत्यवर्गस्य पोषणम्..
रौरवं नरकं याति स एवं हि श्रुतं मया .. 37 ..
5.186.m: A king who does not maintain his group of servants / goes to the Raurava hell; for so it has been heard by me.”

5.186.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
yacchrāddhaṃ dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ tilairdarbhairvivarjitam ..
tatsarvaṃ te mayā dattaṃ yadyapi syātsutīrthagam.. 38 ..
5.186.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
यच्छ्राद्धं दक्षिणाहीनं तिलैर्दर्भैर्विवर्जितम् ..
तत्सर्वं ते मया दत्तं यद्यपि स्यात्सुतीर्थगम्.. 38 ..
5.186.m: Brahmā said: / “Whatever ancestral offering is devoid of sacrificial gifts, and lacking sesamum and darbha grass, / all that is given to you by me, even if it be performed at an excellent tīrtha.

5.186.s:
yacchrāddhaṃ sūkaraḥ paśyennārī vātha rajasvalā ..
kauleyako'tha vāleyastatsarvaṃ te bhaviṣyati .. 39 ..
5.186.d:
यच्छ्राद्धं सूकरः पश्येन्नारी वाथ रजस्वला ..
कौलेयकोऽथ वालेयस्तत्सर्वं ते भविष्यति .. 39 ..
5.186.m: Whatever ancestral offering a pig, or a menstruating woman, / or a dog, or a donkey should look upon, all that shall belong to you.

5.186.s:
vidhihīnaṃ tu yacchrāddhaṃ darbhervā mūlavarjitaiḥ ..
vitasteradhikairvāpi tatsarvaṃ te bhaviṣyati .. 6.187.40 ..
5.186.d:
विधिहीनं तु यच्छ्राद्धं दर्भेर्वा मूलवर्जितैः ..
वितस्तेरधिकैर्वापि तत्सर्वं ते भविष्यति .. 6.187.40 ..
5.186.m: Whatever ancestral offering is devoid of rules, or performed with rootless darbha grass, / or with grass longer than a span, all that shall belong to you.

5.186.s:
tilaṃ vā tailapakvaṃ vā śūkadhānyamathāpi vā ..
na yatra dīyate śrāddhe tatte śrāddhaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 41 ..
5.186.d:
तिलं वा तैलपक्वं वा शूकधान्यमथापि वा ..
न यत्र दीयते श्राद्धे तत्ते श्राद्धं भविष्यति .. 41 ..
5.186.m: An ancestral offering in which sesamum, or food cooked in oil, / or bearded grain is not given, that ancestral offering shall belong to you.

5.186.s:
asnātairyatkṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ yaccādhautāṃbaraiḥ kṛtam ..
tailābhyaṃgayutaiścaiva tatte sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 42 ..
5.186.d:
अस्नातैर्यत्कृतं श्राद्धं यच्चाधौतांबरैः कृतम् ..
तैलाभ्यंगयुतैश्चैव तत्ते सर्वं भविष्यति .. 42 ..
5.186.m: Whatever ancestral offering is performed by unbathed persons, or by those with unwashed garments, / or by those smeared with oil, all that shall belong to you.

5.186.s:
yadvā māhiṣiko bhuṃkte śvitrī vā kunakho'pi vā ..
kuṣṭhī vātha dvijo bhuṃkte tatte śrāddhaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 43 ..
5.186.d:
यद्वा माहिषिको भुंक्ते श्वित्री वा कुनखोऽपि वा ..
कुष्ठी वाथ द्विजो भुंक्ते तत्ते श्राद्धं भविष्यति .. 43 ..
5.186.m: Or whatever [ancestral offering] a keeper of buffaloes eats, or one with white leprosy, or one with deformed nails, / or whatever brahmin suffering from leprosy eats, that ancestral offering shall belong to you.

5.186.s:
hīnāṃgo vā'tha yadbhuṃkte'dhikāṃgo vātha niṃditaḥ ..
mahāvyādhigṛhīto vā cauro vārddhuṣiko'pi vā ..
yatra bhuṃkte'thavā śrāddhe tatte śrāddhaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 44 ..
5.186.d:
हीनांगो वाऽथ यद्भुंक्तेऽधिकांगो वाथ निंदितः ..
महाव्याधिगृहीतो वा चौरो वार्द्धुषिकोऽपि वा ..
यत्र भुंक्तेऽथवा श्राद्धे तत्ते श्राद्धं भविष्यति .. 44 ..
5.186.m: Or whatever [ancestral offering] one with a deficient limb eats, or one with a redundant limb, or a censured man, / or one seized by a severe disease, or a thief, or a usurer eats, that ancestral offering shall belong to you.

5.186.s:
śyāvadantastu yadbhuṃkte yadbhuṃkte vṛṣalīpatiḥ ..
vinagno vātha yadbhuṃkte tatte śrāddhaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 45 ..
5.186.d:
श्यावदन्तस्तु यद्भुंक्ते यद्भुंक्ते वृषलीपतिः ..
विनग्नो वाथ यद्भुंक्ते तत्ते श्राद्धं भविष्यति .. 45 ..
5.186.m: Whatever a black-toothed man eats, or whatever the husband of a śūdra woman eats, / or whatever a naked man eats, that ancestral offering shall belong to you.

5.186.s:
yo yajño dakṣiṇāhīno yaścāśaucayutaiḥ kṛtaḥ ..
brahmacaryavihīnastu tatphalaṃ te bhaviṣyati .. 46 ..
5.186.d:
यो यज्ञो दक्षिणाहीनो यश्चाशौचयुतैः कृतः ..
ब्रह्मचर्यविहीनस्तु तत्फलं ते भविष्यति .. 46 ..
5.186.m: Whatever sacrifice is devoid of priestly fees, and whatever is performed by impure persons, / or devoid of celibacy, the fruit of that shall belong to you.”

5.186.s:
yasminnaivātithiḥ pūjyaḥ śrāddhe vā yajñakarmaṇi ..
saṃprāpte vaiśvadevāṃte tatte sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 47 ..1
5.186.d:
यस्मिन्नैवातिथिः पूज्यः श्राद्धे वा यज्ञकर्मणि ..
संप्राप्ते वैश्वदेवांते तत्ते सर्वं भविष्यति .. 47 ..1
5.186.m: The śrāddha or sacrifice in which a guest who arrives at the end of the vaiśvadeva offering is not honoured—all that shall be yours. / 47

5.186.s:
āvāhanātparaṃ yatra maunaṃ na śrāddhadaścaret..
brāhmaṇo vā'tha bhoktā ca tatte śrāddhaṃ bhaviṣyati..48..
5.186.d:
आवाहनात्परं यत्र मौनं न श्राद्धदश्चरेत्..
ब्राह्मणो वाऽथ भोक्ता च तत्ते श्राद्धं भविष्यति..48..
5.186.m: Where the performer of the śrāddha does not observe silence after the invocation, / or the brahmin who eats does not, that śrāddha shall be yours. / 48

5.186.s:
mṛnmayeṣu ca pātreṣu yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute naraḥ ..
bhinnapātreṣu vā yacca tatte sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 49 ..
5.186.d:
मृन्मयेषु च पात्रेषु यः श्राद्धं कुरुते नरः ..
भिन्नपात्रेषु वा यच्च तत्ते सर्वं भविष्यति .. 49 ..
5.186.m: And whatever śrāddha a man performs using earthenware vessels, / or that which is in broken vessels—all that shall be yours. / 49

5.186.s:
pratyakṣalavaṇaṃ yatra takraṃ vā vikṛtaṃ bhavet ..
jātīpuṣpapradānaṃ ca tatte sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 6.187.50 ..
5.186.d:
प्रत्यक्षलवणं यत्र तक्रं वा विकृतं भवेत् ..
जातीपुष्पप्रदानं च तत्ते सर्वं भविष्यति .. 6.187.50 ..
5.186.m: Where visible salt [is served] or butter-milk is spoiled, / and where jasmine flowers are offered—all that shall be yours. / 50

5.186.s:
yajamāno dvijo vātha brahmacaryavivarjitaḥ ..
tacchrāddhaṃ te mayā dattaṃ tripātreṇa vivarjitam .. 51 ..
5.186.d:
यजमानो द्विजो वाथ ब्रह्मचर्यविवर्जितः ..
तच्छ्राद्धं ते मया दत्तं त्रिपात्रेण विवर्जितम् .. 51 ..
5.186.m: Whether the patron or the twice-born priest is devoid of celibacy, / that śrāddha, bereft of the three vessels, has been given to you by me. / 51

5.186.s:
āyasena tu pātreṇa yatrānnaṃ ca pradīyate ..
tacchrāddhaṃ te mayā dattaṃ tathānyadapi hīyate .. 52 ..
5.186.d:
आयसेन तु पात्रेण यत्रान्नं च प्रदीयते ..
तच्छ्राद्धं ते मया दत्तं तथान्यदपि हीयते .. 52 ..
5.186.m: And where food is served on an iron vessel, / that śrāddha has been given to you by me, and whatever other [faulty rite] is ruined. / 52

5.186.s:
maṃtrakriyābhyāṃ yatkicidrātrau dattaṃ hutaṃ tathā ..
sakrāṃtisomaparvabhyāṃ vyati riktaṃ tu kutsitam .. 53 ..
5.186.d:
मंत्रक्रियाभ्यां यत्किचिद्रात्रौ दत्तं हुतं तथा ..
सक्रांतिसोमपर्वभ्यां व्यति रिक्तं तु कुत्सितम् .. 53 ..
5.186.m: Whatever is offered or poured into the fire at night through mantra and ritual, / other than during the saṃkrānti and somaparvan days, is vile [and yours]. / 53

5.186.s:
ityuktvā virarāmāśu brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ..
rākṣasaḥ so'pi tatrāpi lebhe sthānaṃ tu rākṣasam .. 54 ..
5.186.d:
इत्युक्त्वा विररामाशु ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः ..
राक्षसः सोऽपि तत्रापि लेभे स्थानं तु राक्षसम् .. 54 ..
5.186.m: Having spoken thus, Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, immediately fell silent; / and that rākṣasa also obtained a rākṣasa’s place right there. / 54

5.186.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye rākṣasaprāpyaśrāddhavarṇanaṃnāma saptāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 187 .. .. ..
5.186.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठ नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये राक्षसप्राप्यश्राद्धवर्णनंनाम सप्ताशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. .. 187 .. .. ..
5.186.m: Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-seventh chapter, entitled 'Description of the Śrāddha Pertaining to the Rākṣasa', in the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvara Kṣetra, in the sixth [section], Nāgarakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. / 187

5.187.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tatastu paṃcame cāhni saṃjāte te dvijottamāḥ ..
śvetadhautāṃbarāḥ sarve susnātāḥ śucayaḥ sthitāḥ .. .. 1 ..
5.187.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
ततस्तु पंचमे चाह्नि संजाते ते द्विजोत्तमाः ..
श्वेतधौतांबराः सर्वे सुस्नाताः शुचयः स्थिताः .. .. 1 ..
5.187.m: Sūta said: / Then, when the fifth day arrived, those best of twice-borns, / all clad in washed white garments, well-bathed and pure, stood ready. / 1

5.187.s:
cakruḥ sarvāṇi karmāṇi pulastyena prabodhitāḥ ..
sadomadhye gatāścaiva ṛtvigvaraṇapūrvakāḥ .. 2 ..
5.187.d:
चक्रुः सर्वाणि कर्माणि पुलस्त्येन प्रबोधिताः ..
सदोमध्ये गताश्चैव ऋत्विग्वरणपूर्वकाः .. 2 ..
5.187.m: Admonished by Pulastya, they performed all the rites; / having entered the sacrificial pavilion, they first chose the officiating priests. / 2

5.187.s:
adhvaryuṇā samādiṣṭānpraiṣānprocuryathā kramam ..
homārthaṃ dīptavahnau ca ṛtvigbhiḥ susamāhitaiḥ .. 3 ..
5.187.d:
अध्वर्युणा समादिष्टान्प्रैषान्प्रोचुर्यथा क्रमम् ..
होमार्थं दीप्तवह्नौ च ऋत्विग्भिः सुसमाहितैः .. 3 ..
5.187.m: Instructed by the adhvaryu, they recited the praiṣa calls in due order / for the sake of the oblation into the blazing fire, through well-concentrated officiating priests. / 3

5.187.s:
etasminneva kāle tu hyudgātrā karma yojitam ..
śaṃkubhiḥ kriyate yacca sāma gītiprasūcitam.. 4 ..
5.187.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु ह्युद्गात्रा कर्म योजितम् ..
शंकुभिः क्रियते यच्च साम गीतिप्रसूचितम्.. 4 ..
5.187.m: At that very time, the ritual was undertaken by the udgātṛ, / which is performed with pegs as indicated by the chanting of the Sāman, / 4

5.187.s:
saptāvartaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ sadomadhyagatena ca ..
yatrā''gacchaṃti te sarve devā yajñāṃśalālasāḥ .. 5 ..
5.187.d:
सप्तावर्तं द्विजश्रेष्ठाः सदोमध्यगतेन च ..
यत्रा'ऽगच्छंति ते सर्वे देवा यज्ञांशलालसाः .. 5 ..
5.187.m: seven turns, O best of twice-borns, by him who had entered the sacrificial pavilion, / where all those gods arrive, eager for their sacrificial shares, / 5

5.187.s:
somapānakṛte caiva viśeṣeṇa mudānvitāḥ ..
prārabdhe somabhakṣye'tha gīte codgātṛnirmite .. 6 ..
5.187.d:
सोमपानकृते चैव विशेषेण मुदान्विताः ..
प्रारब्धे सोमभक्ष्येऽथ गीते चोद्गातृनिर्मिते .. 6 ..
5.187.m: especially filled with joy for the drinking of Soma. / Then, when the consuming of the Soma began and the chant composed by the udgātṛ was sung, / 6

5.187.s:
āgatā kanyakā caikā sāmagītisamutsukā ..
śaṃkukarṇanajaṃ citraṃ vāṃchamānā vicakṣaṇā .. 7 ..
5.187.d:
आगता कन्यका चैका सामगीतिसमुत्सुका ..
शंकुकर्णनजं चित्रं वांछमाना विचक्षणा .. 7 ..
5.187.m: a maiden arrived, eager to hear the Sāman chanting, / wise and desirous of seeing the marvel born of the peg-sound. / 7

5.187.s:
chandogasya sutā śreṣṭhā devaśarmābhidhasya ca ..
audumbarīti nāmnā sā sāmaśravaṇalālasā .. 8 ..
5.187.d:
छन्दोगस्य सुता श्रेष्ठा देवशर्माभिधस्य च ..
औदुम्बरीति नाम्ना सा सामश्रवणलालसा .. 8 ..
5.187.m: She was the excellent daughter of a chanter of the Chandoga school named Devaśarman, / called Audumbarī by name, longing to listen to the Sāman. / 8

5.187.s:
udgātāraṃ ca sadasi vacanaṃ vyājahāra sā ..
yathāyathā pravartaṃte śaṃkavaḥ sāmasūcitāḥ .. 9 ..
5.187.d:
उद्गातारं च सदसि वचनं व्याजहार सा ..
यथायथा प्रवर्तंते शंकवः सामसूचिताः .. 9 ..
5.187.m: And she addressed a word to the udgātṛ in the assembly: / 'Just as the pegs indicated by the Sāman are being driven, / 9

5.187.s:
dakṣiṇāgnau drutaṃ gatvā kuru homaṃ yathoditam ..
yena tvaṃ mucyase pāpānna cedvyartho bhaviṣyati .. 6.188.10 ..
5.187.d:
दक्षिणाग्नौ द्रुतं गत्वा कुरु होमं यथोदितम् ..
येन त्वं मुच्यसे पापान्न चेद्व्यर्थो भविष्यति .. 6.188.10 ..
5.187.m: go quickly to the Dakṣiṇa fire and make the oblation as prescribed, / by which you will be freed from sin; if not, it will become fruitless.' / 10

5.187.s:
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā sābhiprāyaṃ dvijottamāḥ ..
tataḥ sa cintayāmāsa yāvattadvyāhṛtaṃ vacaḥ .. 11 ..
5.187.d:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा साभिप्रायं द्विजोत्तमाः ..
ततः स चिन्तयामास यावत्तद्व्याहृतं वचः .. 11 ..
5.187.m: O best of twice-borns, having heard her speech fraught with meaning, / he then reflected upon the word that had been spoken. / 11

5.187.s:
tataḥ papraccha tāṃ kanyāmudgātā vismayānvitaḥ ..
kutastvamasi cā''yātā sutā kasya vadasva me .. 12 ..
5.187.d:
ततः पप्रच्छ तां कन्यामुद्गाता विस्मयान्वितः ..
कुतस्त्वमसि चा'ऽयाता सुता कस्य वदस्व मे .. 12 ..
5.187.m: Then, filled with wonder, the udgātṛ asked that maiden: / 'From where have you come, and whose daughter are you? Tell me!' / 12

5.187.s:
.. audumbaryuvāca .. ..
parvatasya sutā cāsmi vikhyātā devaśarmaṇaḥ ..
jātismarā mahābhāga prāptā gandharvalokataḥ .. 13 ..
5.187.d:
.. औदुम्बर्युवाच .. ..
पर्वतस्य सुता चास्मि विख्याता देवशर्मणः ..
जातिस्मरा महाभाग प्राप्ता गन्धर्वलोकतः .. 13 ..
5.187.m: Audumbarī said: / 'I am the daughter of Parvata, and [now] renowned as that of Devaśarman; / I remember my past lives, O fortunate one, and have come from the world of the Gandharvas.' / 13

5.187.s:
.. udgātovāca .. ..
gandharvasya sutā kasya kena śaptāsi putrike ..
kadā te bhavitā mokṣo mānuṣatvasya kīrttaya .. 14 ..
5.187.d:
.. उद्गातोवाच .. ..
गन्धर्वस्य सुता कस्य केन शप्तासि पुत्रिके ..
कदा ते भविता मोक्षो मानुषत्वस्य कीर्त्तय .. 14 ..
5.187.m: The udgātṛ said: / 'Whose Gandharva’s daughter are you? By whom were you cursed, O daughter? / When will your liberation from human form occur? Tell me!' / 14

5.187.s:
.. audumbaryuvāca .. ..
nāradaḥ parvataścaiva gandharvau viditau janaiḥ ..
parvatasya sutā cāsmi śaptāhaṃ nāradena hi .. 15 ..
5.187.d:
.. औदुम्बर्युवाच .. ..
नारदः पर्वतश्चैव गन्धर्वौ विदितौ जनैः ..
पर्वतस्य सुता चास्मि शप्ताहं नारदेन हि .. 15 ..
5.187.m: Audumbarī said: / 'Nārada and Parvata are two Gandharvas known to men; / and I am the daughter of Parvata, but cursed by Nārada. / 15

5.187.s:
vipaṃcīṃ vādayansvairaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ sa munisattamaḥ ..
ajānaṃtyā ca tānānāṃ viśeṣaṃ mūrcchanodbhavam ..
mayā sa hasito'tīva tānabhaṃgatayā gataḥ .. 16 ..
5.187.d:
विपंचीं वादयन्स्वैरं दृष्टः स मुनिसत्तमः ..
अजानंत्या च तानानां विशेषं मूर्च्छनोद्भवम् ..
मया स हसितोऽतीव तानभंगतया गतः .. 16 ..
5.187.m: That best of sages was seen playing his vīṇā freely; / and not knowing the distinction of the tones produced by the melodic progression, / I laughed heartily at him as he committed a lapse in tone. / 16

5.187.s:
tataḥ sa kupito mahyaṃ dadau śāpaṃ dvijottamaḥ ..
mithyāpahasito yasmādahaṃ śāpamato'rhasi .. 17 ..
5.187.d:
ततः स कुपितो मह्यं ददौ शापं द्विजोत्तमः ..
मिथ्यापहसितो यस्मादहं शापमतोऽर्हसि .. 17 ..
5.187.m: Then that best of twice-borns, angered at me, gave a curse: / "Because I have been falsely laughed at, therefore you deserve a curse. / 17

5.187.s:
mānuṣāṇāmayaṃ dharmastasmāttvaṃ mānuṣī bhava ..
mayā prasāditaḥ so'tha pitrā sārdhaṃ munīśvaraḥ .. 18 ..
5.187.d:
मानुषाणामयं धर्मस्तस्मात्त्वं मानुषी भव ..
मया प्रसादितः सोऽथ पित्रा सार्धं मुनीश्वरः .. 18 ..
5.187.m: This is the nature of mortals; therefore, become a mortal woman!" / Then, together with my father, that lord of sages was propitiated by me: / 18

5.187.s:
śāpāṃtaṃ kuru me nātha bāliśāyā viśeṣataḥ ..
mānuṣatvaṃ ca me bhūyātsusthāne sukule vibho .. 19 ..
5.187.d:
शापांतं कुरु मे नाथ बालिशाया विशेषतः ..
मानुषत्वं च मे भूयात्सुस्थाने सुकुले विभो .. 19 ..
5.187.m: "Put an end to my curse, O lord, especially since I am foolish; / and may my human birth be in a good place and in a good family, O omnipresent one, / 19

5.187.s:
susthāne cāṃtakālaśca brāhmaṇasya niveśane ..
tato'haṃ tena saṃproktā camatkārapureṃ śubhe . 6.188.20 ..
5.187.d:
सुस्थाने चांतकालश्च ब्राह्मणस्य निवेशने ..
ततोऽहं तेन संप्रोक्ता चमत्कारपुरें शुभे . 6.188.20 ..
5.187.m: and my time of death in a good place, in the dwelling of a brahmin!" / Then I was told by him: "In auspicious Camatkārapura, / 20

5.187.s:
devaśarmā tu vipreṃdraḥ kulīnaḥ sarvaśāstravit ..
tasya tu brāhmaṇī nāmnā satyabhāmeti viśrutā .. 21 ..
5.187.d:
देवशर्मा तु विप्रेंद्रः कुलीनः सर्वशास्त्रवित् ..
तस्य तु ब्राह्मणी नाम्ना सत्यभामेति विश्रुता .. 21 ..
5.187.m: there is a lord of brahmins, Devaśarman, of noble family and learned in all śāstras. / His brahmin wife is renowned by the name Satyabhāmā. / 21

5.187.s:
tasyā garbhaṃ samāsādya mānuṣatvaṃ samācara ..
yadā paitāmaho yajñastasminkṣetre bhaviṣyati .. 22 ..
5.187.d:
तस्या गर्भं समासाद्य मानुषत्वं समाचर ..
यदा पैतामहो यज्ञस्तस्मिन्क्षेत्रे भविष्यति .. 22 ..
5.187.m: Entering her womb, undergo human existence! / When a sacrifice to the Grandfather [Brahmā] takes place in that kṣetra, / 22

5.187.s:
udgātuḥ samaye tasya śaṃkoścaiva viparyaye ..
tadā tu sa tvayā vācyo hyasthāne śaṃkurāhitaḥ ..
sarvadevasabhā madhye tadā mokṣo bhaviṣyati .. 23 ..
5.187.d:
उद्गातुः समये तस्य शंकोश्चैव विपर्यये ..
तदा तु स त्वया वाच्यो ह्यस्थाने शंकुराहितः ..
सर्वदेवसभा मध्ये तदा मोक्षो भविष्यति .. 23 ..
5.187.m: at the time of the udgātṛ, when there is an error regarding the peg, / then he must be told by you, 'The peg has been placed in the wrong spot.' / In the midst of the assembly of all the gods, liberation will then occur for you." / 23

5.187.s:
imāṃ me daivikīṃ kāṃtāṃ tanuṃ paśya dvijottama ..
vimānaṃ paśya cāyātaṃ pitrā saṃpreṣitaṃ mama .. 24 .. ..
5.187.d:
इमां मे दैविकीं कांतां तनुं पश्य द्विजोत्तम ..
विमानं पश्य चायातं पित्रा संप्रेषितं मम .. 24 .. ..
5.187.m: Look upon this divine, lovely body of mine, O best of twice-borns! / And see the aerial chariot that has arrived, sent by my father!' / 24

5.187.s:
.. udgātovāca .. ..
tuṣṭo'haṃ te viśālākṣi yajñasyā'vighnakārake ..
na vṛthā darśanaṃ me syādviśeṣāddevasaṃbhave ..
varaṃ varaya mattastvaṃ tasmādaudumbarīpsitam .. 25 ..
5.187.d:
.. उद्गातोवाच .. ..
तुष्टोऽहं ते विशालाक्षि यज्ञस्याऽविघ्नकारके ..
न वृथा दर्शनं मे स्याद्विशेषाद्देवसंभवे ..
वरं वरय मत्तस्त्वं तस्मादौदुम्बरीप्सितम् .. 25 ..
5.187.m: The udgātṛ said: / 'I am pleased with you, O large-eyed one, who have prevented an obstacle to the sacrifice; / my darśana should not be in vain, especially since you are of divine origin. / Therefore, choose a boon from me, O Audumbarī, which you desire.' / 25

5.187.s:
audumbaryuvāca .. ..
yadi me yacchasi varaṃ santuṣṭo brāhmaṇottama ..
sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ purataśca dadasva tam .. 26 ..
5.187.d:
औदुम्बर्युवाच .. ..
यदि मे यच्छसि वरं सन्तुष्टो ब्राह्मणोत्तम ..
सर्वेषामेव देवानां पुरतश्च ददस्व तम् .. 26 ..
5.187.m: Audumbarī said: / 'If you grant me a boon, being pleased, O best of brahmins, / then grant it in the presence of all the gods: / 26

5.187.s:
adyaprabhṛti yaḥ kaścidyajñaṃ bhūmau samācaret ..
tasminsadasi madhyasthā mūrtiḥ kāryā yathā mama .. .. 27 ..
5.187.d:
अद्यप्रभृति यः कश्चिद्यज्ञं भूमौ समाचरेत् ..
तस्मिन्सदसि मध्यस्था मूर्तिः कार्या यथा मम .. .. 27 ..
5.187.m: "From this day onward, whoever performs a sacrifice on earth, / an image like mine must be placed in the middle of that sacrificial pavilion. / 27

5.187.s:
tato matpurataścaiva kāryaṃ śaṃkupracāraṇam ..
svargasthāyā bhavettuṣṭirmama tena kṛtena ca .. 28 ..
5.187.d:
ततो मत्पुरतश्चैव कार्यं शंकुप्रचारणम् ..
स्वर्गस्थाया भवेत्तुष्टिर्मम तेन कृतेन च .. 28 ..
5.187.m: Then, right before me, the movement of the pegs must be performed; / by that being done, there shall be satisfaction for me who dwell in heaven."' / 28

5.187.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā udgātā tāmathābravīt ..
adyaprabhṛti yaḥ kaścidyajñamatra kariṣyati .. 29 ..
5.187.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा उद्गाता तामथाब्रवीत् ..
अद्यप्रभृति यः कश्चिद्यज्ञमत्र करिष्यति .. 29 ..
5.187.m: Sūta said: / Having heard her word, the udgātṛ then said to her: / 'From this day onward, whoever performs a sacrifice here, / 29

5.187.s:
sadomadhye tu tāṃ sthāpya pūjayitvā vilepanaiḥ ..
vastrairābharaṇaiścaiva gandhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ .. 6.188.30 ..
5.187.d:
सदोमध्ये तु तां स्थाप्य पूजयित्वा विलेपनैः ..
वस्त्रैराभरणैश्चैव गन्धपुष्पानुलेपनैः .. 6.188.30 ..
5.187.m: having placed that [image] in the middle of the sacrificial pavilion and worshipped it with unguents, / garments, ornaments, fragrant powders, and flowers, / 30

5.187.s:
tataḥ śaṃkupracāraṃ tu kariṣyati tadagrataḥ ..
etadvākyaṃ mayā proktaṃ sarvadevasamā game .. 31 ..
5.187.d:
ततः शंकुप्रचारं तु करिष्यति तदग्रतः ..
एतद्वाक्यं मया प्रोक्तं सर्वदेवसमा गमे .. 31 ..
5.187.m: shall then perform the movement of the pegs in front of it.' / This statement was spoken by me in the assembly of all the gods. / 31

5.187.s:
nānyathā bhāvi bhadraṃ te tvaṃ saṃtoṣaṃ paraṃ vraja ..
tvayā virahitaṃ bhadre sadaḥkarma kariṣyati .. 32 ..
5.187.d:
नान्यथा भावि भद्रं ते त्वं संतोषं परं व्रज ..
त्वया विरहितं भद्रे सदःकर्म करिष्यति .. 32 ..
5.187.m: "It will not be otherwise; good fortune to you! Attain supreme contentment! / Whatever rite of the sacrificial assembly is performed without you, auspicious one,

5.187.s:
vṛthā bhāvi ca tatsarvaṃ yathā bhasmahutaṃ tathā ..
yā nārī sadaso madhye phalaistvāṃ pūjayiṣyati .. 33 ..
5.187.d:
वृथा भावि च तत्सर्वं यथा भस्महुतं तथा ..
या नारी सदसो मध्ये फलैस्त्वां पूजयिष्यति .. 33 ..
5.187.m: all of that will be in vain, just like an oblation poured onto ashes. / Whatever woman shall worship you with fruits in the midst of the assembly,

5.187.s:
phalephale koṭiguṇaṃ tasyāḥ śreyo bhaviṣyati ..
saphalāśca diśaḥ sarvā bhaviṣyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ .. 34 ..
5.187.d:
फलेफले कोटिगुणं तस्याः श्रेयो भविष्यति ..
सफलाश्च दिशः सर्वा भविष्यंति न संशयः .. 34 ..
5.187.m: for every fruit, her welfare will be multiplied ten-millionfold. / And all quarters shall be fruitful [for her], of this there is no doubt.

5.187.s:
vastramābharaṇaṃ yā ca puṣpadhūpādikaṃ tathā ..
tubhyaṃ dāsyati tatsarvaṃ tasyāḥ koṭiguṇaṃ phalam .. 35 ..
5.187.d:
वस्त्रमाभरणं या च पुष्पधूपादिकं तथा ..
तुभ्यं दास्यति तत्सर्वं तस्याः कोटिगुणं फलम् .. 35 ..
5.187.m: And whatever woman offers garments, ornaments, flowers, incense, and the like / to you, her reward for all that will be ten-millionfold.

5.187.s:
paraṃ tāvatpratīkṣasva mā vimānaṃ samāruha ..
devi kenāpi kāryeṇa tava pūjāṃ samācare .. 36 ..
5.187.d:
परं तावत्प्रतीक्षस्व मा विमानं समारुह ..
देवि केनापि कार्येण तव पूजां समाचरे .. 36 ..
5.187.m: Wait for a short while; do not mount the aerial chariot yet! / O goddess, for a certain matter I shall perform your worship."

5.187.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
yuktaṃ tvayā dvijaśreṣṭha vacanaṃ samudāhṛtam ..
asmākamapi vākyena satyametadbhaviṣyati .. 37 ..
5.187.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
युक्तं त्वया द्विजश्रेष्ठ वचनं समुदाहृतम् ..
अस्माकमपि वाक्येन सत्यमेतद्भविष्यति .. 37 ..
5.187.m: The gods said: / "A fitting utterance has been spoken by you, O best of the twice-born! / By our word also, this shall come to be true."

5.187.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
udgātrā saitamuktā ca tiṣṭhatiṣṭhetyathoditā ..
devī varavimānena gṛhītā sāṃ'bare sthitā .. 38 ..
5.187.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
उद्गात्रा सैतमुक्ता च तिष्ठतिष्ठेत्यथोदिता ..
देवी वरविमानेन गृहीता सांऽबरे स्थिता .. 38 ..
5.187.m: Sūta said: / Thus addressed by the Udgātṛ and told, "Wait, wait!", / the goddess, taken up by the excellent aerial chariot, stood in the sky.

5.187.s:
etasminneva kāle tu devaśarmasutā'bhavat ..
devī nagaramadhyasthāṃ sarvā nāryo dvijottamāḥ .. 39 ..
5.187.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु देवशर्मसुताऽभवत् ..
देवी नगरमध्यस्थां सर्वा नार्यो द्विजोत्तमाः .. 39 ..
5.187.m: At that very time, the daughter of Devaśarman was there. / All the women, O best of the twice-born, [seeing] the goddess staying in the midst of the town,

5.187.s:
kutūhalātsamāyātāstasyā darśanalālasāḥ ..
kācitphalāni cādāya kācidvastrāṇi bhaktitaḥ ..
yathārhaṃ pūjitā tābhiḥ sarvābhiśca dvijottamāḥ .. 6.188.40 ..
5.187.d:
कुतूहलात्समायातास्तस्या दर्शनलालसाः ..
काचित्फलानि चादाय काचिद्वस्त्राणि भक्तितः ..
यथार्हं पूजिता ताभिः सर्वाभिश्च द्विजोत्तमाः .. 6.188.40 ..
5.187.m: approached out of curiosity, eager for a darśana of her. / One bringing fruits and another garments with devotion, / she was duly worshipped by all of them, O best of the twice-born.

5.187.s:
śrutvā svaduhituḥ so'pi devaśarmā samāyayau ..
sapatnīkaḥ prahṛṣṭātmā vismayotphullalocanaḥ .. 41 ..
5.187.d:
श्रुत्वा स्वदुहितुः सोऽपि देवशर्मा समाययौ ..
सपत्नीकः प्रहृष्टात्मा विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनः .. 41 ..
5.187.m: Hearing [of this] regarding his daughter, that Devaśarman also arrived / together with his wife, delighted in heart, with eyes widened in wonder.

5.187.s:
so'pi yāvatpraṇāmaṃ ca tasyāścakre dvijottamāḥ ..
sapatnīkastadā proktvā niṣiddhastu tathā tayā .. 42 ..
5.187.d:
सोऽपि यावत्प्रणामं च तस्याश्चक्रे द्विजोत्तमाः ..
सपत्नीकस्तदा प्रोक्त्वा निषिद्धस्तु तथा तया .. 42 ..
5.187.m: As he along with his wife was about to pay obeisance to her, O best of the twice-born, / he was then addressed and stopped by her:

5.187.s:
tātatāta namaskāraṃ mā me kuru sahāṃbayā ..
prāptā svargagatirnāma mama nāśaṃ prayāsyati .. 43 ..
5.187.d:
ताततात नमस्कारं मा मे कुरु सहांबया ..
प्राप्ता स्वर्गगतिर्नाम मम नाशं प्रयास्यति .. 43 ..
5.187.m: "Father, father! Do not make an obeisance to me together with mother! / The state of attaining heaven that I have reached will surely come to ruin.

5.187.s:
tiṣṭhātraiva sapatnīko yāvadadya dinaṃ vibho ..
tvāmādāya sapatnīkaṃ yāsyāmi tridivālayam ..
anenaiva śarīreṇa yācayitvā surottamān .. 44 ..
5.187.d:
तिष्ठात्रैव सपत्नीको यावदद्य दिनं विभो ..
त्वामादाय सपत्नीकं यास्यामि त्रिदिवालयम् ..
अनेनैव शरीरेण याचयित्वा सुरोत्तमान् .. 44 ..
5.187.m: Stay right here with your wife until today ends, O lord. / Taking you together with your wife, I will go to the abode of the thirty [gods] / in this very body, after begging the best of the gods."

5.187.s:
tatastau harṣitau tatra pitarau hi vyavasthitau ..
prekṣamāṇau sutāyāstāṃ pūjāṃ janavinirmitām ..
manyamānau tadātmānamadhikaṃ sarva dehinām .. 45 ..
5.187.d:
ततस्तौ हर्षितौ तत्र पितरौ हि व्यवस्थितौ ..
प्रेक्षमाणौ सुतायास्तां पूजां जनविनिर्मिताम् ..
मन्यमानौ तदात्मानमधिकं सर्व देहिनाम् .. 45 ..
5.187.m: Then the two joyful parents remained there, / gazing upon that worship offered by the people to their daughter, / considering themselves then superior to all embodied beings.

5.187.s:
tasya ye svajanāḥ kecitsarve te'pi dvijottamāḥ ..
śaṃsamānā sutāṃ tāṃ tu tatsamīpaṃ vyavasthitāḥ .. 46 ..
5.187.d:
तस्य ये स्वजनाः केचित्सर्वे तेऽपि द्विजोत्तमाः ..
शंसमाना सुतां तां तु तत्समीपं व्यवस्थिताः .. 46 ..
5.187.m: Whatever kinsmen he had, all of them too, O best of the twice-born, / praising that daughter, stood near her.

5.187.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāpto bhṛguryatra pitāmahaḥ ..
niṣkramya sadasastasmātkṛtāñjaliruvāca tam .. 47 ..
5.187.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्तो भृगुर्यत्र पितामहः ..
निष्क्रम्य सदसस्तस्मात्कृताञ्जलिरुवाच तम् .. 47 ..
5.187.m: In the meantime, Bhṛgu arrived where the Grandfather [Brahmā] was. / Coming forth from that assembly, he said to him with folded hands:

5.187.s:
udgātrā deva cātmīyo mārgaḥ śrutivivarjitaḥ ..
vihitaḥ kanyakāṃ dhṛtvā sadomadhye sureśvara .. 48 ..
5.187.d:
उद्गात्रा देव चात्मीयो मार्गः श्रुतिविवर्जितः ..
विहितः कन्यकां धृत्वा सदोमध्ये सुरेश्वर .. 48 ..
5.187.m: "O lord, by the Udgātṛ his own path, devoid of the Veda, / has been established by setting a girl in the midst of the assembly, O lord of gods!

5.187.s:
devatvaṃ jalpitaṃ tasyā nāgaryāḥ surasaṃnidhau ..
somapānaṃ tathā kurmo vayaṃ tatra tayā saha .. 49 ..
tato vidhistamānīya papraccha dvijasattamāḥ..
kā'sau kanyā kimarthaṃ ca sadomadhye dhṛtā tvayā..6.188.5...
5.187.d:
देवत्वं जल्पितं तस्या नागर्याः सुरसंनिधौ ..
सोमपानं तथा कुर्मो वयं तत्र तया सह .. 49 ..
ततो विधिस्तमानीय पप्रच्छ द्विजसत्तमाः..
काऽसौ कन्या किमर्थं च सदोमध्ये धृता त्वया..6.188.5...
5.187.m:
Divinity was proclaimed of that Nāgara woman in the presence of the gods. / How can we drink the Soma there together with her?"
Then Brahmā summoned him and asked, O best of the twice-born: / "Who is that maiden, and for what purpose was she placed in the midst of the assembly by you?"

5.187.s:
so'bravīcchāpabhraṣṭeyaṃ gandharvī brāhmaṇālaye ..
avatīrṇā vidheryajñe muktirasyāḥ prakīrtitā ..51..
5.187.d:
सोऽब्रवीच्छापभ्रष्टेयं गन्धर्वी ब्राह्मणालये ..
अवतीर्णा विधेर्यज्ञे मुक्तिरस्याः प्रकीर्तिता ..51..
5.187.m: He said: "She is a Gandharva woman fallen by a curse, / descended into a brāhmaṇa's house; her liberation was foretold at Brahmā's sacrifice.

5.187.s:
nāradena purā deva kopena ca tathā mudā ..
tasyā deva varo datto mayā tuṣṭena sāṃpratam .. 52 ..
5.187.d:
नारदेन पुरा देव कोपेन च तथा मुदा ..
तस्या देव वरो दत्तो मया तुष्टेन सांप्रतम् .. 52 ..
5.187.m: Formerly, O lord, [it was declared] by Nārada in anger, and likewise with joy. / A boon was given to her by me now, being pleased, O lord:

5.187.s:
śaṃkupracāraṃ no bāhyaṃ tava saṃpatsyate kvacit ..
devaiḥ sarvaiḥ samānītā pratiṣṭhāṃ prapitāmaha .. 53 ..
5.187.d:
शंकुप्रचारं नो बाह्यं तव संपत्स्यते क्वचित् ..
देवैः सर्वैः समानीता प्रतिष्ठां प्रपितामह .. 53 ..
5.187.m: 'Your peg-laying shall not be carried out outside anywhere.' / She was brought to consecration by all the gods, O great-grandfather!"

5.187.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāptāḥ kailāsācca dvijottamāḥ ..
śrutvā cauduṃbarījātaṃ māhātmyaṃ dharaṇītale .. 54 ..
5.187.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्ताः कैलासाच्च द्विजोत्तमाः ..
श्रुत्वा चौदुंबरीजातं माहात्म्यं धरणीतले .. 54 ..
5.187.m: In the meantime, there arrived from Kailāsa, O best of the twice-born, / having heard of the māhātmya born of the audumbarī post on the surface of the earth,

5.187.s:
yajñe paitāmahe caiva hāṭakeśvarasaṃbhave ..
kṣetre puṇyatame tatra pūjārthaṃ dvijasattamāḥ ..55..
5.187.d:
यज्ञे पैतामहे चैव हाटकेश्वरसंभवे ..
क्षेत्रे पुण्यतमे तत्र पूजार्थं द्विजसत्तमाः ..55..
5.187.m: at the sacrifice of the Grandfather born in Hāṭakeśvara, / in that most sacred kṣetra, for the sake of worship, O best of the twice-born:

5.187.s:
hṛṣṭā mātṛgaṇā ye ca aṣṭaṣaṣṭipramāṇataḥ ..
pūjyaṃte ye ca gandharvaiḥ siddhaiḥ sādhyairmarudgaṇaiḥ .. 56 ..
5.187.d:
हृष्टा मातृगणा ये च अष्टषष्टिप्रमाणतः ..
पूज्यंते ये च गन्धर्वैः सिद्धैः साध्यैर्मरुद्गणैः .. 56 ..
5.187.m: the delighted host of Mothers, sixty-eight in number, / who are worshipped by Gandharvas, Siddhas, Sādhyas, and the hosts of Maruts.

5.187.s:
pṛthakpṛthagvidhai rūpairlokavismayakārakaiḥ ..
nṛtyaṃtyaśca hasaṃtyaśca gāyaṃtyaśca tathāparāḥ .. .. 57 ..
5.187.d:
पृथक्पृथग्विधै रूपैर्लोकविस्मयकारकैः ..
नृत्यंत्यश्च हसंत्यश्च गायंत्यश्च तथापराः .. .. 57 ..
5.187.m: With diverse forms causing wonder to the worlds, / some dancing, some laughing, and others singing,

5.187.s:
tāsāṃ kolāhalaṃ śrutvā brahmaviṣṇupuraḥsarāḥ ..
vismayaṃ paramaṃ prāptāḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ .. 58 ..
5.187.d:
तासां कोलाहलं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मविष्णुपुरःसराः ..
विस्मयं परमं प्राप्ताः सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः .. 58 ..
5.187.m: hearing their clamor, all the gods headed by Brahmā and Viṣṇu, / together with Indra, were filled with supreme amazement.

5.187.s:
kimetaditi jalpaṃtaḥ protthitā yajñamaṃḍapāt ..
etasminnaṃtare prāptāḥ sarvāstā yatra padmajaḥ .. 59 ..
5.187.d:
किमेतदिति जल्पंतः प्रोत्थिता यज्ञमंडपात् ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्ताः सर्वास्ता यत्र पद्मजः .. 59 ..
5.187.m: Saying, "What is this?", they arose from the sacrificial pavilion. / In the meantime, all of them arrived where the Lotus-Born [Brahmā] was.

5.187.s:
praṇamya śirasā hṛṣṭāstataḥ procustu sādaram ..
vayamevaṃ samāyātāḥ śrutvā te yajñamuttamam .. 6.188.60 ..
5.187.d:
प्रणम्य शिरसा हृष्टास्ततः प्रोचुस्तु सादरम् ..
वयमेवं समायाताः श्रुत्वा ते यज्ञमुत्तमम् .. 6.188.60 ..
5.187.m: Having bowed with their heads, delighted, they then spoke respectfully: / "We have come thus, having heard of your excellent sacrifice,

5.187.s:
āmaṃtritāśca deveśa vāyunā jagadāyunā ..
yajñabhāgā na cāsmākaṃ vidyaṃte yajñakarmaṇi .. 61 ..
5.187.d:
आमंत्रिताश्च देवेश वायुना जगदायुना ..
यज्ञभागा न चास्माकं विद्यंते यज्ञकर्मणि .. 61 ..
5.187.m: and invited, O lord of gods, by Vāyu, the life of the universe. / Yet we have no sacrificial shares in the sacrificial rite;

5.187.s:
etānyeva dinānīha nāyātāstena padmaja ..
auduṃbarīṃ vayaṃ śrutvā hyapūrvāṃ tena saṃgatāḥ .. 62 ..
5.187.d:
एतान्येव दिनानीह नायातास्तेन पद्मज ..
औदुंबरीं वयं श्रुत्वा ह्यपूर्वां तेन संगताः .. 62 ..
5.187.m: for all these days, we did not come here because of that, O Lotus-Born. / Having heard of the extraordinary audumbarī post, we have therefore come.

5.187.s:
sā dṛṣṭvā pūjitā'smābhiḥ praṇipātapuraḥsaram...
parvatasya sutā yasmādgandharvasya mahātmanaḥ .. 63 ..
5.187.d:
सा दृष्ट्वा पूजिताऽस्माभिः प्रणिपातपुरःसरम्...
पर्वतस्य सुता यस्माद्गन्धर्वस्य महात्मनः .. 63 ..
5.187.m: She, having been seen, has been worshipped by us with prostrations, / because she is the daughter of the high-souled Gandharva Parvata,

5.187.s:
sarvakāmapradā strīṇāṃ sarvadevaiḥ pratiṣṭhitā ..
sthānaṃ darśaya cāsmākaṃ tvaṃ deva prapitāmaha .. 64 ..
5.187.d:
सर्वकामप्रदा स्त्रीणां सर्वदेवैः प्रतिष्ठिता ..
स्थानं दर्शय चास्माकं त्वं देव प्रपितामह .. 64 ..
5.187.m: granting all desires to women, consecrated by all the gods. / Show us our dwelling place, O god, Great-Grandfather!

5.187.s:
aṣṭaṣaṣṭipramāṇaśca gaṇo'smākaṃ vyavasthitaḥ ..
tacchrutvā padmajo jñātvā saṃkīrṇaṃ yatamaṃḍapam ..
vyāptaṃ devagaṇaiḥ sarvaistrayastriṃśatpramāṇakaiḥ .. 65 ..
5.187.d:
अष्टषष्टिप्रमाणश्च गणोऽस्माकं व्यवस्थितः ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा पद्मजो ज्ञात्वा संकीर्णं यतमंडपम् ..
व्याप्तं देवगणैः सर्वैस्त्रयस्त्रिंशत्प्रमाणकैः .. 65 ..
5.187.m: And our host consists of sixty-eight [Mothers]." / Having heard that, the Lotus-Born, knowing the sacrificial pavilion to be crowded,

5.187.s:
tato madhyagamāhūya sa tadā nagarodbhavam ..
śrutādhyayanasaṃpannaṃ vṛhaspatimivāparam ..
abravīcchlakṣṇayā vācā tyaktā maunaṃ pitāmahaḥ .. 66 ..
5.187.d:
ततो मध्यगमाहूय स तदा नगरोद्भवम् ..
श्रुताध्ययनसंपन्नं वृहस्पतिमिवापरम् ..
अब्रवीच्छ्लक्ष्णया वाचा त्यक्ता मौनं पितामहः .. 66 ..
5.187.m: filled with all the hosts of gods, thirty-three in number, / then called a resident of the city standing in their midst, / endowed with sacred learning and study, like another Bṛhaspati, / breaking his silence, the Grandfather spoke in gentle words:

5.187.s:
tvaṃ gatvā mama vākyena viprānnāgarasaṃbhavān ..
prabrūhi gotramukhyāṃśca hyaṣṭaṣaṣṭipramāṇataḥ .. 67 ..
5.187.d:
त्वं गत्वा मम वाक्येन विप्रान्नागरसंभवान् ..
प्रब्रूहि गोत्रमुख्यांश्च ह्यष्टषष्टिप्रमाणतः .. 67 ..
5.187.m: "Go at my command, and speak to the vipras born of the Nāgara [lineage], / the chiefs of the sixty-eight gotras:

5.187.s:
ete mātṛgaṇāḥ prāptā aṣṭaṣaṣṭipramāṇakāḥ ..
ekaika gotramukhyāśca ekaikasya pramāṇataḥ .. 68 ..
5.187.d:
एते मातृगणाः प्राप्ता अष्टषष्टिप्रमाणकाः ..
एकैक गोत्रमुख्याश्च एकैकस्य प्रमाणतः .. 68 ..
5.187.m: 'These hosts of Mothers have arrived, sixty-eight in number. / One chief of each gotra, in proportion to each one,

5.187.s:
svesve bhūmivibhāge ca sthānaṃ yacchatu sāṃpratam ..
etatsāhāyyakaṃ kāryaṃ bhavadbhirmama nāgarāḥ ..
prasādaṃ pracuraṃ kṛtvā yena tuṣṭiṃ prayāṃti ca .. 69 ..
5.187.d:
स्वेस्वे भूमिविभागे च स्थानं यच्छतु सांप्रतम् ..
एतत्साहाय्यकं कार्यं भवद्भिर्मम नागराः ..
प्रसादं प्रचुरं कृत्वा येन तुष्टिं प्रयांति च .. 69 ..
5.187.m: must now grant a place in their respective divisions of land. / This assistance must be rendered to me by you, O Nāgaras, / showing abundant favor, so that they may attain satisfaction.'"

5.187.s:
tataḥ sa satvaraṃ gatvā tānsamāhūya nāgarān..
provāca vinayopetaḥ praṇipatya tataḥ param .. 6.188.70 ..
5.187.d:
ततः स सत्वरं गत्वा तान्समाहूय नागरान्..
प्रोवाच विनयोपेतः प्रणिपत्य ततः परम् .. 6.188.70 ..
5.187.m: Then, having gone quickly and assembled those Nāgaras, / he, endowed with modesty, spoke after bowing down to them.

5.187.s:
tacchrutvā nāgarāḥ sarve saṃtoṣaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ..
ekaikasya gaṇasyaiva daduḥ sthānaṃ nijaṃ tadā..71..
5.187.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा नागराः सर्वे संतोषं परमं गताः..
एकैकस्य गणस्यैव ददुः स्थानं निजं तदा..71..
5.187.m: Having heard that, all the Nāgaras attained supreme satisfaction. / They then gave their own place to each single host.

5.187.s:
tatastāḥ mātaraḥ sarvāḥ praṇipatya pitāmaham..
tadanantaramevātha gāyatrīṃ bhaktipūrvakam..72..
5.187.d:
ततस्ताः मातरः सर्वाः प्रणिपत्य पितामहम्..
तदनन्तरमेवाथ गायत्रीं भक्तिपूर्वकम्..72..
5.187.m: Then all those Mothers, having bowed to the Grandfather, / immediately thereafter [bowed] to Gāyatrī with devotion.

5.187.s:
viprasaṃsūcite sthāne sarvāścaiva vyavasthitāḥ..
pūjitāstarpitāścaiva balibhirvividhairapi..73..
5.187.d:
विप्रसंसूचिते स्थाने सर्वाश्चैव व्यवस्थिताः..
पूजितास्तर्पिताश्चैव बलिभिर्विविधैरपि..73..
5.187.m: And all of them settled in the place designated by the brahmins, / worshipped and propitiated with various kinds of offerings.

5.187.s:
tato gāyanti tā hṛṣṭā nṛtyaṃti ca hasaṃti ca..
tarpitā brāhmaṇendraiśca procuśca tadanantaram..74..
5.187.d:
ततो गायन्ति ता हृष्टा नृत्यंति च हसंति च..
तर्पिता ब्राह्मणेन्द्रैश्च प्रोचुश्च तदनन्तरम्..74..
5.187.m: Then, delighted, they sang, danced, and laughed. / Propitiated by the best of brahmins, they then said:

5.187.s:
na yāsyāmo paraṃ sthānaṃ sthāsyāmotraiva sarvadā..
īdṛśā yatra viprendrāḥ sarve bhaktisamanvitāḥ..75..
5.187.d:
न यास्यामो परं स्थानं स्थास्यामोत्रैव सर्वदा..
ईदृशा यत्र विप्रेन्द्राः सर्वे भक्तिसमन्विताः..75..
5.187.m: "We will not go to another place; we will stay right here forever, / where all the best brahmins are endowed with such devotion,

5.187.s:
īdṛśaṃ ca mahākṣetraṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃbhavam..
etasminneva kāle tu sāvitrī tatra saṃsthitā..76..
5.187.d:
ईदृशं च महाक्षेत्रं हाटकेश्वरसंभवम्..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु सावित्री तत्र संस्थिता..76..
5.187.m: and where there is such a great sacred field, originating from Hāṭakeśvara." / At that very time, Sāvitrī was residing there.

5.187.s:
praṇipatya dvijaiḥ sarvairgacchamānā nivāritā..
mā devayajanaṃ gaccha sāvitri pativallabhe..77..
5.187.d:
प्रणिपत्य द्विजैः सर्वैर्गच्छमाना निवारिता..
मा देवयजनं गच्छ सावित्रि पतिवल्लभे..77..
5.187.m: As she was going, she was bowed down to and stopped by all the twice-born: / "Do not go to the sacrificial ground of the gods, O Sāvitrī, dear to your husband!

5.187.s: brahmaṇā pariṇītāsti gāyatrīti varāṃganā..78..
5.187.d: ब्रह्मणा परिणीतास्ति गायत्रीति वरांगना..78..
5.187.m: Brahmā has married an excellent woman named Gāyatrī."

5.187.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ sāvitrī bhrāṃtalocanā..
duḥkhaśokasamopetā bāṣpavyākulalocanā..79..
5.187.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तेषां सावित्री भ्रांतलोचना..
दुःखशोकसमोपेता बाष्पव्याकुललोचना..79..
5.187.m: Hearing their words, Sāvitrī, her eyes rolling, / filled with sorrow and grief, her eyes troubled with tears,

5.187.s:
dṛṣṭvā tā nṛtyamānāśca gāyamānāstathaiva ca..
utkūrdatīrdharāpṛṣṭhe saṃtoṣaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ..6.188.80..
5.187.d:
दृष्ट्वा ता नृत्यमानाश्च गायमानास्तथैव च..
उत्कूर्दतीर्धरापृष्ठे संतोषं परमं गताः..6.188.80..
5.187.m: seeing them dancing and singing as well, / leaping on the surface of the earth, having attained the highest joy,

5.187.s:
śaśāpātha ca sāvitrī bāṣpagadgadayā girā.
sapatnyā mama yatpūjāṃ kṛtvā vai susamāgatāḥ..81..
5.187.d:
शशापाथ च सावित्री बाष्पगद्गदया गिरा.
सपत्न्या मम यत्पूजां कृत्वा वै सुसमागताः..81..
5.187.m: Sāvitrī then cursed [them] with a voice choked with tears: / "Since you have arrived after worshipping my co-wife,

5.187.s:
na praṇāmaḥ kṛto'smākaṃ mama duḥkhena duḥkhitāḥ ..
tasmānnaivāparaṃ sthānaṃ gamiṣyatha kathaṃcana .. 82 ..
5.187.d:
न प्रणामः कृतोऽस्माकं मम दुःखेन दुःखिताः ..
तस्मान्नैवापरं स्थानं गमिष्यथ कथंचन .. 82 ..
5.187.m: and have made no obeisance to us, distressed by my sorrow, / therefore you shall never go to any other place!

5.187.s:
nāgarāṇāṃ ca no pūjā kadācitprabhaviṣyati ..
na prāsādo'tha yuṣmākaṃ kadācitsaṃbhaviṣyati .. 83 ..
5.187.d:
नागराणां च नो पूजा कदाचित्प्रभविष्यति ..
न प्रासादोऽथ युष्माकं कदाचित्संभविष्यति .. 83 ..
5.187.m: And worship of you by the Nāgaras shall never happen; / nor shall a temple ever come to exist for you.

5.187.s:
śītakāle tu śītena hyuṣṇakāle ca raśmibhiḥ ..
varṣākāle tu toyena kleśaṃ yāsya tha bhūriśaḥ ..84..
5.187.d:
शीतकाले तु शीतेन ह्युष्णकाले च रश्मिभिः ..
वर्षाकाले तु तोयेन क्लेशं यास्य थ भूरिशः ..84..
5.187.m: In the cold season, by cold, and in the hot season, by the [sun's] rays, / and in the rainy season, by the water, you will suffer intense distress!"

5.187.s:
evamuktvā tato devī sā tatraiva vyavasthitā ..
nāgarāṇāṃ varastrībhiḥ sarvābhiḥ parivāritā .. 85 ..
5.187.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततो देवी सा तत्रैव व्यवस्थिता ..
नागराणां वरस्त्रीभिः सर्वाभिः परिवारिता .. 85 ..
5.187.m: Having spoken thus, the goddess then remained right there, / surrounded by all the excellent women of the Nāgaras,

5.187.s:
saṃbodhyamānā satataṃ sustrīṇāṃ ceṣṭitena ca ..
etasminneva kāle tu bhagavāṃstīkṣṇadīdhitiḥ .. 86 ..
5.187.d:
संबोध्यमाना सततं सुस्त्रीणां चेष्टितेन च ..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु भगवांस्तीक्ष्णदीधितिः .. 86 ..
5.187.m: constantly being consoled by the conduct of the virtuous women. / At that very time, the blessed sharp-rayed [sun]

5.187.s:
astaṃ gato mahāñchabdaḥ prasthito yajñamaṃḍape ..
yājñikānāṃ tu viprāṇāṃ sumahāñchāstrasaṃbhavaḥ .. 87 ..
5.187.d:
अस्तं गतो महाञ्छब्दः प्रस्थितो यज्ञमंडपे ..
याज्ञिकानां तु विप्राणां सुमहाञ्छास्त्रसंभवः .. 87 ..
5.187.m: set, and a great sound arose in the sacrificial pavilion— / the great [sound] of the officiating brahmins, produced by the sacred scriptures.

5.187.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye mātṛgaṇagamanasāvitrīdatta mātṛgaṇaśāpavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..188..
5.187.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये मातृगणगमनसावित्रीदत्त मातृगणशापवर्णनंनामाष्टाशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..188..
5.187.m: Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-eighth chapter, named 'Description of the Departure of the Group of Mothers and the Curse Bestowed on the Group of Mothers by Sāvitrī', in the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvara Kṣetra, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [book] in the venerable Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses. 188.

5.188.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
atha yāvacca tāḥ śaptā mātaro dvijasattamāḥ ..
sāvitryā tāstu gaṃdharvyaḥ prāptāḥ sā yatra tiṣṭhati .. 1 ..
5.188.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अथ यावच्च ताः शप्ता मातरो द्विजसत्तमाः ..
सावित्र्या तास्तु गंधर्व्यः प्राप्ताः सा यत्र तिष्ठति .. 1 ..
5.188.m: Sūta said: / Now, as soon as those Mothers were cursed, O best of the twice-born, / those Gandharva women came to where she was staying.

5.188.s:
tataḥ praṇamya tā ūcuḥ sarvā dīnataraṃ vacaḥ ..
vayaṃ samāgatā devi sarvāstava makhe yataḥ.. 2 ..
5.188.d:
ततः प्रणम्य ता ऊचुः सर्वा दीनतरं वचः ..
वयं समागता देवि सर्वास्तव मखे यतः.. 2 ..
5.188.m: Then, bowing down, they all spoke in words most humble: / "O goddess, since we all arrived at your sacrifice,

5.188.s:
yajñabhāgaṃ labhiṣyāma auduṃbaryāḥ prasādataḥ ..
na cāsmābhiḥ parijñātā sāvitrī cātra tiṣṭhati .. 3 ..
5.188.d:
यज्ञभागं लभिष्याम औदुंबर्याः प्रसादतः ..
न चास्माभिः परिज्ञाता सावित्री चात्र तिष्ठति .. 3 ..
5.188.m: we were to obtain a share of the sacrifice by the grace of Audumbarī; / and we did not know that Sāvitrī was staying here,

5.188.s:
daurbhāgyadoṣasaṃpannā nāgarībhiḥ samāvṛtā ..
asmākaṃ sukhamārgo'yaṃ nṛtyagītasamudbhavaḥ .. 4 ..
5.188.d:
दौर्भाग्यदोषसंपन्ना नागरीभिः समावृता ..
अस्माकं सुखमार्गोऽयं नृत्यगीतसमुद्भवः .. 4 ..
5.188.m: beset by the fault of ill fortune and surrounded by Nāgara women. / Our path to happiness arises from dance and song;

5.188.s:
tatkurvāṇāstato rātrau śaptā gāṃdharvasattame ..
strīṇāṃ duḥkhena duḥkhārtā jāyaṃte sarvayoṣitaḥ ..5..
5.188.d:
तत्कुर्वाणास्ततो रात्रौ शप्ता गांधर्वसत्तमे ..
स्त्रीणां दुःखेन दुःखार्ता जायंते सर्वयोषितः ..5..
5.188.m: doing that there at night, we were cursed, O best of Gandharva women: / 'All women are pained by the sorrow of [other] women;

5.188.s:
yūyamānaṃditāḥ sarvāḥ sapatnyā mama cotsave ..
tāṃ praṇamya prapūjyādya nāhaṃ saṃbhāṣitāpi ca .. 6 ..
5.188.d:
यूयमानंदिताः सर्वाः सपत्न्या मम चोत्सवे ..
तां प्रणम्य प्रपूज्याद्य नाहं संभाषितापि च .. 6 ..
5.188.m: you were all rejoicing at the festival of my co-wife. / Today, having bowed to her and worshipped her, you did not even speak to me,

5.188.s:
viśeṣānnṛtyagītaṃ ca prārabdhaṃ mama cāgrataḥ..
tasmādvyomagati rnaiva bhavatīnāṃ bhaviṣyati .. 7 ..
5.188.d:
विशेषान्नृत्यगीतं च प्रारब्धं मम चाग्रतः..
तस्माद्व्योमगति र्नैव भवतीनां भविष्यति .. 7 ..
5.188.m: and especially, singing and dancing was begun right before me. / Therefore, you will not have any movement through the sky!

5.188.s:
asminsthāne sadā dīnāstathā''śrayavivarjitāḥ ..
saṃtiṣṭhadhvaṃ na vaḥ pūjāṃ kariṣyaṃti ca mānavāḥ .. 8 ..
5.188.d:
अस्मिन्स्थाने सदा दीनास्तथा'ऽश्रयविवर्जिताः ..
संतिष्ठध्वं न वः पूजां करिष्यंति च मानवाः .. 8 ..
5.188.m: Remain in this place forever, destitute and deprived of shelter; / and humans will not perform worship for you,'

5.188.s:
dīnānāmasamarthānāṃ yātrākṛtyeṣu sarvadā ..
tasyāstadvacanaṃ devi nānyathā saṃbhaviṣyati .. 9 ..
5.188.d:
दीनानामसमर्थानां यात्राकृत्येषु सर्वदा ..
तस्यास्तद्वचनं देवि नान्यथा संभविष्यति .. 9 ..
5.188.m: for those who are miserable and helpless in rites of pilgrimage at all times. / Her word, O goddess, will not turn out otherwise.

5.188.s:
audumbaryāḥ pūjanāya gatvā tasyai nivedyatām ..
sā hi vyapanayedduḥkhaṃ dhruvaṃ sā hi prakāmadā .. 6.189.10 ..
5.188.d:
औदुम्बर्याः पूजनाय गत्वा तस्यै निवेद्यताम् ..
सा हि व्यपनयेद्दुःखं ध्रुवं सा हि प्रकामदा .. 6.189.10 ..
5.188.m: Having gone to worship Audumbarī, let it be made known to her; / for she will surely take away the sorrow, as she grants all desires."

5.188.s: tenā'tra sahasā prāptā yāvannaṣṭamanorathāḥ .. 11 ..
5.188.d: तेनाऽत्र सहसा प्राप्ता यावन्नष्टमनोरथाः .. 11 ..
5.188.m: "Therefore, [we] have quickly arrived here, as our desires have been ruined.

5.188.s:
tasmātkuruṣva kalyāṇi yathāsmākaṃ gatirbhavet ..
māhātmyaṃ tava varddheta trailokye'pi carācare .. 12 ..
5.188.d:
तस्मात्कुरुष्व कल्याणि यथास्माकं गतिर्भवेत् ..
माहात्म्यं तव वर्द्धेत त्रैलोक्येऽपि चराचरे .. 12 ..
5.188.m: Therefore, O auspicious one, act in such a way that there may be a refuge for us, / and your greatness will increase even in the three worlds of moving and unmoving beings."

5.188.s:
.. audumbaryuvāca .. ..
kā śaktirvidyate'smākaṃ kṛtaṃ sāvitrisaṃbhavam ..
anyathā kartumevādya sarvairapi surāsuraiḥ .. 13 ..
5.188.d:
.. औदुम्बर्युवाच .. ..
का शक्तिर्विद्यतेऽस्माकं कृतं सावित्रिसंभवम् ..
अन्यथा कर्तुमेवाद्य सर्वैरपि सुरासुरैः .. 13 ..
5.188.m: Audumbarī said: / "What power do we have, or indeed do all the gods and demons have today, / to make what was done by Sāvitrī otherwise?

5.188.s:
tathāpi śaktito devyo yatiṣyāmi hitāya vaḥ ..
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṣu gotreṣu bhavatyaḥ saṃniyojitāḥ .. 14 ..
5.188.d:
तथापि शक्तितो देव्यो यतिष्यामि हिताय वः ..
अष्टषष्टिषु गोत्रेषु भवत्यः संनियोजिताः .. 14 ..
5.188.m: Nevertheless, according to my ability, O goddesses, I will strive for your benefit. / You have been assigned among the sixty-eight clans

5.188.s:
pitāmahena tuṣṭena tatra pūjāmavāpsyatha ..
yūyaṃ rātrau ca saṃjñābhirhāsyapūrvābhireva ca ..15..
5.188.d:
पितामहेन तुष्टेन तत्र पूजामवाप्स्यथ ..
यूयं रात्रौ च संज्ञाभिर्हास्यपूर्वाभिरेव च ..15..
5.188.m: by the pleased Grandfather; there you will receive worship / at night, by names preceded by laughter.

5.188.s:
adyaprabhṛti yasyātra nāgarasya tu maṃdire ..
vṛddhiḥ saṃpatsyate kācidvi śeṣānmaṃḍapodbhavā .. 16 ..
5.188.d:
अद्यप्रभृति यस्यात्र नागरस्य तु मंदिरे ..
वृद्धिः संपत्स्यते काचिद्वि शेषान्मंडपोद्भवा .. 16 ..
5.188.m: From this day forth, in the house of whichever Nāgara here / an increase of prosperity shall take place, especially arising from a pavilion,

5.188.s:
tathā yā yoṣitaḥ kāścitpuradvāraṃ sametya ca ..
adṛṣṭahāsyamādhyāya kṣapiṣyaṃti baliṃ tataḥ .. 17 ..
5.188.d:
तथा या योषितः काश्चित्पुरद्वारं समेत्य च ..
अदृष्टहास्यमाध्याय क्षपिष्यंति बलिं ततः .. 17 ..
5.188.m: and likewise whatever women, having approached the city gate, / meditate upon unseen laughter and then cast an offering,

5.188.s:
tena vo bhavitā tṛptirdevānāṃ ca yathā makhaiḥ ..
yāḥ punarna kariṣyaṃti pūjāmetāṃ mayoditām .. 18 ..
5.188.d:
तेन वो भविता तृप्तिर्देवानां च यथा मखैः ..
याः पुनर्न करिष्यंति पूजामेतां मयोदिताम् .. 18 ..
5.188.m: by that your satisfaction shall occur, just as that of the gods through sacrifices. / Moreover, those [women] in the city who will not perform this worship told by me,

5.188.s:
yuṣmākaṃ nagare tāsāṃ suputro nāśamāpsyati ..
yuṣmākamapamāne na sadā rogī bhaviṣyati .. 19 ..
5.188.d:
युष्माकं नगरे तासां सुपुत्रो नाशमाप्स्यति ..
युष्माकमपमाने न सदा रोगी भविष्यति .. 19 ..
5.188.m: their good son will meet with ruin; / through the disrespect shown to you, he will always be diseased.

5.188.s:
tasmāttiṣṭhadhvamatraiva rakṣārthaṃ nagarasya ca ..
śāpavyājena yuṣmākaṃ varo'yaṃ samupasthitaḥ .. 6.189.20 ..
5.188.d:
तस्मात्तिष्ठध्वमत्रैव रक्षार्थं नगरस्य च ..
शापव्याजेन युष्माकं वरोऽयं समुपस्थितः .. 6.189.20 ..
5.188.m: Therefore, remain right here for the protection of the city; / under the pretext of a curse, this boon has arrived for you."

5.188.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāpto devaśarmā dvijottamāḥ ..
gaṃdharvaḥ parvato jātaḥ svapatnyā sahitastadā .. 21 ..
5.188.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्तो देवशर्मा द्विजोत्तमाः ..
गंधर्वः पर्वतो जातः स्वपत्न्या सहितस्तदा .. 21 ..
5.188.m: In the meantime, O best of the twice-born, Devaśarman arrived, / the Gandharva Parvata born along with his wife at that time.

5.188.s:
yadā caudumbarī śaptā nāradena surarṣiṇā ..
mānuṣī bhava kruddhena tadā saṃprārthitastayā..22..
5.188.d:
यदा चौदुम्बरी शप्ता नारदेन सुरर्षिणा ..
मानुषी भव क्रुद्धेन तदा संप्रार्थितस्तया..22..
5.188.m: When Audumbarī was cursed by the divine seer Nārada, / who was angry—'Become a human woman!'—then he was implored by her:

5.188.s:
madarthaṃ mānuṣo bhūtvā tatā tvaṃ cānayā saha..
sṛja māṃ mānuṣīṃ ceva yena gacchāmi no bhuvi..23..
5.188.d:
मदर्थं मानुषो भूत्वा तता त्वं चानया सह..
सृज मां मानुषीं चेव येन गच्छामि नो भुवि..23..
5.188.m: "Becoming a human for my sake, O father, you with her / produce me as a human, so that on earth I may not enter

5.188.s:
viṇmūtrasaṃyute garbhe sarvadoṣasamanvite..
tataḥ sā kṛpayā tasyāḥ satpatnyā devaśarmaṇaḥ..24..
5.188.d:
विण्मूत्रसंयुते गर्भे सर्वदोषसमन्विते..
ततः सा कृपया तस्याः सत्पत्न्या देवशर्मणः..24..
5.188.m: a womb filled with feces and urine, endowed with all faults." / Then, out of compassion for her, [born] of that virtuous wife of Devaśarman,

5.188.s:
avatīrṇā dharāpṛṣṭhe vānaprasthāśrame tataḥ..
evaṃ sā pañcamī rātristasya yajñasya sattamāḥ..25..
5.188.d:
अवतीर्णा धरापृष्ठे वानप्रस्थाश्रमे ततः..
एवं सा पञ्चमी रात्रिस्तस्य यज्ञस्य सत्तमाः..25..
5.188.m: she descended upon the surface of the earth in the hermitage of forest-dwellers. / In this way, that fifth night of that sacrifice, O best of men,

5.188.s:
utsavena manojñena caudumbaryā vyatikramāt..
pratyūṣe ca tato jāte yadā tena visarjitā..26..
5.188.d:
उत्सवेन मनोज्ञेन चौदुम्बर्या व्यतिक्रमात्..
प्रत्यूषे च ततो जाते यदा तेन विसर्जिता..26..
5.188.m: passed with a delightful festival and with Audumbarī. / And then, when dawn arrived, when she was dismissed by him,

5.188.s:
audumbarī tadā prāha parvataṃ janakaṃ nijam..
kalye'trāvabhṛtho bhāvī vidhiyajñasamudbhavaḥ..27..
5.188.d:
औदुम्बरी तदा प्राह पर्वतं जनकं निजम्..
कल्येऽत्रावभृथो भावी विधियज्ञसमुद्भवः..27..
5.188.m: Audumbarī then said to her father, Parvata: / "Tomorrow here will be the concluding ablution arising from Brahmā's sacrifice,

5.188.s:
sarvatīrthamayastasminsnānaṃ na syāttataḥ param..
yāsyāmaḥ svagṛhānbhūyaḥ sarvairdevaiḥ samanvitāḥ..28..
5.188.d:
सर्वतीर्थमयस्तस्मिन्स्नानं न स्यात्ततः परम्..
यास्यामः स्वगृहान्भूयः सर्वैर्देवैः समन्विताः..28..
5.188.m: consisting of all sacred fords; there could be no bath superior to that. / We will go back to our homes accompanied by all the gods."

5.188.s:
anenaiva vimānena trayo vāpi yathāsukham..
mamāpi ca varo jāto yaḥ śāpānnāradodbhavāt..
yajñabhāgo mayā prāpto devānāmapi durlabhaḥ..
paurṇamāsīdine prāpte viśeṣātstrījanaiḥ kṛtaḥ..6.189.30..
5.188.d:
अनेनैव विमानेन त्रयो वापि यथासुखम्..
ममापि च वरो जातो यः शापान्नारदोद्भवात्..
यज्ञभागो मया प्राप्तो देवानामपि दुर्लभः..
पौर्णमासीदिने प्राप्ते विशेषात्स्त्रीजनैः कृतः..6.189.30..
5.188.m: In this very aerial chariot, all three [of us], at our pleasure. / A boon has also been granted to me, arising from the curse caused by Nārada: / I have obtained a share in sacrifices, hard to win even for the gods, / offered especially by women when the day of the full moon arrives.

5.188.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmya auduṃbaryutpattipūrvakatatprāgjanmavṛttāṃtavarṇanaṃnāmaikonanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ..189..
5.188.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य औदुंबर्युत्पत्तिपूर्वकतत्प्राग्जन्मवृत्तांतवर्णनंनामैकोननवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः..189..
5.188.m: Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-ninth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Previous Life Preceding the Origin of Audumbarī," in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the auspicious Skandapurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.189.s:
sūta uvāca..
evaṃ kratuḥ sa saṃjātaḥ pañcarātraṃ dvijottamāḥ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre sarvakāma samṛddhimān..1..
5.189.d:
सूत उवाच..
एवं क्रतुः स संजातः पञ्चरात्रं द्विजोत्तमाः..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे सर्वकाम समृद्धिमान्..1..
5.189.m: Sūta said: / Thus that sacrifice took place for five nights, O best of the twice-born, / in the sacred field born of Hāṭakeśvara, abounding in all desires.

5.189.s:
viprāṃśca bhikṣukāṃścaiva dīnāṃdhāṃśca viśeṣataḥ..
samāptau tasya yajñasya saṃtarpya sakalāṃstataḥ..
ṛtvijo dakṣiṇābhistānyathoktāndvijasattamān..2..
5.189.d:
विप्रांश्च भिक्षुकांश्चैव दीनांधांश्च विशेषतः..
समाप्तौ तस्य यज्ञस्य संतर्प्य सकलांस्ततः..
ऋत्विजो दक्षिणाभिस्तान्यथोक्तान्द्विजसत्तमान्..2..
5.189.m: And having gratified all the brahmins, the mendicants, and especially the poor and the blind / at the conclusion of that sacrifice, [he] then [gratified] / those officiating priests, the best of the twice-born, with priestly gifts as prescribed.

5.189.s:
tataḥ sa cānayāmāsa nāgarānbrāhmaṇottamān..
cātuścaraṇasaṃpannāñchrutismṛti samanvitān..3..
5.189.d:
ततः स चानयामास नागरान्ब्राह्मणोत्तमान्..
चातुश्चरणसंपन्नाञ्छ्रुतिस्मृति समन्वितान्..3..
5.189.m: Then he summoned the Nāgara brahmins, the best of the twice-born, / endowed with the four limbs [of Vedic study] and conversant with the Śruti and Smṛti.

5.189.s:
kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā tatastānprāha sādaram..
yadbhūmau tu mayā tīrthaṃ puṣkaraṃ saṃniveśitam..4..
5.189.d:
कृतांजलिपुटो भूत्वा ततस्तान्प्राह सादरम्..
यद्भूमौ तु मया तीर्थं पुष्करं संनिवेशितम्..4..
5.189.m: Having folded his hands in reverence, he then said to them respectfully: / "Since on earth I established the sacred ford Puṣkara,

5.189.s:
kalikālasya bhītena dvitīyaṃ brāhmaṇottamāḥ..
yena no nāśamabhyeti mlecchairapi samāśritam..5..
5.189.d:
कलिकालस्य भीतेन द्वितीयं ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः..
येन नो नाशमभ्येति म्लेच्छैरपि समाश्रितम्..5..
5.189.m: as a second one, O best of the twice-born, out of fear of the Kali age, / so that it is not destroyed even if inhabited by mlecchas,

5.189.s:
hāṭakeśvaradevasya prabhāvena mahātmanaḥ..
kalikāle ca samprāpte tīrthānyāyatanāni ca..6..
5.189.d:
हाटकेश्वरदेवस्य प्रभावेन महात्मनः..
कलिकाले च सम्प्राप्ते तीर्थान्यायतनानि च..6..
5.189.m: by the power of the great Lord Hāṭakeśvara; / and when the Kali age has arrived, the sacred fords and temples,

5.189.s:
mlecchaiḥ spṛṣṭānyasaṃdigdhaṃ prayāgādīni kṛtsnaśaḥ..
yajñastu vihitastena bhayāyaṃ tatkṛtena ca..7..
5.189.d:
म्लेच्छैः स्पृष्टान्यसंदिग्धं प्रयागादीनि कृत्स्नशः..
यज्ञस्तु विहितस्तेन भयायं तत्कृतेन च..7..
5.189.m: beginning with Prayāga, will all undoubtedly be defiled by mlecchas— / by that fear caused by them, this sacrifice was performed.

5.189.s:
tasmādvadatha kiṃ dānaṃ yuṣmadbhūmeśca niṣkraye...
prayacchāmi ca yajñasya yena me syātphalaṃ dvijāḥ..8..
5.189.d:
तस्माद्वदथ किं दानं युष्मद्भूमेश्च निष्क्रये...
प्रयच्छामि च यज्ञस्य येन मे स्यात्फलं द्विजाः..8..
5.189.m: Therefore, tell me what gift [as a fee] for the purchase of your land / of the sacrifice I may bestow, O twice-born, so that its fruit may belong to me."

5.189.s:
brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ..
yadi yacchasi cāsmākaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ yajñasaṃbhavām..
tadasmākaṃ svavāsena sthānaṃ naya pavitratām..9..
5.189.d:
ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः..
यदि यच्छसि चास्माकं दक्षिणां यज्ञसंभवाम्..
तदस्माकं स्ववासेन स्थानं नय पवित्रताम्..9..
5.189.m: The brahmins said: / "If you give us the priestly gift arising from the sacrifice, / then bring this place of ours to purity by your own presence.

5.189.s:
yadetadbhavatā cātra puṣkaraṃ tīrthamuttamam..
sthāpitaṃ tasya no brūhi māhātmyaṃ surasattama..
yena snānādikāḥ sarvāḥ kriyāḥ kurmaḥ pitāmaha..6.190.10..
5.189.d:
यदेतद्भवता चात्र पुष्करं तीर्थमुत्तमम्..
स्थापितं तस्य नो ब्रूहि माहात्म्यं सुरसत्तम..
येन स्नानादिकाः सर्वाः क्रियाः कुर्मः पितामह..6.190.10..
5.189.m: This excellent sacred ford Puṣkara which has been established here by you— / tell us its māhātmya, O best of gods, / so that we may perform all rituals, beginning with ritual ablution, O Grandfather."

5.189.s:
brahmovāca..
etattīrthaṃ mayā sṛṣṭamaṃtarikṣasthitaṃ sadā..
kiṃ na śrutaṃ purāṇeṣu bhavadbhirdvijasattamāḥ..11..
5.189.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच..
एतत्तीर्थं मया सृष्टमंतरिक्षस्थितं सदा..
किं न श्रुतं पुराणेषु भवद्भिर्द्विजसत्तमाः..11..
5.189.m: Brahmā said: / "This sacred ford was created by me, always abiding in the intermediate space. / Have you not heard of it in the Purāṇas, O best of the twice-born?

5.189.s:
pṛthivyāṃ naimiṣaṃ tīrthamantarikṣe ca puṣkaram..
trailokye tu kurukṣetraṃ viśeṣeṇa vyavasthitam..12..
5.189.d:
पृथिव्यां नैमिषं तीर्थमन्तरिक्षे च पुष्करम्..
त्रैलोक्ये तु कुरुक्षेत्रं विशेषेण व्यवस्थितम्..12..
5.189.m: On earth is the sacred ford Naimiṣa, and in the intermediate space is Puṣkara, / while Kurukṣetra is situated distinctly in the three worlds.

5.189.s:
tadyuṣmākaṃ hitārthāya paṃcarātraṃ dharātale..
āgamiṣyatyasaṃdigdhaṃ mama vākyapraṇoditam..13..
5.189.d:
तद्युष्माकं हितार्थाय पंचरात्रं धरातले..
आगमिष्यत्यसंदिग्धं मम वाक्यप्रणोदितम्..13..
5.189.m: Therefore, for your welfare, for five nights upon the earth's surface / it will undoubtedly arrive, impelled by my word.

5.189.s:
kārtikyāṃ śuklapakṣe tu hyekādaśyāṃ dine sthite..
yāvatpaṃcadaśī tāvattithiḥ pāpapraṇāśinī..14..
5.189.d:
कार्तिक्यां शुक्लपक्षे तु ह्येकादश्यां दिने स्थिते..
यावत्पंचदशी तावत्तिथिः पापप्रणाशिनी..14..
5.189.m: In the bright fortnight of Kārttika, beginning on the eleventh day / until the fifteenth, that lunar day destroys sin.

5.189.s:
paṃcarātrasya madhye tu yaḥ snānaṃ ca kariṣyati ..
śrāddhaṃ vā śraddhayā yuktastasya syādakṣayaṃ hi tat .. 15 ..
5.189.d:
पंचरात्रस्य मध्ये तु यः स्नानं च करिष्यति ..
श्राद्धं वा श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्य स्यादक्षयं हि तत् .. 15 ..
5.189.m: Whoever performs ritual ablution in the midst of those five nights, / or, filled with faith, performs a śrāddha, it will indeed become inexhaustible for him.

5.189.s:
aha tu paṃcarātraṃ tadbrahmalokādupetya ca ..
saṃśrayaṃ tu kariṣyāmi tīrthe'traiva dvijottamāḥ .. 16 ..
5.189.d:
अह तु पंचरात्रं तद्ब्रह्मलोकादुपेत्य च ..
संश्रयं तु करिष्यामि तीर्थेऽत्रैव द्विजोत्तमाः .. 16 ..
5.189.m: And I, arriving from Brahmaloka for those five nights, / will take up residence in this very sacred ford, O best of the twice-born."

5.189.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
tava mūrtiṃ kariṣyāmaḥ sthāne'tra prapitāmaha ..
tasyāṃ saṃkramaṇaṃ nityaṃ tasmātkāryaṃ tvayāvibho .. 17 ..
5.189.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
तव मूर्तिं करिष्यामः स्थानेऽत्र प्रपितामह ..
तस्यां संक्रमणं नित्यं तस्मात्कार्यं त्वयाविभो .. 17 ..
5.189.m: The brahmins said: / "We shall fashion an image of you in this place, O Great-grandfather; / therefore, a transference [of your presence] into it must always be made by you, O Lord.

5.189.s:
tīrthaṃ caiva sadāpya'tra samāgacchatu cāṃbarāt ..
lokānāṃ pāpanāśāya tathā tvaṃ kartumarhasi .. 18 ..
5.189.d:
तीर्थं चैव सदाप्यऽत्र समागच्छतु चांबरात् ..
लोकानां पापनाशाय तथा त्वं कर्तुमर्हसि .. 18 ..
5.189.m: And may the sacred ford also always arrive here from the sky / for the destruction of the sins of people; you ought to do so.

5.189.s: eṣā no dakṣiṇā deva yajñasyaiva samudbhavā.. 19 ..
5.189.d: एषा नो दक्षिणा देव यज्ञस्यैव समुद्भवा.. 19 ..
5.189.m: This is our priestly gift, O Lord, arising from the sacrifice.

5.189.s:
evaṃ kṛte suraśreṣṭha saphalaḥ syātkratustava ..
pratijñā ca tathā satyā tasmāddānāya nirmitā .. 6.190.20 .. ..
5.189.d:
एवं कृते सुरश्रेष्ठ सफलः स्यात्क्रतुस्तव ..
प्रतिज्ञा च तथा सत्या तस्माद्दानाय निर्मिता .. 6.190.20 .. ..
5.189.m: When this is done, O best of the gods, your sacrifice will become fruitful, / and so your promise made for granting [it] will become true."

5.189.s:
.. śrībrahmovāca .. ..
mantrāhūtaṃ tataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ nabhomārgāddvijottamāḥ ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre puṣkaraṃ cāgamiṣyati .. 21 ..
5.189.d:
.. श्रीब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
मन्त्राहूतं ततः श्रेष्ठं नभोमार्गाद्द्विजोत्तमाः ..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे पुष्करं चागमिष्यति .. 21 ..
5.189.m: Auspicious Brahmā said: / "Invoked by mantra, the excellent Puṣkara will then arrive / from the path of the sky into the sacred field born of Hāṭakeśvara, O best of the twice-born.

5.189.s:
aghamarṣaṃ japaṃścaiva yaḥ kariṣyati toyagaḥ..
mama mūrteḥ puraḥ sthitvā pailamantrapuraḥsaram ..22..
5.189.d:
अघमर्षं जपंश्चैव यः करिष्यति तोयगः..
मम मूर्तेः पुरः स्थित्वा पैलमन्त्रपुरःसरम् ..22..
5.189.m: And standing in the water in front of my image, / whoever recites the Aghamarṣaṇa preceded by the mantra of Paila,

5.189.s:
japiṣyati dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ savanānāṃ catuṣṭayam ..
brahmalokātsamāgatya praśroṣyā mi ca taddvijāḥ .. 23 ..
5.189.d:
जपिष्यति द्विजश्रेष्ठाः सवनानां चतुष्टयम् ..
ब्रह्मलोकात्समागत्य प्रश्रोष्या मि च तद्द्विजाः .. 23 ..
5.189.m: and will chant the four libations, O best of the twice-born, / I shall arrive from Brahmaloka and listen to that, O twice-born."

5.189.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
atha te nāgarāḥ sarve puṣpadānaprapūrvakam..
anujñāṃ pradadustuṣṭā yajñaphalasamāptaye .. 24 ..
5.189.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अथ ते नागराः सर्वे पुष्पदानप्रपूर्वकम्..
अनुज्ञां प्रददुस्तुष्टा यज्ञफलसमाप्तये .. 24 ..
5.189.m: Sūta said: / Then all those Nāgaras, pleased, having offered flowers, / gave their permission for the completion of the fruit of the sacrifice.

5.189.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāptaḥ pulastyo'dhvaryusattamaḥ ..
yatra sthāne sthito brahmā nāgaraiḥ parivāritaḥ .. 25 ..
5.189.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्तः पुलस्त्योऽध्वर्युसत्तमः ..
यत्र स्थाने स्थितो ब्रह्मा नागरैः परिवारितः .. 25 ..
5.189.m: In the meantime, Pulastya, the best of the Adhvaryu priests, arrived / at that place where Brahmā was seated, surrounded by the Nāgaras.

5.189.s:
abravīcca samāptaste yataḥ saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇaḥ ..
prāyaścittairvirahito yathā nānyasya kasyacit .. 26 ..
5.189.d:
अब्रवीच्च समाप्तस्ते यतः संपूर्णदक्षिणः ..
प्रायश्चित्तैर्विरहितो यथा नान्यस्य कस्यचित् .. 26 ..
5.189.m: And he said: "Your [sacrifice] is completed, since its priestly gifts are fulfilled, / free from [the need for] expiations, as none other's ever was.

5.189.s:
ataḥ paraṃ karmaśeṣaṃ kiṃcidasti pitāmaha ..
vāruṇeṣṭirjapaścaiva tatkariṣyāmi sāṃpratam.. 27 ..
5.189.d:
अतः परं कर्मशेषं किंचिदस्ति पितामह ..
वारुणेष्टिर्जपश्चैव तत्करिष्यामि सांप्रतम्.. 27 ..
5.189.m: Beyond this, a small remainder of the ritual exists, O Grandfather: / the Vāruṇī-iṣṭi and the recitation; that I shall perform now.

5.189.s:
tathā cā'vabhṛthasnānaṃ prakartavyaṃ tvayā saha ..
tasmāduttiṣṭha gacchāmo yatra toyavyavasthitam .. 28 ..
5.189.d:
तथा चाऽवभृथस्नानं प्रकर्तव्यं त्वया सह ..
तस्मादुत्तिष्ठ गच्छामो यत्र तोयव्यवस्थितम् .. 28 ..
5.189.m: And likewise, the ceremonial post-bath ablution must be performed together with you. / Therefore arise, let us go where the water is situated,

5.189.s:
yeneṣṭivāruṇīṃ tatra kurmo viprairyathocitaiḥ ..
caturbhirbrahmapūrvaiśca mayā cāgnīdhrahotṛbhiḥ .. 29 ..
5.189.d:
येनेष्टिवारुणीं तत्र कुर्मो विप्रैर्यथोचितैः ..
चतुर्भिर्ब्रह्मपूर्वैश्च मया चाग्नीध्रहोतृभिः .. 29 ..
5.189.m: so that there we may perform the Vāruṇī-iṣṭi with the proper brahmins: / the four led by the Brahman priest, myself, the Āgnīdhra, and the Hotṛs.

5.189.s:
yathāvahnau tathā toye mantravattadbhavaṃśubham ..
hūyate saṃvidhānenayajñapātraiḥ sama nvitam.. 6.190.30 ..
5.189.d:
यथावह्नौ तथा तोये मन्त्रवत्तद्भवंशुभम् ..
हूयते संविधानेनयज्ञपात्रैः सम न्वितम्.. 6.190.30 ..
5.189.m: Just as in the fire, so in the water that auspicious offering is poured with mantras, / according to rule, together with the sacrificial vessels.

5.189.s:
varuṇasya pratuṣṭyarthaṃ snānaṃ kāryaṃ tvayaiva ca ..
ṛtvigbhiḥ sahitenaiva sarvāriṣṭapraśāṃtaye .. 31 ..
5.189.d:
वरुणस्य प्रतुष्ट्यर्थं स्नानं कार्यं त्वयैव च ..
ऋत्विग्भिः सहितेनैव सर्वारिष्टप्रशांतये .. 31 ..
5.189.m: For the pleasure of Varuṇa, ritual ablution must be performed by you alone, / accompanied by the officiating priests, for the pacification of all misfortunes.

5.189.s:
yastatra samaye snānaṃ kariṣyati tvayā saha ..
anyo'pi mānavaḥ kaścidvipāpmā sa bhaviṣyati .. 32 ..
5.189.d:
यस्तत्र समये स्नानं करिष्यति त्वया सह ..
अन्योऽपि मानवः कश्चिद्विपाप्मा स भविष्यति .. 32 ..
5.189.m: Whatever other human being also performs ritual ablution at that time together with you / will become freed from sin.

5.189.s:
yānīha saṃti tīrthāni trailokye sacarācare ..
vāruṇīmiṣṭimāsādya tāni yāṃti ca saṃnidhau .. 33 ..
5.189.d:
यानीह संति तीर्थानि त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे ..
वारुणीमिष्टिमासाद्य तानि यांति च संनिधौ .. 33 ..
5.189.m: Whatever sacred fords there are here in the three worlds of moving and unmoving beings / come into the vicinity, having reached the Vāruṇī-iṣṭi.

5.189.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena dīkṣitena samanvitam ..
tatra snānaṃ prakartavyaṃ jalamadhye tu sārthibhiḥ ..
brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ sarvairava bhṛthotsave .. 34 ..
5.189.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन दीक्षितेन समन्वितम् ..
तत्र स्नानं प्रकर्तव्यं जलमध्ये तु सार्थिभिः ..
ब्राह्मणैः क्षत्रियैर्वैश्यैः सर्वैरव भृथोत्सवे .. 34 ..
5.189.m: Therefore, with every effort, together with the consecrated sacrificer, / ritual ablution must be performed there in the midst of the water by all seekers of welfare— / by brahmins, kṣatriyas, and vaiśyas—at the festival of the ceremonial post-bath ablution.

5.189.s:
tasmādvisarjayādyaitānbrāhmaṇāṃstāvadeva ca ..
ete'pi ca kariṣyaṃti snānaṃ tatra tvayā saha .. 35 ..
5.189.d:
तस्माद्विसर्जयाद्यैतान्ब्राह्मणांस्तावदेव च ..
एतेऽपि च करिष्यंति स्नानं तत्र त्वया सह .. 35 ..
5.189.m: Therefore dismiss these brahmins now for that purpose; / they too will perform ritual ablution there together with you."

5.189.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā prasthito brahmā jyeṣṭhakuṇḍataṭaṃ śubham ..
gāyatryā sahito hṛṣṭaḥ kṛtakṛtyatvamāgataḥ .. 36 ..
5.189.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा प्रस्थितो ब्रह्मा ज्येष्ठकुण्डतटं शुभम् ..
गायत्र्या सहितो हृष्टः कृतकृत्यत्वमागतः .. 36 ..
5.189.m: Sūta said: / Having heard that, Brahmā set out toward the auspicious bank of the Jyeṣṭhakuṇḍa, / accompanied by Gāyatrī, delighted, having achieved his purpose.

5.189.s:
atha tadvacanaṃ śrutvā surāḥ sarve tathā dvijāḥ ..
pulastyaśca śubhārthāya snānārthaṃ prasthitāstadā..
brahmaṇā sahitā hṛṣṭāḥ putradārasamanvitāḥ .. 37 ..
5.189.d:
अथ तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सुराः सर्वे तथा द्विजाः ..
पुलस्त्यश्च शुभार्थाय स्नानार्थं प्रस्थितास्तदा..
ब्रह्मणा सहिता हृष्टाः पुत्रदारसमन्विताः .. 37 ..
5.189.m: Then, having heard that speech, all the gods as well as the twice-born / and Pulastya set out for auspiciousness, for the ritual ablution, / accompanied by Brahmā, delighted, together with their sons and wives.

5.189.s:
atha saṃkīrṇatā jātā samaṃtājjyeṣṭhapuṣkare ..
snānārthamāgatairlokairūrdhvabāhubhireva ca .. 38 ..
5.189.d:
अथ संकीर्णता जाता समंताज्ज्येष्ठपुष्करे ..
