स्नानार्थमागतैर्लोकैरूर्ध्वबाहुभिरेव च .. 38 ..
5.189.m: Then overcrowding arose all around at Jyeṣṭhapuṣkara / by the people who had arrived for the ritual ablution, their arms raised high.

5.189.s:
na tatra lakṣyate brahmā na tatkarma ca vāruṇam ..
kriyamāṇairdvijaistatra vyāpte bhūmi tale'khile .. 39 ..
5.189.d:
न तत्र लक्ष्यते ब्रह्मा न तत्कर्म च वारुणम् ..
क्रियमाणैर्द्विजैस्तत्र व्याप्ते भूमि तलेऽखिले .. 39 ..
5.189.m: Brahmā could not be seen there, nor that concluding rite of Varuṇa, / as the whole surface of the earth was crowded by the brahmins performing it there.

5.189.s:
athāṃte karmaṇastasya brahmā prāha śatakratum ..
hitārthaṃ sarvalokasya vinayāvanataṃ sthitam .. 6.190.40 ..
5.189.d:
अथांते कर्मणस्तस्य ब्रह्मा प्राह शतक्रतुम् ..
हितार्थं सर्वलोकस्य विनयावनतं स्थितम् .. 6.190.40 ..
5.189.m: Then, at the conclusion of that rite, Brahmā said to Indra, / who was standing bowed in modesty, for the benefit of the whole world:

5.189.s:
na māṃ jñāsyati dūrasthā janāḥ snānārthamāgatāḥ ..
majjamānaṃ jale puṇye sammarde'smiñjalodbhave .. 41 ..
5.189.d:
न मां ज्ञास्यति दूरस्था जनाः स्नानार्थमागताः ..
मज्जमानं जले पुण्ये सम्मर्देऽस्मिञ्जलोद्भवे .. 41 ..
5.189.m: “The people standing far off, who have come for the ritual ablution, will not perceive me / dipping into the sacred water in this throng in the water.

5.189.s:
tasmānnāgaṃ samāruhya nijaṃ vṛtraniṣūdana ..
eṇasya kṛṣṇasārasya vaṃśāṃte carma nyasya ca .. 42 ..
5.189.d:
तस्मान्नागं समारुह्य निजं वृत्रनिषूदन ..
एणस्य कृष्णसारस्य वंशांते चर्म न्यस्य च .. 42 ..
5.189.m: Therefore, mount your own elephant, O slayer of Vṛtra, / and placing the hide of a black antelope upon the end of a bamboo pole,

5.189.s:
tatastatsnānavelāyāṃ kṣeptavyaṃ salile tvayā ..
yena lokaḥ samasto'yaṃ vetti kālaṃ tu snānajam .. 43 ..
5.189.d:
ततस्तत्स्नानवेलायां क्षेप्तव्यं सलिले त्वया ..
येन लोकः समस्तोऽयं वेत्ति कालं तु स्नानजम् .. 43 ..
5.189.m: it must then be cast by you into the water at the time of that ritual ablution, / so that all this world may know the time born of the ritual ablution,

5.189.s:
snānaṃ ca kurute śreyaḥ saṃprāpnoti yathoditam ..
dūrastho'pi suvṛddho'pi bālo'pi ca samāgataḥ ..
snānajaṃ labhate śreyaḥ saṃdṛṣṭe'pi yathoditam .. 44 .. ..
5.189.d:
स्नानं च कुरुते श्रेयः संप्राप्नोति यथोदितम् ..
दूरस्थोऽपि सुवृद्धोऽपि बालोऽपि च समागतः ..
स्नानजं लभते श्रेयः संदृष्टेऽपि यथोदितम् .. 44 .. ..
5.189.m: and perform the ritual ablution and attain the welfare as described. / Even if far off, even if very old, even if a child who has arrived, / merely upon seeing it, one obtains the welfare arising from the ritual ablution as described.”

5.189.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
bāḍhamityeva saṃprocya satvaraṃ prayayau hariḥ .. 45 ..
5.189.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
बाढमित्येव संप्रोच्य सत्वरं प्रययौ हरिः .. 45 ..
5.189.m: Sūta said: / Having said, “So be it,” Hari went quickly.

5.189.s:
tato nāgaṃ samāruhya dhṛtvā vaṃśaṃ kare nije ..
mṛgacarmāgrasaṃyuktaṃ toyamadhye vyavasthitaḥ .. 46 ..
5.189.d:
ततो नागं समारुह्य धृत्वा वंशं करे निजे ..
मृगचर्माग्रसंयुक्तं तोयमध्ये व्यवस्थितः .. 46 ..
5.189.m: Then, mounting the elephant and holding a bamboo pole in his hand / with the deer hide attached to its tip, he took his position amidst the water.

5.189.s:
etatkarmāvasāne sa snātukāme pitāmahe ..
taccarma prākṣipattoye svayameva śatakratuḥ .. 47 ..
5.189.d:
एतत्कर्मावसाने स स्नातुकामे पितामहे ..
तच्चर्म प्राक्षिपत्तोये स्वयमेव शतक्रतुः .. 47 ..
5.189.m: At the conclusion of this rite, as the Grandfather wished to bathe, / Indra himself cast that hide into the water.

5.189.s:
etasminnantare devāḥ sarve gandharvaguhyakāḥ ..
mānuṣāśca viśeṣeṇa snātāstatra samāhitāḥ .. 48 ..
5.189.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवाः सर्वे गन्धर्वगुह्यकाः ..
मानुषाश्च विशेषेण स्नातास्तत्र समाहिताः .. 48 ..
5.189.m: At that moment, all the gods, Gandharvas, and Guhyakas, / and mortals especially, bathed there with focused minds.

5.189.s:
etasminnantare brahmā śakraṃ provāca sādaram ..
kṛtasnānaṃ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ vinayāvanataṃ sthitam .. 49 ..
5.189.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे ब्रह्मा शक्रं प्रोवाच सादरम् ..
कृतस्नानं सुरैः सार्धं विनयावनतं स्थितम् .. 49 ..
5.189.m: In the meantime, Brahmā respectfully addressed Indra, / who stood bowed in modesty after having bathed along with the gods:

5.189.s:
sahasrākṣaṃ tvayā kaṣṭaṃ manmakhe vipulaṃ kṛtam ..
ānītā ca tathā patnī gāyatrī ca sumadhyamā .. 6.190.50 ..
5.189.d:
सहस्राक्षं त्वया कष्टं मन्मखे विपुलं कृतम् ..
आनीता च तथा पत्नी गायत्री च सुमध्यमा .. 6.190.50 ..
5.189.m: “O thousand-eyed one, immense hardship was endured by you in my sacrifice; / and the slender-waisted wife Gāyatrī was likewise brought by you.

5.189.s:
tasmādvaraya bhadraṃ te yaṃ varaṃ manasi sthitam ..
sarvaṃ te'haṃ pradāsyāmi yadyapi syātsudurlabham .. 51 ..
5.189.d:
तस्माद्वरय भद्रं ते यं वरं मनसि स्थितम् ..
सर्वं तेऽहं प्रदास्यामि यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम् .. 51 ..
5.189.m: Therefore, choose a boon—blessing be upon you—whatever boon rests in your mind. / I shall grant you everything, even if it is very difficult to obtain.”

5.189.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva yadi deyo varo mama ..
yadi tvāṃ prārthayāmyadya bhūyāttu tādṛśaṃ vibho .. 52 ..
5.189.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे देव यदि देयो वरो मम ..
यदि त्वां प्रार्थयाम्यद्य भूयात्तु तादृशं विभो .. 52 ..
5.189.m: Indra said: / “If you are pleased with me, O God, if a boon is to be given to me, / if I may ask you today, O Lord, let it be thus:

5.189.s:
varṣevarṣe tu yaḥ kuryātsaṃprāpte'smindine śubhe ..
mṛgacarma samādāya vaṃśāgre yo mahīpatiḥ .. 53 ..
5.189.d:
वर्षेवर्षे तु यः कुर्यात्संप्राप्तेऽस्मिन्दिने शुभे ..
मृगचर्म समादाय वंशाग्रे यो महीपतिः .. 53 ..
5.189.m: Year after year, when this auspicious day arrives, / whichever king, taking a deer skin at the tip of a bamboo pole,

5.189.s:
nāgapravaramāruhya svayameva pitāmaha ..
yathā'haṃ prakṣipettoye sa syātpāpavivarjitaḥ .. 54 ..
5.189.d:
नागप्रवरमारुह्य स्वयमेव पितामह ..
यथाऽहं प्रक्षिपेत्तोये स स्यात्पापविवर्जितः .. 54 ..
5.189.m: mounts an excellent elephant and himself, O Grandfather, / casts it into the water just as I did, may he be free from sin,

5.189.s:
ajeyaḥ sarvaśatrūṇāṃ sarvavyasanavarjitaḥ ..
ye kariṣyaṃti ca snānamanena mṛgacarmaṇā .. 55 ..
5.189.d:
अजेयः सर्वशत्रूणां सर्वव्यसनवर्जितः ..
ये करिष्यंति च स्नानमनेन मृगचर्मणा .. 55 ..
5.189.m: unconquerable by all enemies, and free from all vices; / and those who perform their ritual ablution together with this deer skin,

5.189.s:
sārdhamanye'pi ye lokā api pāpasamanvitāḥ ..
teṣāṃ varṣakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tvatprasādātpraṇaśyatu .. 56 ..
5.189.d:
सार्धमन्येऽपि ये लोका अपि पापसमन्विताः ..
तेषां वर्षकृतं पापं त्वत्प्रसादात्प्रणश्यतु .. 56 ..
5.189.m: and whatever other people as well, even though endowed with sin— / may the sin committed by them during the year perish through your grace!”

5.189.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
etatsarvaṃ sahasrākṣa tava vākyamasaṃśayam ..
bhaviṣyati na saṃdehaḥ sarvametanmayoditam .. 57 ..
5.189.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
एतत्सर्वं सहस्राक्ष तव वाक्यमसंशयम् ..
भविष्यति न संदेहः सर्वमेतन्मयोदितम् .. 57 ..
5.189.m: Brahmā said: / “All these words of yours, O thousand-eyed one, without doubt / shall come to pass, there is no question; all this has been declared by me.

5.189.s:
yo rājā śraddhayā yukto deśasyāsya samudbhavaḥ ..
ānartasya gajārūḍho mṛgacarma kṣipiṣyati .. 58 ..
5.189.d:
यो राजा श्रद्धया युक्तो देशस्यास्य समुद्भवः ..
आनर्तस्य गजारूढो मृगचर्म क्षिपिष्यति .. 58 ..
5.189.m: Whatever king, endowed with faith, born in this Ānarta country, / mounted upon an elephant, shall cast the deer skin

5.189.s:
atra kuṇḍe madīye tu māṃ saṃpūjya taṭasthitam ...
sarvalokahitārthāya saṃprāpte pratipaddine .. 59 ..
5.189.d:
अत्र कुण्डे मदीये तु मां संपूज्य तटस्थितम् ...
सर्वलोकहितार्थाय संप्राप्ते प्रतिपद्दिने .. 59 ..
5.189.m: into this pool of mine, having worshipped me stationed on the bank, / for the welfare of all the world, when the day of Pratipad has arrived,

5.189.s:
samāpte kutape kāle vijayī sa bhaviṣyati ..
kārtikyāṃ ca vyatītāyāṃ dvitīye'hni vyavasthite .. .. 6.190.60 ..
5.189.d:
समाप्ते कुतपे काले विजयी स भविष्यति ..
कार्तिक्यां च व्यतीतायां द्वितीयेऽह्नि व्यवस्थिते .. .. 6.190.60 ..
5.189.m: at the conclusion of the kutapa hour, he shall be victorious, / once the full-moon day of Kārttika has passed and the second day has begun.

5.189.s:
tathā tatkālamāsādya ye kariṣyaṃti mānavāḥ ..
snānaṃ tacca dine'traiva varṣapāpavivarjitāḥ ..
ādhivyādhivimuktāśca te bhaviṣyaṃtyasaṃśayam .. 61 ..
5.189.d:
तथा तत्कालमासाद्य ये करिष्यंति मानवाः ..
स्नानं तच्च दिनेऽत्रैव वर्षपापविवर्जिताः ..
आधिव्याधिविमुक्ताश्च ते भविष्यंत्यसंशयम् .. 61 ..
5.189.m: Likewise, reaching that time, whatever humans / perform the ritual ablution on this very day here, free from the year's sins / and liberated from mental agony and physical disease, they shall become, without a doubt.”

5.189.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etasminnaṃtare prāpto yakṣmākhyo dāruṇo gadaḥ ..
acikitsyo'pi devānāṃ tathā dhanvaṃtarerapi .. 62 ..
5.189.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्तो यक्ष्माख्यो दारुणो गदः ..
अचिकित्स्योऽपि देवानां तथा धन्वंतरेरपि .. 62 ..
5.189.m: Sūta said: / In the meantime, the terrible disease named Yakṣmā arrived, / incurable even by the gods and likewise by Dhanvantari.

5.189.s:
nīlāṃbaradharaḥ kṣāmo dīno daṇḍasamāśritaḥ ..
kṣutkurvañchleṣmaṇā tāvatkṛcchrātsaṃdhārayanpadam .. 63 ..
5.189.d:
नीलांबरधरः क्षामो दीनो दण्डसमाश्रितः ..
क्षुत्कुर्वञ्छ्लेष्मणा तावत्कृच्छ्रात्संधारयन्पदम् .. 63 ..
5.189.m: Wearing dark blue garments, emaciated, wretched, leaning on a staff, / coughing and spitting phlegm, placing each footstep with great difficulty,

5.189.s: tataśca praṇato bhūtvā vākyametaduvāca saḥ .. 64 .. ..
5.189.d: ततश्च प्रणतो भूत्वा वाक्यमेतदुवाच सः .. 64 .. ..
5.189.m: he then bowed down and spoke these words:

5.189.s:
.. yakṣmovāca .. ..
tava yajñamahaṃ śrutvā dūrādeva pitāmaha ..
kṣutkṣāmakaṃṭhaścāyātaḥ samāptāvadya kṛcchrataḥ .. 65 ..
5.189.d:
.. यक्ष्मोवाच .. ..
तव यज्ञमहं श्रुत्वा दूरादेव पितामह ..
क्षुत्क्षामकंठश्चायातः समाप्तावद्य कृच्छ्रतः .. 65 ..
5.189.m: Yakṣmā said: / “Having heard of your sacrifice from afar, O Grandfather, / with a throat emaciated by hunger, I have come with great difficulty today at the conclusion.

5.189.s:
dakṣeṇāhaṃ purā sṛṣṭaścaṃdrārthaṃ kupitena ca ..
rohiṇīṃ sevamānasya saṃtyaktānyāsutasya ca ..66..
5.189.d:
दक्षेणाहं पुरा सृष्टश्चंद्रार्थं कुपितेन च ..
रोहिणीं सेवमानस्य संत्यक्तान्यासुतस्य च ..66..
5.189.m: Formerly, I was created by the enraged Dakṣa for the sake of the Moon, / who attended upon Rohiṇī and abandoned his other daughters.

5.189.s:
tato māheśvarādeśāttena tuṣṭena tasya ca ..
pakṣamekaṃ kṛtaṃ mahyaṃ tasyāsvādanakarmaṇi .. 67 ..
5.189.d:
ततो माहेश्वरादेशात्तेन तुष्टेन तस्य च ..
पक्षमेकं कृतं मह्यं तस्यास्वादनकर्मणि .. 67 ..
5.189.m: Then, by the order of Śiva, when pleased with him, / one fortnight was allotted to me for consuming him.

5.189.s:
anyapakṣe na kiṃcicca yena tṛptiḥ prajāyate ..
yajñasyaiva tu sarvasya tarpayitvā dvijottamam .. 68 ..
5.189.d:
अन्यपक्षे न किंचिच्च येन तृप्तिः प्रजायते ..
यज्ञस्यैव तु सर्वस्य तर्पयित्वा द्विजोत्तमम् .. 68 ..
5.189.m: In the other fortnight there is nothing by which satisfaction is produced for me. / Having satiated the best of brahmins at every sacrifice,

5.189.s:
tatastadvacanaṃ grāhyaṃ tarpito'hamasaṃśayam ..
paurṇamāsyāṃ tato deva yasya yajñasya kṛtsnaśaḥ .. 69 ..
5.189.d:
ततस्तद्वचनं ग्राह्यं तर्पितोऽहमसंशयम् ..
पौर्णमास्यां ततो देव यस्य यज्ञस्य कृत्स्नशः .. 69 ..
5.189.m: his word should then be accepted: ‘I am satisfied, without doubt.’ / Then, O God, on the full-moon day, for whichever sacrifice entirely,

5.189.s:
yasya no brāhmaṇo brūte yajñasyāṃte pratarpitaḥ ..
tarpito'smīti tattasya vṛthā syādyajñajaṃ phalam ..
yadi koṭiguṇaṃ dattamapi śraddhāsamanvitam .. 6.190.70 ..
5.189.d:
यस्य नो ब्राह्मणो ब्रूते यज्ञस्यांते प्रतर्पितः ..
तर्पितोऽस्मीति तत्तस्य वृथा स्याद्यज्ञजं फलम् ..
यदि कोटिगुणं दत्तमपि श्रद्धासमन्वितम् .. 6.190.70 ..
5.189.m: a brahmin, having been satiated at the end of the sacrifice, does not say, / ‘I am satisfied,’ the fruit born of that sacrifice would be in vain for him, / even if given tenfold-millionfold and endowed with faith.

5.189.s:
etacchrutvā tvayā deva paṭhyamānaṃ śrutāviha ..
tasmātsamyaksthite yajñe brāhmaṇaṃ tarpayeta vai .. 71 ..
5.189.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा त्वया देव पठ्यमानं श्रुताविह ..
तस्मात्सम्यक्स्थिते यज्ञे ब्राह्मणं तर्पयेत वै .. 71 ..
5.189.m: Having heard this recited by you in the Vedic revelation here, O God, / therefore, when a sacrifice is properly established, one should indeed satisfy the brahmin.

5.189.s:
pratyakṣaṃ me yathā tṛptirannenaiva prajāyate ..
tvatprasādātsuraśreṣṭha tathā nītirvidhīyatām .. 72 ..
5.189.d:
प्रत्यक्षं मे यथा तृप्तिरन्नेनैव प्रजायते ..
त्वत्प्रसादात्सुरश्रेष्ठ तथा नीतिर्विधीयताम् .. 72 ..
5.189.m: Just as tangible satisfaction may arise for me through food, / through your grace, O best of gods, let such a rule be ordained!”

5.189.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā padmajastasya pathyaṃpathyaṃ vaco'khilam ..
śrutiṃ pramāṇatāṃ nītvā tato vacanamabravīt .. 73 ..
5.189.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा पद्मजस्तस्य पथ्यंपथ्यं वचोऽखिलम् ..
श्रुतिं प्रमाणतां नीत्वा ततो वचनमब्रवीत् .. 73 ..
5.189.m: Sūta said: / Having heard his entire speech, both beneficial and unwholesome, / and taking the Vedic revelation as the authoritative source, the lotus-born [Brahmā] then spoke these words:

5.189.s:
adyaprabhṛti vai viprāḥ sāgnayaḥ syurdharātale ..
taiḥ sarvairvaiśvadevāṃte balirdeyastathākhilaḥ .. 74 ..
5.189.d:
अद्यप्रभृति वै विप्राः साग्नयः स्युर्धरातले ..
तैः सर्वैर्वैश्वदेवांते बलिर्देयस्तथाखिलः .. 74 ..
5.189.m: “From this day onward, the brahmins on the face of the earth who maintain the sacred fires / must all offer the entire food-offering at the end of the vaiśvadeva rite.

5.189.s:
dattvā'nyebhyotha devebhyastava tṛptirbhaviṣyati ..
tava pakṣe dvitīye tu satyametanmayoditam .. 75 ..
5.189.d:
दत्त्वाऽन्येभ्योथ देवेभ्यस्तव तृप्तिर्भविष्यति ..
तव पक्षे द्वितीये तु सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् .. 75 ..
5.189.m: After giving it to the other gods, your satisfaction shall take place / during your second fortnight; this is the truth declared by me.

5.189.s:
ye viprāstu baliṃ dadyurvaiśvadevāṃta āgate ..
na teṣāmanvaye cāpi tvayā sevyo'tra kaścana .. 76 ..
5.189.d:
ये विप्रास्तु बलिं दद्युर्वैश्वदेवांत आगते ..
न तेषामन्वये चापि त्वया सेव्योऽत्र कश्चन .. 76 ..
5.189.m: And whatever brahmins give the food-offering when the end of the vaiśvadeva arrives, / no one in their lineage here must be afflicted by you.”

5.189.s:
.. yakṣmovāca .. ..
tīrthe'smiṃstāvake deva sadāhaṃ tapasi sthitaḥ ..
tiṣṭhāmi yadi vādeśastāvako jāyate mama .. 77 ..
5.189.d:
.. यक्ष्मोवाच .. ..
तीर्थेऽस्मिंस्तावके देव सदाहं तपसि स्थितः ..
तिष्ठामि यदि वादेशस्तावको जायते मम .. 77 ..
5.189.m: Yakṣmā said: / “In this sacred ford of yours, O God, constantly engaged in austerity / I shall dwell, if such a command of yours comes to me.”

5.189.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
yadyevaṃ kuru cānyatra tvamāśramapadaṃ nijam ..
saṃprāpya bhūmideśe ca kañcidyadabhirocate ..
arthayitvā dvijānetānyathā yajñakṛte mayā .. 78 ..
5.189.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
यद्येवं कुरु चान्यत्र त्वमाश्रमपदं निजम् ..
संप्राप्य भूमिदेशे च कञ्चिद्यदभिरोचते ..
अर्थयित्वा द्विजानेतान्यथा यज्ञकृते मया .. 78 ..
5.189.m: Brahmā said: / “If so, make your own hermitage elsewhere, / having obtained whatever region of land pleases you, / after requesting these brahmins, just as was done by me for the sacrifice.”

5.189.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā prārthayāmāsa camatkārapurodbhavān ..
tebhyaḥ prāpya tato bhūmiṃ cakārāthāśramaṃ nijam .. 79 ..
5.189.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा प्रार्थयामास चमत्कारपुरोद्भवान् ..
तेभ्यः प्राप्य ततो भूमिं चकाराथाश्रमं निजम् .. 79 ..
5.189.m: Sūta said: / Hearing that, he begged the inhabitants born of Camatkārapura; / having obtained land from them, he then made his own hermitage.

5.189.s:
tatra yaḥ kurute snānaṃ pratipaddivase sthite ..
sūryavāreṇa mucyeta yakṣmaṇā sevito'pi vā .. 6.190.80 ..
5.189.d:
तत्र यः कुरुते स्नानं प्रतिपद्दिवसे स्थिते ..
सूर्यवारेण मुच्येत यक्ष्मणा सेवितोऽपि वा .. 6.190.80 ..
5.189.m: Whoever bathes there when the Pratipad day falls / on a Sunday, is freed even if afflicted by consumption.

5.189.s:
adyāpi dṛśyate cātra pratyayastasya saṃbhave ..
sarveṣāmāhitāgnīnāṃ nāgarāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
kali kāle'pi saṃprāpte na yakṣmā saṃprajāyate .. 81 ..
5.189.d:
अद्यापि दृश्यते चात्र प्रत्ययस्तस्य संभवे ..
सर्वेषामाहिताग्नीनां नागराणां विशेषतः ..
कलि कालेऽपि संप्राप्ते न यक्ष्मा संप्रजायते .. 81 ..
5.189.m: Even today proof of this is seen in its occurrence: / for all who maintain sacrificial fires, especially the Nāgaras, / even when the Kali age has arrived, consumption does not arise.

5.189.s:
tathā catuṣpadānāṃ ca teṣāṃ gṛhanivāsinām ..
na tasya bheṣajāni syurna maṃtrā na cikitsakāḥ .. 82 ..
5.189.d:
तथा चतुष्पदानां च तेषां गृहनिवासिनाम् ..
न तस्य भेषजानि स्युर्न मंत्रा न चिकित्सकाः .. 82 ..
5.189.m: Likewise for the four-footed animals residing in their houses, / there would be no need of medicines, mantras, or physicians.

5.189.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye brahmayajñāvabhṛthayakṣma tīrthotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma navatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 190 ..
5.189.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये ब्रह्मयज्ञावभृथयक्ष्म तीर्थोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम नवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 190 ..
5.189.m: Thus ends the one hundred and ninetieth chapter, named 'Description of the Origin and Greatness of the Yakṣmatīrtha at the Final Bath of Brahmā's Sacrifice,' in the Great Purāṇa of Skanda, in the compilation of eighty-one thousand [verses], in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the Greatness of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field.

5.190.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
sūtaputra tvayā proktaṃ sāvitrī nāgatā ca yat ..
kauṭilyena samāyuktairāhūtā vacanaistathā ..
pulastyena punaścaiva prasaktā gṛhakarmaṇi .. 1 ..
5.190.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
सूतपुत्र त्वया प्रोक्तं सावित्री नागता च यत् ..
कौटिल्येन समायुक्तैराहूता वचनैस्तथा ..
पुलस्त्येन पुनश्चैव प्रसक्ता गृहकर्मणि .. 1 ..
5.190.m: The seers said: / O son of Sūta, it was mentioned by you that Sāvitrī did not arrive, / though summoned with words imbued with crookedness / by Pulastya, and that she was again occupied with domestic work.

5.190.s:
tatastu brahmaṇā kopādgāyatrī ca samāhṛtā ..
devairvipreśce sā'tīva śaṃsitā bhāryatāṃ gatā .. 2 ..
5.190.d:
ततस्तु ब्रह्मणा कोपाद्गायत्री च समाहृता ..
देवैर्विप्रेश्चे साऽतीव शंसिता भार्यतां गता .. 2 ..
5.190.m: Then, out of anger, Gāyatrī was brought by Brahmā; / highly praised by the gods and brahmins, she became his wife.

5.190.s:
sāvitrī ca kathaṃ jātā tāṃ jñātvā yajñamaṇḍape ..
patnīśālāṃ praviṣṭāṃ ca sarvaṃ no vistarādvada .. 3 ..
5.190.d:
सावित्री च कथं जाता तां ज्ञात्वा यज्ञमण्डपे ..
पत्नीशालां प्रविष्टां च सर्वं नो विस्तराद्वद .. 3 ..
5.190.m: And how did Sāvitrī react, knowing her to be in the sacrificial pavilion / and entered into the wife's enclosure? Tell us everything in detail!

5.190.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
sāvitrī vaśagaṃ kāṃtaṃ jñātvā viśvāsamāgatā ..
sthirā bhūtvā tadā sarvā devapatnīḥ samānayat .. 4 ..
5.190.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
सावित्री वशगं कांतं ज्ञात्वा विश्वासमागता ..
स्थिरा भूत्वा तदा सर्वा देवपत्नीः समानयत् .. 4 ..
5.190.m: Sūta said: / Sāvitrī, knowing her beloved to be under her control, regained confidence; / having become calm, she then gathered all the wives of the gods.

5.190.s:
gaurī lakṣmīḥ śacī medhā tathā caivāpyarundhatī ..
svadhā svāhā tathā kītirbuddhiḥ puṣṭiḥ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ ..
tathā cānyāśca bahavo hyapsarobhiḥ samanvitāḥ .. 5 ..
5.190.d:
गौरी लक्ष्मीः शची मेधा तथा चैवाप्यरुन्धती ..
स्वधा स्वाहा तथा कीतिर्बुद्धिः पुष्टिः क्षमा धृतिः ..
तथा चान्याश्च बहवो ह्यप्सरोभिः समन्विताः .. 5 ..
5.190.m: Gaurī, Lakṣmī, Śacī, Medhā, and likewise Arundhatī, / Svadhā, Svāhā, and Kīrti, Buddhi, Puṣṭi, Kṣamā, Dhṛti, / and many others accompanied by apsarases—

5.190.s:
ghṛtācī menakā raṃbhā urvaśī ca tilottamā ..
apsarāṇāṃ gaṇāḥ sarve samājagmurdvijottamāḥ .. 6 ..
5.190.d:
घृताची मेनका रंभा उर्वशी च तिलोत्तमा ..
अप्सराणां गणाः सर्वे समाजग्मुर्द्विजोत्तमाः .. 6 ..
5.190.m: Ghṛtācī, Menakā, Rambhā, Urvaśī, and Tilottamā— / all the hosts of apsarases arrived, O best of twice-born ones.

5.190.s:
sā tābhiḥ sahitā devīpūrṇahastābhireva ca ..
saṃprahṛṣṭamanobhiśca prasthitā maṇḍapaṃ prati .. 7 ..
5.190.d:
सा ताभिः सहिता देवीपूर्णहस्ताभिरेव च ..
संप्रहृष्टमनोभिश्च प्रस्थिता मण्डपं प्रति .. 7 ..
5.190.m: She, accompanied by them whose hands were full [of auspicious offerings] / and whose minds were greatly delighted, set out toward the pavilion,

5.190.s:
vādyamāneṣu vādyeṣu gītadhvaniyuteṣu ca ..
gandharvāṇāṃ pramukhyānāṃ kinnarāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 8 ..
5.190.d:
वाद्यमानेषु वाद्येषु गीतध्वनियुतेषु च ..
गन्धर्वाणां प्रमुख्यानां किन्नराणां विशेषतः .. 8 ..
5.190.m: while instruments were being played, accompanied by the sound of singing / by the foremost gandharvas and especially by kinnaras.

5.190.s:
prasthitā sā mahābhāgā yāvattadyajñamaṇḍapam ..
tāvattasyāstadā cakṣuḥ prāsphuraddakṣiṇaṃ muhuḥ .. 9 ..
5.190.d:
प्रस्थिता सा महाभागा यावत्तद्यज्ञमण्डपम् ..
तावत्तस्यास्तदा चक्षुः प्रास्फुरद्दक्षिणं मुहुः .. 9 ..
5.190.m: As the highly fortunate lady set out toward the sacrificial pavilion, / just then her right eye twitched repeatedly.

5.190.s:
apasavyaṃ mṛgāścakrustathānye'pi khagādayaḥ ..
viparyastena saṃyāti śabdānkurvaṃti cāsakṛt .. 6.191.10 ..
5.190.d:
अपसव्यं मृगाश्चक्रुस्तथान्येऽपि खगादयः ..
विपर्यस्तेन संयाति शब्दान्कुर्वंति चासकृत् .. 6.191.10 ..
5.190.m: Deer passed on her right side, and likewise other creatures such as birds; / going in an contrary way, they repeatedly made sounds.

5.190.s:
dakṣiṇāni tathā'ṅgāni sphuramāṇāni vai muhuḥ..
tasyā manasi saṃkṣobhaṃ janayati nirargalam .. 11 ..
5.190.d:
दक्षिणानि तथाऽङ्गानि स्फुरमाणानि वै मुहुः..
तस्या मनसि संक्षोभं जनयति निरर्गलम् .. 11 ..
5.190.m: Her right limbs also throbbing repeatedly / caused unrestrained agitation in her mind.

5.190.s:
tāśca devastriyaḥ sarvā nṛtyaṃti ca hasaṃti ca ..
gāyaṃti ca yathotsāhaṃ tasyāḥ pārśve vyavasthitāḥ .. 12 ..
5.190.d:
ताश्च देवस्त्रियः सर्वा नृत्यंति च हसंति च ..
गायंति च यथोत्साहं तस्याः पार्श्वे व्यवस्थिताः .. 12 ..
5.190.m: Yet all those divine women danced and laughed, / and sang with enthusiasm, standing beside her.

5.190.s:
na jānaṃti ca saṃkṣobhaṃ tathā śakunajaṃ hṛdi ..
anyonyasparddhayā sarvā gītanṛtyaparāyaṇāḥ .. 13 ..
5.190.d:
न जानंति च संक्षोभं तथा शकुनजं हृदि ..
अन्योन्यस्पर्द्धया सर्वा गीतनृत्यपरायणाः .. 13 ..
5.190.m: They did not know of the agitation born of omens in her heart, / all intent on singing and dancing in rivalry with one another.

5.190.s:
ahaṃpūrvamahaṃpūrvaṃ praviśāmi mahāmakhe ..
ityautsukyasamopetāstā gacchaṃti tadā pathi .. 14 ..
5.190.d:
अहंपूर्वमहंपूर्वं प्रविशामि महामखे ..
इत्यौत्सुक्यसमोपेतास्ता गच्छंति तदा पथि .. 14 ..
5.190.m: 'I shall enter the great sacrifice first! I shall enter first!' / Filled with such eagerness, they then proceeded along the path.

5.190.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgara khaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye sāvitryā yajñāgamanakālikotpātādyapaśakunodbhavavarṇanaṃnāmaikanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..191..
5.190.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागर खण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सावित्र्या यज्ञागमनकालिकोत्पाताद्यपशकुनोद्भववर्णनंनामैकनवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..191..
5.190.m: Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-first chapter, named 'Description of the Origin of Portents and Bad Omens at the Time of Sāvitrī's Coming to the Sacrifice,' in the Great Purāṇa of Skanda, in the compilation of eighty-one thousand [verses], in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the Greatness of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field.

5.191.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
atha śrutvā mahānādaṃ vādyānāṃ samupasthitam ..
nāradaḥ sammukhaḥ prāyājjñātvā ca jananīṃ nijām .. 1 ..
5.191.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अथ श्रुत्वा महानादं वाद्यानां समुपस्थितम् ..
नारदः सम्मुखः प्रायाज्ज्ञात्वा च जननीं निजाम् .. 1 ..
5.191.m: Sūta said: / Then, hearing the loud noise of musical instruments approaching, / Nārada went forward, knowing that it was his own mother.

5.191.s:
praṇipatya sa dīnātmā bhūtvā cāśrupariplutaḥ ..
prāha gadgadayā vācā kaṇṭhe bāṣpasamāvṛtaḥ .. 2 ..
5.191.d:
प्रणिपत्य स दीनात्मा भूत्वा चाश्रुपरिप्लुतः ..
प्राह गद्गदया वाचा कण्ठे बाष्पसमावृतः .. 2 ..
5.191.m: Bowing low, miserable and bathed in tears, / his throat choked with weeping, he spoke in a faltering voice.

5.191.s:
ātmanaḥ śāparakṣārthaṃ tasyāḥ kopavivṛddhaye ..
kalipriyastadā vipro devastrīṇāṃ puraḥ sthitaḥ .. 3 ..
5.191.d:
आत्मनः शापरक्षार्थं तस्याः कोपविवृद्धये ..
कलिप्रियस्तदा विप्रो देवस्त्रीणां पुरः स्थितः .. 3 ..
5.191.m: To protect himself from a curse and to increase her anger, / the brahmin who delights in strife then stood before the divine women.

5.191.s:
meghagambhīrayā vācā praskhalaṃtyā padepade ..
mayā tvaṃ devi cāhūtā pulastyena tataḥ param .. 4 ..
5.191.d:
मेघगम्भीरया वाचा प्रस्खलंत्या पदेपदे ..
मया त्वं देवि चाहूता पुलस्त्येन ततः परम् .. 4 ..
5.191.m: With a voice deep as a thundercloud, faltering at every step, [he said]: / 'O goddess, you were summoned by me, and after that by Pulastya.

5.191.s: strīsvabhāvaṃ samāśritya dīkṣākāle'pi nāgatā .. 5 ..
5.191.d: स्त्रीस्वभावं समाश्रित्य दीक्षाकालेऽपि नागता .. 5 ..
5.191.m: Resorting to the nature of women, you did not come even at the time of consecration.

5.191.s:
tato vidheḥ samādeśācchakreṇānyā samāhṛtā ..
kācidgopasamudbhūtā kumārī deva rūpiṇī .. 6 ..
5.191.d:
ततो विधेः समादेशाच्छक्रेणान्या समाहृता ..
काचिद्गोपसमुद्भूता कुमारी देव रूपिणी .. 6 ..
5.191.m: Then, by the command of the Creator, another was fetched by Śakra: / a certain maiden born of a cowherd, possessing divine form.

5.191.s:
govaktreṇa praveśyātha guhyamārgeṇa tatkṣaṇāt ..
ākarṣitā mahābhāge samānītātha tatkṣaṇāt .. 7 ..
5.191.d:
गोवक्त्रेण प्रवेश्याथ गुह्यमार्गेण तत्क्षणात् ..
आकर्षिता महाभागे समानीताथ तत्क्षणात् .. 7 ..
5.191.m: Having made her enter through the mouth of a cow, / she was immediately drawn out through the secret passage, O fortunate lady, and brought at once.

5.191.s:
sā viṣṇunā vivāhārthaṃ tataścaivānumoditā ..
īśvareṇa kṛtaṃ nāma gāyatrī ca tavānugam .. 8 ..
5.191.d:
सा विष्णुना विवाहार्थं ततश्चैवानुमोदिता ..
ईश्वरेण कृतं नाम गायत्री च तवानुगम् .. 8 ..
5.191.m: She was then approved by Viṣṇu for marriage, / and Īśvara gave her the name Gāyatrī, subservient to you.

5.191.s:
brāhmaṇaiḥ sakalaiḥ proktaṃ brāhmaṇīti bhavatviyam ..
asmākaṃ vacanādbrahmankuru hastagrahaṃ vibho .. 9 ..
5.191.d:
ब्राह्मणैः सकलैः प्रोक्तं ब्राह्मणीति भवत्वियम् ..
अस्माकं वचनाद्ब्रह्मन्कुरु हस्तग्रहं विभो .. 9 ..
5.191.m: All the brahmins said, "Let her be a brahmin lady. / At our word, O Brahmā, take her hand, O all-pervading Lord!"

5.191.s:
devaiḥ sarvaiḥ sa samproktastatastāṃ ca varānanām ..
tataḥ patnyutthadharmeṇa yojayāmāsa satvaram ..6.192. 10 ..
5.191.d:
देवैः सर्वैः स सम्प्रोक्तस्ततस्तां च वराननाम् ..
ततः पत्न्युत्थधर्मेण योजयामास सत्वरम् ..6.192. 10 ..
5.191.m: Having been urged by all the gods, he then swiftly / united that fair-faced maiden with the duty of a wife.

5.191.s:
kiṃ vā te bahunoktena patnīśālāṃ samāgatā ..
raśanā yojitā tasyā gopyāḥ kaṭyāṃ sureśvari .. 11 ..
5.191.d:
किं वा ते बहुनोक्तेन पत्नीशालां समागता ..
रशना योजिता तस्या गोप्याः कट्यां सुरेश्वरि .. 11 ..
5.191.m: Why say much to you? She has entered the wife's enclosure; / the girdle has been tied on the waist of that cowherd girl, O queen of the gods!

5.191.s:
taddṛṣṭvā garhitaṃ karma niṣkrāṃto yajñamaṇḍapāt ..
amarṣa vaśamāpanno na śakto vīkṣituṃ ca tām .. 12 ..
5.191.d:
तद्दृष्ट्वा गर्हितं कर्म निष्क्रांतो यज्ञमण्डपात् ..
अमर्ष वशमापन्नो न शक्तो वीक्षितुं च ताम् .. 12 ..
5.191.m: Seeing that despicable act, I left the sacrificial pavilion, / overcome by indignation, unable to look at her.

5.191.s:
etajjñātvā mahābhāge yatkṣamaṃ tatsamācara ..
gaccha vā tiṣṭha vā tatra maṇḍape dharmavarjite .. 13 ..
5.191.d:
एतज्ज्ञात्वा महाभागे यत्क्षमं तत्समाचर ..
गच्छ वा तिष्ठ वा तत्र मण्डपे धर्मवर्जिते .. 13 ..
5.191.m: Knowing this, O fortunate lady, do whatever is appropriate; / go, or remain here, [away from] that pavilion devoid of righteousness!'

5.191.s:
tacchrutvā sā tadā devī sāvitrī dvijasattamāḥ ..
pramlānavadanā jātā padminīva himāgame .. 14 ..
5.191.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा सा तदा देवी सावित्री द्विजसत्तमाः ..
प्रम्लानवदना जाता पद्मिनीव हिमागमे .. 14 ..
5.191.m: Hearing that then, O best of twice-born ones, the goddess Sāvitrī / became faded in face, like a lotus at the onset of frost,

5.191.s:
lateva cchinnamūlā sā cakrīva priyavicyutā ..
śuciśuklāgame kāle sarasīva gatodakā .. 15 ..
5.191.d:
लतेव च्छिन्नमूला सा चक्रीव प्रियविच्युता ..
शुचिशुक्लागमे काले सरसीव गतोदका .. 15 ..
5.191.m: like a creeper severed at the root, like a female cakravāka separated from her mate, / like a lake devoid of water at the coming of the bright summer,

5.191.s:
prakṣīṇacandralekheva mṛgīva mṛgavarjitā ..
seneva hatabhūpālā satīva gatabhartṛkā .. 16 ..
5.191.d:
प्रक्षीणचन्द्रलेखेव मृगीव मृगवर्जिता ..
सेनेव हतभूपाला सतीव गतभर्तृका .. 16 ..
5.191.m: like a waning crescent of the moon, like a doe deserted by the deer, / like an army whose king is slain, like a faithful wife whose husband is gone,

5.191.s:
saṃśuṣkā puṣpamāleva mṛtavatsaiva saurabhī ..
vaimanasyaṃ paraṃ gatvā niścalatvamupasthitām ..
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā devapatnyastā jagadurnāradaṃ tadā .. 17 ..
5.191.d:
संशुष्का पुष्पमालेव मृतवत्सैव सौरभी ..
वैमनस्यं परं गत्वा निश्चलत्वमुपस्थिताम् ..
तां दृष्ट्वा देवपत्न्यस्ता जगदुर्नारदं तदा .. 17 ..
5.191.m: like a dried-up flower garland, like a cow whose calf is dead. / Having reached supreme dejection and arrived at motionless grief, / seeing her, those wives of the gods then said to Nārada:

5.191.s:
dhigdhikkalipriya tvāṃ ca rāge vairāgyakārakam ..
tvayā kṛtaṃ sarvametadvidhestasya tathāntaram .. 18 ..
5.191.d:
धिग्धिक्कलिप्रिय त्वां च रागे वैराग्यकारकम् ..
त्वया कृतं सर्वमेतद्विधेस्तस्य तथान्तरम् .. 18 ..
5.191.m: 'Fie, fie on you, lover of strife, who causes aversion where there was love! / All this rift between her and Brahmā has been caused by you!'

5.191.s:
.. gauryuvāca .. ..
ayaṃ kalipriyo devi brūte satyānṛtaṃ vacaḥ ..
anena karmaṇā prāṇānbibhartyeṣa sadā muniḥ .. 19 ..
5.191.d:
.. गौर्युवाच .. ..
अयं कलिप्रियो देवि ब्रूते सत्यानृतं वचः ..
अनेन कर्मणा प्राणान्बिभर्त्येष सदा मुनिः .. 19 ..
5.191.m: Gaurī said: / 'O goddess, this lover of strife speaks words of truth mingled with falsehood; / by this conduct this sage always sustains his life.

5.191.s:
ahaṃ tryakṣeṇa sāvitri purā proktā muhurmuhuḥ ..
nāradasya munervākyaṃ na śraddheyaṃ tvayā priye ..
yadi vāṃchasi saukhyāni mama jātāni pārvati .. 6.192.20 ..
5.191.d:
अहं त्र्यक्षेण सावित्रि पुरा प्रोक्ता मुहुर्मुहुः ..
नारदस्य मुनेर्वाक्यं न श्रद्धेयं त्वया प्रिये ..
यदि वांछसि सौख्यानि मम जातानि पार्वति .. 6.192.20 ..
5.191.m: Formerly, Sāvitrī, I was repeatedly told by the Three-Eyed Lord: / "The word of the sage Nārada is not to be trusted by you, my dear, / if you desire the happiness born of me, O Pārvatī."'

5.191.s:
tataḥprabhṛti naivāhaṃ śraddadhe'sya vacaḥ kvacit ..
tasmādgacchāmahe tatra yatra tiṣṭhati te patiḥ .. 21 ..
5.191.d:
ततःप्रभृति नैवाहं श्रद्दधेऽस्य वचः क्वचित् ..
तस्माद्गच्छामहे तत्र यत्र तिष्ठति ते पतिः .. 21 ..
5.191.m: From that time on, I have never believed his words anywhere. / Therefore, let us go there, where your husband is staying.

5.191.s:
svayaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva vṛttāṃtaṃ kartavyaṃ yatkṣamaṃ tataḥ ..
nātrāsya vacanādadya sthātavyaṃ tatra gamyatām .. 22 ..
5.191.d:
स्वयं दृष्ट्वैव वृत्तांतं कर्तव्यं यत्क्षमं ततः ..
नात्रास्य वचनादद्य स्थातव्यं तत्र गम्यताम् .. 22 ..
5.191.m: Having seen the matter for ourselves, we must do whatever is fitting then. / We should not remain here today on his word alone; let us go there.

5.191.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
gauryā stadvacanaṃ śrutvā sāvitrī harṣavarjitā ..
makhamaṇḍapamuddiśya praskhalantī padepade .. 23 ..
5.191.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
गौर्या स्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सावित्री हर्षवर्जिता ..
मखमण्डपमुद्दिश्य प्रस्खलन्ती पदेपदे .. 23 ..
5.191.m: Sūta said: / Hearing that statement of Gaurī, Sāvitrī, bereft of joy, / set out toward the sacrificial pavilion, stumbling at every step.

5.191.s:
prajagāma dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ śūnyena manasā tadā ..
pratibhāti tadā gītaṃ tasyā madhuramapyaho .. 24 ..
5.191.d:
प्रजगाम द्विजश्रेष्ठाः शून्येन मनसा तदा ..
प्रतिभाति तदा गीतं तस्या मधुरमप्यहो .. 24 ..
5.191.m: She went, O best of brahmins, with an empty mind then. / Ah, then singing seemed sweet to her [no longer];

5.191.s:
karṇaśūlaṃ yathā''yātamasakṛddvijasattamāḥ ..
vandhyavādyaṃ yathā vādyaṃ mṛdaṃgānakapūrvakam .. 25 ..
5.191.d:
कर्णशूलं यथा'ऽयातमसकृद्द्विजसत्तमाः ..
वन्ध्यवाद्यं यथा वाद्यं मृदंगानकपूर्वकम् .. 25 ..
5.191.m: as if ear-pain had arrived repeatedly, O best of brahmins, / as if instrumental music accompanied by mṛdaṅgas and ānakas were futile noise,

5.191.s:
pretasaṃdarśanaṃ yadvanmartyaṃ tatsā mahāsatī ..
vīkṣituṃ na ca śakroti gacchamānā tadā makhe .. 26 ..
5.191.d:
प्रेतसंदर्शनं यद्वन्मर्त्यं तत्सा महासती ..
वीक्षितुं न च शक्रोति गच्छमाना तदा मखे .. 26 ..
5.191.m: just like seeing a corpse, so did that mortal sight appear; that chaste lady, / going to the sacrifice then, was unable even to look upon it.

5.191.s:
śṛṃgāraṃ ca tathāṃgāraṃ manyate sā tanusthitam ..
vāṣpapūrṇekṣaṇā dīnā prajagāma mahāsatī .. 27 ..
5.191.d:
शृंगारं च तथांगारं मन्यते सा तनुस्थितम् ..
वाष्पपूर्णेक्षणा दीना प्रजगाम महासती .. 27 ..
5.191.m: And she considered the adornment on her body to be embers. / Her eyes filled with tears, miserable, that chaste lady proceeded.

5.191.s:
tataḥ kṛcchrātsamāsādya saivaṃ taṃ yajñamaṃḍapam ..
kṛcchrātkārāgṛhaṃ tadvadduṣprekṣyaṃ dṛkpathaṃ gatam .. 28 ..
5.191.d:
ततः कृच्छ्रात्समासाद्य सैवं तं यज्ञमंडपम् ..
कृच्छ्रात्कारागृहं तद्वद्दुष्प्रेक्ष्यं दृक्पथं गतम् .. 28 ..
5.191.m: Then, having reached that sacrificial pavilion with difficulty, / she saw it entering her field of vision like a hard-to-look-at prison.

5.191.s:
atha dṛṣṭvā tu saṃprāptāṃ sāvitrīṃ yajñamaṇḍapam ..
tatkṣaṇācca caturvaktraḥ saṃsthito'dhomukho hriyā. .. 29 ..
5.191.d:
अथ दृष्ट्वा तु संप्राप्तां सावित्रीं यज्ञमण्डपम् ..
तत्क्षणाच्च चतुर्वक्त्रः संस्थितोऽधोमुखो ह्रिया. .. 29 ..
5.191.m: Now, seeing Sāvitrī arrived at the sacrificial pavilion, / from that very instant the Four-faced one stood with his face turned down in shame.

5.191.s:
tathā śambhuśca śakraśca vāsudevastathaiva ca ..
ye cānye vibudhāstatra saṃsthitā yajñamaṃḍape .. 6.192.30 ..
5.191.d:
तथा शम्भुश्च शक्रश्च वासुदेवस्तथैव च ..
ये चान्ये विबुधास्तत्र संस्थिता यज्ञमंडपे .. 6.192.30 ..
5.191.m: Likewise Śambhu, Śakra, and Vāsudeva as well, / and whatever other gods were staying there in the sacrificial pavilion,

5.191.s:
te ca brāhmaṇaśārdūlāstyaktvā vedadhvaniṃ tataḥ ..
mūkībhāvaṃ gatāḥ sarve bhayasaṃtrastamānasāḥ ..31..
5.191.d:
ते च ब्राह्मणशार्दूलास्त्यक्त्वा वेदध्वनिं ततः ..
मूकीभावं गताः सर्वे भयसंत्रस्तमानसाः ..31..
5.191.m: and those tigers among brahmins, ceasing the sound of the Vedas then, / all became silent, their minds terrified with fear.

5.191.s:
atha saṃvīkṣya sāvitrī sapatnyā sahitaṃ patim ..
kopasaṃraktanayanā paruṣaṃ vākyamabravīt .. 32 ..
5.191.d:
अथ संवीक्ष्य सावित्री सपत्न्या सहितं पतिम् ..
कोपसंरक्तनयना परुषं वाक्यमब्रवीत् .. 32 ..
5.191.m: Then, seeing her husband accompanied by a co-wife, Sāvitrī, / her eyes bloodshot with rage, spoke harsh words:

5.191.s:
.. sāvitryuvāca .. ..
kimetadyujyate kartuṃ tava vṛddha tamākṛte ..
ūḍhavānasi yatpatnīmetāṃ gopasamudbhavām .. 33 ..
5.191.d:
.. सावित्र्युवाच .. ..
किमेतद्युज्यते कर्तुं तव वृद्ध तमाकृते ..
ऊढवानसि यत्पत्नीमेतां गोपसमुद्भवाम् .. 33 ..
5.191.m: Sāvitrī said: / How is it fitting for you to do this, O old one in dark form, / that you have married this wife born of a cowherd?

5.191.s:
ubhayoḥ pakṣayoryasyāḥ strīṇāṃ kāṃtā yathepsitāḥ ..
śaucācāraparityaktā dharmakṛtyaparāṅmukhāḥ .. 34 ..
5.191.d:
उभयोः पक्षयोर्यस्याः स्त्रीणां कांता यथेप्सिताः ..
शौचाचारपरित्यक्ता धर्मकृत्यपराङ्मुखाः .. 34 ..
5.191.m: On both sides of her lineage, women have lovers as they please; / they are abandoned by purity and conduct, turned away from righteous deeds.

5.191.s:
yadanvaye janāḥ sarve paśudharmaratotsavāḥ ..
sodaryāṃ bhaginīṃ tyaktvā jananīṃ ca tathā parām .. 35 ...
5.191.d:
यदन्वये जनाः सर्वे पशुधर्मरतोत्सवाः ..
सोदर्यां भगिनीं त्यक्त्वा जननीं च तथा पराम् .. 35 ...
5.191.m: In her lineage, all the people delight in the festivities of animal behavior; / abandoning their uterine sister and likewise their mother, [they mate with] another.

5.191.s:
tasyāḥ kule prasevaṃte sarvāṃ nārīṃ janāḥ parām ..
yathā hi paśavo'śnaṃti tṛṇāni jalapānagāḥ .. 36 ..
viṇmūtraṃ kevalaṃ cakrurbhārodvahanameva ca ..9
5.191.d:
तस्याः कुले प्रसेवंते सर्वां नारीं जनाः पराम् ..
यथा हि पशवोऽश्नंति तृणानि जलपानगाः .. 36 ..
विण्मूत्रं केवलं चक्रुर्भारोद्वहनमेव च ..9
5.191.m:
In her family, men frequent every other woman; / for just as animals eat grass and drink water,
and merely discharge feces and urine, carrying loads alone,

5.191.s: tadvadasyāḥ kulaṃ sarvaṃ takramaśrāti kevalam .. 37 ..
5.191.d: तद्वदस्याः कुलं सर्वं तक्रमश्राति केवलम् .. 37 ..
5.191.m: just so does her entire family merely consume buttermilk.

5.191.s:
kṛtvā mūtrapurīṣaṃ ca janmabhogavivarjitam ..
nānyajjānāti kartavyaṃ dharmaṃ svodarasaṃ śrayāt .. 38 ..
5.191.d:
कृत्वा मूत्रपुरीषं च जन्मभोगविवर्जितम् ..
नान्यज्जानाति कर्तव्यं धर्मं स्वोदरसं श्रयात् .. 38 ..
5.191.m: Discharging urine and feces, devoid of the enjoyment of birth, / relying solely on their own bellies, they know no other duty or righteousness.

5.191.s:
antyajā api no karma yatkurvanti vigarhitam ..
ābhīrāstacca kurvaṃti tatkimetattvayā kṛtam .. 39 ..
5.191.d:
अन्त्यजा अपि नो कर्म यत्कुर्वन्ति विगर्हितम् ..
आभीरास्तच्च कुर्वंति तत्किमेतत्त्वया कृतम् .. 39 ..
5.191.m: Even outcasts do not commit the despicable deed / which the Ābhīras commit; then why was this done by you?

5.191.s:
avaśyaṃ yadi te kāryaṃ bhāryayā parayā makhe ..
tvayā vā brāhmaṇī kāpi prakhyātā bhuvanatraye .. 6.192.40 ..
5.191.d:
अवश्यं यदि ते कार्यं भार्यया परया मखे ..
त्वया वा ब्राह्मणी कापि प्रख्याता भुवनत्रये .. 6.192.40 ..
5.191.m: If another wife was necessarily needed by you at the sacrifice, / you [should have married] some brahmin woman renowned in the three worlds.

5.191.s:
noḍhā vidhe vṛthā muṇḍa nūnaṃ dhūrto'si me mataḥ ..
yattvayā śaucasaṃtyaktā kanyābhāvapradūṣitā..41..
5.191.d:
नोढा विधे वृथा मुण्ड नूनं धूर्तोऽसि मे मतः ..
यत्त्वया शौचसंत्यक्ता कन्याभावप्रदूषिता..41..
5.191.m: She was not married, O Vidhi! You shaved-head fool, surely you are a rogue in my view, / since you took a girl abandoned by purity, corrupted in maidhood,

5.191.s:
prabhuktā bahubhiḥ pūrvaṃ tathā gopakumārikā..
eṣā prāptā supāpāḍhyā veśyājanaśatādhikā..42..
5.191.d:
प्रभुक्ता बहुभिः पूर्वं तथा गोपकुमारिका..
एषा प्राप्ता सुपापाढ्या वेश्याजनशताधिका..42..
5.191.m: already enjoyed by many previously, a cowherd girl, / this woman full of great sin, worse than a hundred courtesans!

5.191.s:
antyajātā tathā kanyā kṣatayoniḥ prajāyate..
tathā gopakumārī ca kācittādṛkprajāyate..43..
5.191.d:
अन्त्यजाता तथा कन्या क्षतयोनिः प्रजायते..
तथा गोपकुमारी च काचित्तादृक्प्रजायते..43..
5.191.m: Just as an outcast maiden is born with a deflowered womb, / so is some cowherd girl born such.

5.191.s:
mātṛkaṃ paitṛkaṃ vaṃśaṃ śvāśuraṃ ca prapātayet.
tasmādetena kṛtyena garhitena dharātale..44..
na tvaṃ prāpsyasi tāṃ pūjāṃ tathā nye vibudhottamāḥ..
anena karmaṇā caiva yadi me sti ṛtaṃ kvacit..44..
5.191.d:
मातृकं पैतृकं वंशं श्वाशुरं च प्रपातयेत्.
तस्मादेतेन कृत्येन गर्हितेन धरातले..44..
न त्वं प्राप्स्यसि तां पूजां तथा न्ये विबुधोत्तमाः..
अनेन कर्मणा चैव यदि मे स्ति ऋतं क्वचित्..44..
5.191.m:
She ruins the maternal, paternal, and father-in-law's lineages. / Therefore, because of this despicable deed on the earth's surface,
you will not receive that worship, nor will the other best of gods, / through this action, if there is any truth in me anywhere!

5.191.s:
pūjāṃ ye ca kariṣyaṃti bhaviṣyaṃti ca nirdhanāḥ..
kathaṃ na lajjitosi tvametatkurvanvigarhitam..46..
5.191.d:
पूजां ये च करिष्यंति भविष्यंति च निर्धनाः..
कथं न लज्जितोसि त्वमेतत्कुर्वन्विगर्हितम्..46..
5.191.m: And those who will perform worship [to you] will become penniless. / How were you not ashamed, doing this despicable act,

5.191.s:
putrāṇāmatha pautrāṇāmanyeṣāṃ ca divaukasām..
ayogyaṃ caiva viprāṇāṃ yadetatkṛtavānasi..47..
5.191.d:
पुत्राणामथ पौत्राणामन्येषां च दिवौकसाम्..
अयोग्यं चैव विप्राणां यदेतत्कृतवानसि..47..
5.191.m: unworthy of your sons, grandsons, and the other celestials, / and unworthy of brahmins, that you have done this?

5.191.s:
atha vā naiṣa doṣaste na kāmavaśagā narāḥ..
lajjaṃti ca vijānaṃti kṛtyākṛtyaṃ śubhāśubham..48..
5.191.d:
अथ वा नैष दोषस्ते न कामवशगा नराः..
लज्जंति च विजानंति कृत्याकृत्यं शुभाशुभम्..48..
5.191.m: Or rather, this is not your fault: men overwhelmed by lust / feel no shame and do not discern what ought to be done from what ought not, auspicious from inauspicious.

5.191.s:
akṛtyaṃ manyate kṛtyaṃ mitraṃ śatruṃ ca manyate..
śatruṃ ca manyate mitraṃ janaḥ kāmavaśaṃ gataḥ..49..
5.191.d:
अकृत्यं मन्यते कृत्यं मित्रं शत्रुं च मन्यते..
शत्रुं च मन्यते मित्रं जनः कामवशं गतः..49..
5.191.m: A person gone under the sway of lust considers what should not be done as what should be done, / considers a friend an enemy, and considers an enemy a friend.

5.191.s:
dyūtakāre yathā satyaṃ yathā cauraṃ ca sauhṛdam..
yathā nṛpasya no mitraṃ tathā lajjā na kāminām..6.192.50..
5.191.d:
द्यूतकारे यथा सत्यं यथा चौरं च सौहृदम्..
यथा नृपस्य नो मित्रं तथा लज्जा न कामिनाम्..6.192.50..
5.191.m: Just as truth is absent in a gambler, and friendship in a thief, / just as a king has no friend, so lustful men have no shame.

5.191.s:
api syācchītalo vahniścaṃdramā dahanātmakaḥ.
kṣārābdirapi miṣṭaḥ syānna kāmī lajjate dhruvam..51..
5.191.d:
अपि स्याच्छीतलो वह्निश्चंद्रमा दहनात्मकः.
क्षाराब्दिरपि मिष्टः स्यान्न कामी लज्जते ध्रुवम्..51..
5.191.m: Fire might become cold, the moon might become scorching, / even the salty ocean might become sweet, but a lustful man surely feels no shame.

5.191.s:
na me syāddukhametaddhi yatsāpatnyamupasthitam..
sahasramapi nārīṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ yathā bhavet.. 52..
5.191.d:
न मे स्याद्दुखमेतद्धि यत्सापत्न्यमुपस्थितम्..
सहस्रमपि नारीणां पुरुषाणां यथा भवेत्.. 52..
5.191.m: This grief would not be mine merely because a co-wife has appeared; / for men may have even a thousand women,

5.191.s:
kulīnānāṃ ca śuddhānāṃ svajātyānāṃ viśeṣataḥ..
tvaṃ kuruṣva parāṇāṃ ca yadi kāmavaśaṃ gataḥ..53..
5.191.d:
कुलीनानां च शुद्धानां स्वजात्यानां विशेषतः..
त्वं कुरुष्व पराणां च यदि कामवशं गतः..53..
5.191.m: of noble birth, pure, and especially belonging to their own caste. / Take others, if you are overwhelmed by lust!

5.191.s:
etatpunarmahadduḥkhaṃ yadābhīrī vigarhitā..
veśyeva naṣṭacāritrā tvayoḍhā bahubhartṛkā .. 54 ..
5.191.d:
एतत्पुनर्महद्दुःखं यदाभीरी विगर्हिता..
वेश्येव नष्टचारित्रा त्वयोढा बहुभर्तृका .. 54 ..
5.191.m: Yet this is a great grief: that a despicable Ābhīra woman, / ruined in conduct like a courtesan, having many husbands, has been married by you!

5.191.s:
tasmādahaṃ prayāsyāmi yatra nāma na te vidhe ..
śrūyate kāmalubdhasya hriyā parihṛtasya ca .. 55 ..
5.191.d:
तस्मादहं प्रयास्यामि यत्र नाम न ते विधे ..
श्रूयते कामलुब्धस्य ह्रिया परिहृतस्य च .. 55 ..
5.191.m: Therefore I shall depart, O Vidhi, where your name is not heard— / you who are greedy with lust and abandoned by shame!

5.191.s:
ahaṃ viḍaṃbitā yasmādatrānīya tvayā vidhe ..
purato devapatnīnāṃ devānāṃ ca dvijanmanām ..
tasmātpūjāṃ na te kaścitsāṃprataṃ prakariṣyati .. 56 ..
5.191.d:
अहं विडंबिता यस्मादत्रानीय त्वया विधे ..
पुरतो देवपत्नीनां देवानां च द्विजन्मनाम् ..
तस्मात्पूजां न ते कश्चित्सांप्रतं प्रकरिष्यति .. 56 ..
5.191.m: Because I have been humiliated, brought here by you, O Vidhi, / in the presence of the wives of the gods, the gods, and the twice-born, / therefore no one shall perform worship to you henceforth.

5.191.s:
adya prabhṛti yaḥ pūjāṃ maṃtrapūjāṃ kariṣyati ..
tava martyo dharāpṛṣṭhe yathānyeṣāṃ divaukasām .. 57 ..
5.191.d:
अद्य प्रभृति यः पूजां मंत्रपूजां करिष्यति ..
तव मर्त्यो धरापृष्ठे यथान्येषां दिवौकसाम् .. 57 ..
5.191.m: From this day forward, whatever mortal on the surface of the earth / performs worship or mantra-worship to you, as to other celestials,

5.191.s:
bhaviṣyati ca tadvaṃśo daridro duḥkhasaṃyutaḥ ..
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vāpi vaiśyaḥ śūdropi cālaye .. 58 ..
5.191.d:
भविष्यति च तद्वंशो दरिद्रो दुःखसंयुतः ..
ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वापि वैश्यः शूद्रोपि चालये .. 58 ..
5.191.m: his lineage will become impoverished and full of sorrow, / whether he be a brahmin, a kṣatriya, a vaiśya, or even a śūdra in his home.

5.191.s:
eṣā'bhīrasutā yasmānmama sthāne vigarhitā ..
bhaviṣyati na saṃtānastasmādvākyānmamaiva hi .. 59 ..
5.191.d:
एषाऽभीरसुता यस्मान्मम स्थाने विगर्हिता ..
भविष्यति न संतानस्तस्माद्वाक्यान्ममैव हि .. 59 ..
5.191.m: Because this despicable daughter of an Ābhīra stands in my place, / by my very word she shall have no offspring.

5.191.s: na pūjāṃ lapsyate loke yathānyā devayoṣitaḥ .. 6.192.60 ..
5.191.d: न पूजां लप्स्यते लोके यथान्या देवयोषितः .. 6.192.60 ..
5.191.m: She will not obtain worship in the world like the other wives of the gods.

5.191.s:
kariṣyati ca yā nārī pūjā yasyā api kvacit ..
sā bhaviṣyati duḥkhāḍhyā vaṃdhyā daurbhāgyasaṃyutā .. 61 ..
5.191.d:
करिष्यति च या नारी पूजा यस्या अपि क्वचित् ..
सा भविष्यति दुःखाढ्या वंध्या दौर्भाग्यसंयुता .. 61 ..
5.191.m: And whatever woman performs worship to her anywhere, / she will become full of misery, barren, and afflicted with misfortune.

5.191.s:
pāpiṣṭhā naṣṭacāritrā yathaiṣā paṃcabhartṛkā ..
vikhyātiṃ yāsyate loke yathā cāsau tathaiva sā .. 62 ..
5.191.d:
पापिष्ठा नष्टचारित्रा यथैषा पंचभर्तृका ..
विख्यातिं यास्यते लोके यथा चासौ तथैव सा .. 62 ..
5.191.m: Most sinful, ruined in conduct, like this woman who has five husbands, / she will become renowned in the world, just as this one is.

5.191.s:
etasyā anvayaḥ pāpo bhaviṣyati niśācara ..
satyaśaucaparityaktāḥ śiṣṭasaṃgavivarjitāḥ .. 63 ..
5.191.d:
एतस्या अन्वयः पापो भविष्यति निशाचर ..
सत्यशौचपरित्यक्ताः शिष्टसंगविवर्जिताः .. 63 ..
5.191.m: Her lineage will be sinful, roving by night, / abandoned by truth and purity, devoid of the company of the virtuous.

5.191.s:
aniketā bhaviṣyaṃti vaṃśe'syā goprajīvinaḥ ..
evaṃ śaptvā vidhiṃ sādhvī gāyatrīṃ ca tataḥ param .. 64 ..
5.191.d:
अनिकेता भविष्यंति वंशेऽस्या गोप्रजीविनः ..
एवं शप्त्वा विधिं साध्वी गायत्रीं च ततः परम् .. 64 ..
5.191.m: Living off cattle, those in her lineage will become homeless wanderers. / Having thus cursed Vidhi, and thereafter the chaste Gāyatrī,

5.191.s:
tato devagaṇānsarvāñchaśāpa ca tadā satī ..
bhobhoḥ śakra tvayānītā yadeṣā paṃcabhartṛkā .. 65 ..
5.191.d:
ततो देवगणान्सर्वाञ्छशाप च तदा सती ..
भोभोः शक्र त्वयानीता यदेषा पंचभर्तृका .. 65 ..
5.191.m:
Then the chaste woman also cursed all the hosts of gods:
"O Śakra, since this woman who has five husbands was brought by you,

5.191.s:
tadāpnuhi phalaṃ samyakchubhaṃ kṛtvā guroridam ..
tvaṃ śatrubhirjito yuddhe baṃdhanaṃ samavāpsyasi .. 66 ..
5.191.d:
तदाप्नुहि फलं सम्यक्छुभं कृत्वा गुरोरिदम् ..
त्वं शत्रुभिर्जितो युद्धे बंधनं समवाप्स्यसि .. 66 ..
5.191.m:
therefore receive the full fruit of having performed this [service] for your elder:
Conquered by enemies in battle, you shall suffer imprisonment.

5.191.s:
kārāgāre ciraṃ kālaṃ saṃgamiṣyatyasaṃśayam ..
vāsudeva tvayā yasmādeṣā vai paṃcabhartṛkā .. 67 ..
5.191.d:
कारागारे चिरं कालं संगमिष्यत्यसंशयम् ..
वासुदेव त्वया यस्मादेषा वै पंचभर्तृका .. 67 ..
5.191.m:
You will without doubt go into a dungeon for a long time!
O Vāsudeva, because this woman who has five husbands

5.191.s:
anumoditā vidheḥ pūrvaṃ tasmācchapsyāmyasaṃśayam ..
tvaṃ cāpi parabhṛtyatvaṃ saṃprāpsyasi sudurmate .. 68 ..
5.191.d:
अनुमोदिता विधेः पूर्वं तस्माच्छप्स्याम्यसंशयम् ..
त्वं चापि परभृत्यत्वं संप्राप्स्यसि सुदुर्मते .. 68 ..
5.191.m:
was approved by you beforehand for Brahmā, therefore I shall curse you without doubt:
You too, O most wicked-minded one, shall become the servant of another!

5.191.s:
samīpastho'pi rudra tvaṃ karmaitadyadupekṣase ..
niṣedhayasi no mūḍha tasmācśṛṇu vaco mama .. 69 ..
5.191.d:
समीपस्थोऽपि रुद्र त्वं कर्मैतद्यदुपेक्षसे ..
निषेधयसि नो मूढ तस्माच्शृणु वचो मम .. 69 ..
5.191.m: O Rudra, though standing near, because you overlook this deed / and do not forbid it, O fool, therefore hear my word:

5.191.s:
jīvamānasya kāṃtasya mayā tadvirahodbhavam ..
saṃsevitaṃ mṛtāyāṃ te dayitāyāṃ bhaviṣyati .. 6.192.70 ..
5.191.d:
जीवमानस्य कांतस्य मया तद्विरहोद्भवम् ..
संसेवितं मृतायां ते दयितायां भविष्यति .. 6.192.70 ..
5.191.m:
While my husband is alive, I have experienced the [grief] born of separation from him;
the same shall be experienced by you when your beloved wife has died!

5.191.s:
yatra yajñe praviṣṭeyaṃ garhitā paṃcabhartṛkā ..
bhavānapi havirvahne yattvaṃ gṛhṇāsi laulyataḥ .. 71 ..
5.191.d:
यत्र यज्ञे प्रविष्टेयं गर्हिता पंचभर्तृका ..
भवानपि हविर्वह्ने यत्त्वं गृह्णासि लौल्यतः .. 71 ..
5.191.m:
In this sacrifice where this censured woman who has five husbands has entered,
and since you, O Fire, accept the oblation out of greed,

5.191.s:
tathānyeṣu ca yajñeṣu samyakchaṃkāvivarjitaḥ ..
tasmādduṣṭasamācāra sarvabhakṣo bhaviṣyasi .. 72 ..
5.191.d:
तथान्येषु च यज्ञेषु सम्यक्छंकाविवर्जितः ..
तस्माद्दुष्टसमाचार सर्वभक्षो भविष्यसि .. 72 ..
5.191.m:
as well as in other sacrifices, completely devoid of scruples,
therefore, O you of evil conduct, you shall be an eater of all things!

5.191.s:
svadhayā svāhayā sārdhaṃ sadā duḥkhasamanvitaḥ ..
naivāpsyasi paraṃ saukhyaṃ sarvakālaṃ yathā purā .. 73 ..
5.191.d:
स्वधया स्वाहया सार्धं सदा दुःखसमन्वितः ..
नैवाप्स्यसि परं सौख्यं सर्वकालं यथा पुरा .. 73 ..
5.191.m:
Together with Svadhā and Svāhā, constantly beset with sorrow,
you shall never obtain supreme happiness at all times, as before!

5.191.s:
ete ca brāhmaṇāḥ sarve lobhopahatacetasaḥ ..
homaṃ prakurvate ye ca makhe cāpi vigarhite. 74 ..
5.191.d:
एते च ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे लोभोपहतचेतसः ..
होमं प्रकुर्वते ये च मखे चापि विगर्हिते. 74 ..
5.191.m:
And all these brahmins, their minds corrupted by greed,
who perform the oblation in this censured sacrifice as well,

5.191.s:
vittalobhena yatraiṣā niviṣṭā pañcabhartṛkā ..
tathā ca vacanaṃ proktaṃ brāhmaṇīyaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 75 ..
5.191.d:
वित्तलोभेन यत्रैषा निविष्टा पञ्चभर्तृका ..
तथा च वचनं प्रोक्तं ब्राह्मणीयं भविष्यति .. 75 ..
5.191.m:
where out of greed for wealth this woman who has five husbands was installed—
so the word pronounced concerning the brahmins shall come to pass:

5.191.s:
daridropahatāstasmādvṛṣalīpatayastathā ..
vedavikrayakartāro bhaviṣyatha na saṃśayaḥ .. 76 ..
5.191.d:
दरिद्रोपहतास्तस्माद्वृषलीपतयस्तथा ..
वेदविक्रयकर्तारो भविष्यथ न संशयः .. 76 ..
5.191.m:
Therefore, afflicted by poverty, husbands of Śūdra women,
sellers of the Veda you shall become, there is no doubt!

5.191.s:
bhobho vittapate vittaṃ dadāsi makhaviplave ..
tasmādyatte'khilaṃ vittamabhogyaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati .. 77 ..
5.191.d:
भोभो वित्तपते वित्तं ददासि मखविप्लवे ..
तस्माद्यत्तेऽखिलं वित्तमभोग्यं संभविष्यति .. 77 ..
5.191.m:
O lord of wealth, you give wealth at the disruption of a sacrifice;
therefore whatever wealth you have shall become unenjoyable!

5.191.s:
tathā devagaṇāḥ sarve sāhāyyaṃ ye samāśritāḥ ..
atra kurvaṃti doṣāḍhye yajñe vai pāṃcabhartṛke .. 78 ..
5.191.d:
तथा देवगणाः सर्वे साहाय्यं ये समाश्रिताः ..
अत्र कुर्वंति दोषाढ्ये यज्ञे वै पांचभर्तृके .. 78 ..
5.191.m:
Likewise, all the hosts of gods who have lent their assistance
and act here in this fault-filled sacrifice involving the woman with five husbands—

5.191.s:
saṃtānena parityaktāste bhaviṣyaṃti sāṃpratam..
dānavaiśca parābhūtā duḥkhaṃ prāpsyati kevalam .. 79 ..
5.191.d:
संतानेन परित्यक्तास्ते भविष्यंति सांप्रतम्..
दानवैश्च पराभूता दुःखं प्राप्स्यति केवलम् .. 79 ..
5.191.m:
they shall now be bereft of offspring;
and defeated by the Dānavas, they will experience only sorrow!

5.191.s:
etasyāḥ pārśvataścānyāścatasro yā vyavasthitāḥ ..
ābhīrīti sapa tnīti proktā dhyānapraharṣitāḥ .. 6.192.80 ..
5.191.d:
एतस्याः पार्श्वतश्चान्याश्चतस्रो या व्यवस्थिताः ..
आभीरीति सप त्नीति प्रोक्ता ध्यानप्रहर्षिताः .. 6.192.80 ..
5.191.m:
And the other four women standing at her side,
called cowherdesses and co-wives, rejoicing in meditation,

5.191.s:
mama dveṣaparā nityaṃ śivadūtīpurassarāḥ ..
tāsāṃ parasparaṃ saṃgaḥ kadācicca bhaviṣyati .. 81 ..
5.191.d:
मम द्वेषपरा नित्यं शिवदूतीपुरस्सराः ..
तासां परस्परं संगः कदाचिच्च भविष्यति .. 81 ..
5.191.m:
constantly intent on malice toward me, headed by Śivadūtī—
their meeting with one another shall be only occasional.

5.191.s:
nānyenātra nareṇāpi dṛṣṭimātramapi kṣitau ..
parvatāgreṣu durgeṣu cāgamyeṣu ca dehinām ..
vāsaḥ saṃpatsyate nityaṃ sarvabhogavivarjitaḥ .. 82 ..
5.191.d:
नान्येनात्र नरेणापि दृष्टिमात्रमपि क्षितौ ..
पर्वताग्रेषु दुर्गेषु चागम्येषु च देहिनाम् ..
वासः संपत्स्यते नित्यं सर्वभोगविवर्जितः .. 82 ..

5.191.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evamuktvā'tha sāvitrīkopopahatacetasā ..
visṛjya devapatnīstāḥ sarvā yāḥ pārśvataḥ sthitāḥ .. 83 ..
5.191.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्त्वाऽथ सावित्रीकोपोपहतचेतसा ..
विसृज्य देवपत्नीस्ताः सर्वा याः पार्श्वतः स्थिताः .. 83 ..
5.191.m:
Sūta said:
Having spoken thus, Sāvitrī, her mind overwhelmed by rage,
dismissed all the wives of the gods who stood at her side,

5.191.s:
udaṅmukhī pratasthe ca vāryamāṇāpi sarvataḥ ..
sarvābhirdevapatnībhirlakṣmīpūrvābhirevaca ..84..
5.191.d:
उदङ्मुखी प्रतस्थे च वार्यमाणापि सर्वतः ..
सर्वाभिर्देवपत्नीभिर्लक्ष्मीपूर्वाभिरेवच ..84..
5.191.m:
and set out facing north, even though restrained on every side
by all the wives of the gods, headed by Lakṣmī.

5.191.s:
tatra yāsyāmi no yatra nāmāpi kila vai yataḥ ..
śrūyate kāmukasyāsya tatra yāsyāmyahaṃ drutam ..85..
5.191.d:
तत्र यास्यामि नो यत्र नामापि किल वै यतः ..
श्रूयते कामुकस्यास्य तत्र यास्याम्यहं द्रुतम् ..85..
5.191.m:
"I will go where not even the name of this lustful one
is heard; indeed, thither will I swiftly go!"

5.191.s:
ekaścaraṇayornyasto vāmaḥ parvatarodhasi ..
dvitīyena samārūḍhā tasyāgasya tathopari ..86..
5.191.d:
एकश्चरणयोर्न्यस्तो वामः पर्वतरोधसि ..
द्वितीयेन समारूढा तस्यागस्य तथोपरि ..86..
5.191.m:
One of her feet, the left, was placed on the mountain slope;
with the second she stepped onto the top of that mountain.

5.191.s:
adyāpi tatpadaṃ vāmaṃ tasyāstatra pradṛśyate ..
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sthitaṃ parvatarodhasi .. 87 ..
5.191.d:
अद्यापि तत्पदं वामं तस्यास्तत्र प्रदृश्यते ..
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं स्थितं पर्वतरोधसि .. 87 ..
5.191.m:
Even today that left footprint of hers is seen there,
meritorious, destroying all sins, resting on the mountain slope.

5.191.s:
api pāpasamācāro yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ ..
sarvapātakanirmuktaḥ sa yāti paramaṃ padam .. 88 ..
5.191.d:
अपि पापसमाचारो यस्तं पूजयते नरः ..
सर्वपातकनिर्मुक्तः स याति परमं पदम् .. 88 ..
5.191.m:
Even a man of sinful conduct who worships it,
freed from all sins, goes to the supreme abode.

5.191.s:
yo yaṃ kāmamabhi dhyāya tamarcayati mānavaḥ ..
avaśyaṃ samavāpnoti yadyapi syātsudurlabham.. 89 ..
5.191.d:
यो यं काममभि ध्याय तमर्चयति मानवः ..
अवश्यं समवाप्नोति यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम्.. 89 ..
5.191.m:
Whatever desire a mortal meditates upon and worships it,
he surely attains, even if it be very hard to obtain.

5.191.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ tatra sthitā devī sāvitrī parvatā śrayā ..
apamānaṃ mahatprāpya sakāśātsvapatestadā .. 6.192.90 ..
5.191.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं तत्र स्थिता देवी सावित्री पर्वता श्रया ..
अपमानं महत्प्राप्य सकाशात्स्वपतेस्तदा .. 6.192.90 ..
5.191.m:
Sūta said:
Thus goddess Sāvitrī dwelt there, resorting to the mountain,
having received great insult on that occasion from her own husband.

5.191.s:
yastāmarcayate samyakpaurṇamāsyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti sa manovāṃchitāṃ stadā .. 91 ..
5.191.d:
यस्तामर्चयते सम्यक्पौर्णमास्यां विशेषतः ..
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति स मनोवांछितां स्तदा .. 91 ..
5.191.m:
Whoever worships her properly, especially on the full-moon day,
obtains at that time all desires cherished in his heart.

5.191.s:
yā nārī kurute bhaktyā dīpadānaṃ tadagrataḥ ..
raktataṃtubhirājyena śrūyatāṃ tasya yatphalam .. 92 ..
5.191.d:
या नारी कुरुते भक्त्या दीपदानं तदग्रतः ..
रक्ततंतुभिराज्येन श्रूयतां तस्य यत्फलम् .. 92 ..
5.191.m:
Hear the fruit of that woman who with devotion
offers a lamp before her, using red threads and ghee:

5.191.s:
yāvantastaṃtavastasya dahyaṃte dīpa saṃbhavāḥ ..
muhūrtāni ca yāvaṃti ghṛtadīpaśca tiṣṭhati ..
tāvajjanmasahasrāṇi sā syātsaubhāgyabhāṃginī .. 93 ..
5.191.d:
यावन्तस्तंतवस्तस्य दह्यंते दीप संभवाः ..
मुहूर्तानि च यावंति घृतदीपश्च तिष्ठति ..
तावज्जन्मसहस्राणि सा स्यात्सौभाग्यभांगिनी .. 93 ..

5.191.s:
putrapautrasamopetā dhaninī śīla maṃḍanā. ..
na durbhagā na vandhyā ca na ca kāṇā virūpikā .. 94 ..
5.191.d:
पुत्रपौत्रसमोपेता धनिनी शील मंडना. ..
न दुर्भगा न वन्ध्या च न च काणा विरूपिका .. 94 ..
5.191.m:
endowed with sons and grandsons, wealthy, adorned with good character,
neither unfortunate nor barren, neither one-eyed nor deformed.

5.191.s:
yā nṛtyaṃ kurute nārī vidhavāpi tadagrataḥ ..
gītaṃ vā kurute tatra tasyāḥ śṛṇuta yatphalam .. 95 ..
5.191.d:
या नृत्यं कुरुते नारी विधवापि तदग्रतः ..
गीतं वा कुरुते तत्र तस्याः शृणुत यत्फलम् .. 95 ..
5.191.m:
The woman—even if she is a widow—who dances before her
or sings there, hear the fruit for her:

5.191.s:
yathāyathā nṛtyamānā svagātraṃ vidhunoti ca ..
tathātathā dhunotyeva yatpāpaṃ prakṛtaṃ purā .. 96 ..
5.191.d:
यथायथा नृत्यमाना स्वगात्रं विधुनोति च ..
तथातथा धुनोत्येव यत्पापं प्रकृतं पुरा .. 96 ..
5.191.m:
Just as while dancing she shakes her body,
so does she shake off whatever sin was previously committed.

5.191.s:
yāvanto jantavo gītaṃ tasyāḥ śṛṇvaṃti tatra ca ..
tāvaṃti divi varṣāṇi sahasrāṇi vasecca sā .. 97 ..
5.191.d:
यावन्तो जन्तवो गीतं तस्याः शृण्वंति तत्र च ..
तावंति दिवि वर्षाणि सहस्राणि वसेच्च सा .. 97 ..
5.191.m:
As many living creatures as hear her singing there,
for that many thousands of years shall she dwell in heaven.

5.191.s:
sāvitrīṃ yā samuddiśya phaladānaṃ karoti sā ..
phalasaṃkhyāpramāṇāni yugāni divi modate .. 98 ..
5.191.d:
सावित्रीं या समुद्दिश्य फलदानं करोति सा ..
फलसंख्याप्रमाणानि युगानि दिवि मोदते .. 98 ..
5.191.m:
She who gives a gift of fruit dedicated to Sāvitrī
rejoices in heaven for as many yugas as the number of fruits.

5.191.s:
miṣṭānnaṃ yacchate yaśca nārīṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ..
tasyā dakṣiṇamūrtau ca bhartrāḍhyānāṃ dvijottamāḥ ..
sa ca sikthapramāṇāni yugā ni divi modate ..99..
5.191.d:
मिष्टान्नं यच्छते यश्च नारीणां च विशेषतः ..
तस्या दक्षिणमूर्तौ च भर्त्राढ्यानां द्विजोत्तमाः ..
स च सिक्थप्रमाणानि युगा नि दिवि मोदते ..99..
5.191.m:
And whoever gives sweet food, especially to women
who have their husbands, at her southern form, O best of brahmins,
he rejoices in heaven for as many yugas as there are grains of boiled rice.

5.191.s:
yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute tatra samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
rasenaikena sasyena tathaikena dvijottamāḥ ..
tasyāpi jāyate puṇyaṃ gayāśrāddhena yadbhavet .. 6.192.100 ..
5.191.d:
यः श्राद्धं कुरुते तत्र सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः ..
रसेनैकेन सस्येन तथैकेन द्विजोत्तमाः ..
तस्यापि जायते पुण्यं गयाश्राद्धेन यद्भवेत् .. 6.192.100 ..
5.191.m:
Whoever performs a śrāddha there with complete faith,
with a single flavor and with a single grain, O best of brahmins,
to him accrues the merit that is obtained from a śrāddha at Gayā.

5.191.s:
yaḥ karoti dvijastasyā dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritaḥ ..
sandhyopāsanamekaṃ tu svapatnyā kṣipitairjalaiḥ .. 101 ..
5.191.d:
यः करोति द्विजस्तस्या दक्षिणां दिशमाश्रितः ..
सन्ध्योपासनमेकं तु स्वपत्न्या क्षिपितैर्जलैः .. 101 ..
5.191.m:
The twice-born man who, turning to her southern direction,
performs just one twilight devotion with waters poured by his own wife,

5.191.s:
sāyaṃtane ca saṃprāpte kāle brāhmaṇasattamāḥ..
tena syādvaṃditā saṃdhyā samyagdvādaśavārṣikī .. 102 ..
5.191.d:
सायंतने च संप्राप्ते काले ब्राह्मणसत्तमाः..
तेन स्याद्वंदिता संध्या सम्यग्द्वादशवार्षिकी .. 102 ..
5.191.m:
when the evening hour has arrived, O best of brahmins,
by him the twilight devotion will have been duly revered for twelve years.

5.191.s:
yo japedbrāhmaṇastasyāḥ sāvitrīṃ purataḥ sthitaḥ ..
tasya yatsyātphalaṃ viprāḥ śrūyatāṃ tadvadāmi vaḥ .. 103 ..
5.191.d:
यो जपेद्ब्राह्मणस्तस्याः सावित्रीं पुरतः स्थितः ..
तस्य यत्स्यात्फलं विप्राः श्रूयतां तद्वदामि वः .. 103 ..
5.191.m:
The brahmin who, standing in front of her, recites the Sāvitrī—
hear what his fruit is, O brahmins; I shall tell it to you:

5.191.s:
daśabhirjjanmajanitaṃ śatena ca purā kṛtam ..
triyuge tu sahasreṇa tasya naśyati pātakam .. 104 ..
5.191.d:
दशभिर्ज्जन्मजनितं शतेन च पुरा कृतम् ..
त्रियुगे तु सहस्रेण तस्य नश्यति पातकम् .. 104 ..
5.191.m:
With ten [repetitions], that born of one birth; with a hundred, that committed in the past;
and with a thousand, in the three yugas his sin is destroyed.

5.191.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena camatkārapuraṃ prati ..
gatvā tāṃ pūjayeddevīṃ stotavyā ca viśeṣataḥ .. 105 ..
5.191.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन चमत्कारपुरं प्रति ..
गत्वा तां पूजयेद्देवीं स्तोतव्या च विशेषतः .. 105 ..
5.191.m:
Therefore, with every effort one should go to Camatkārapura
and worship that goddess, and she is especially to be praised with hymns.

5.191.s:
sāvitryā idamākhyānaṃ yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyācca vā ..
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sukhabhāgatra jāyate .. 106 ..
5.191.d:
सावित्र्या इदमाख्यानं यः पठेच्छृणुयाच्च वा ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः सुखभागत्र जायते .. 106 ..
5.191.m:
Whoever reads or hears this narrative of Sāvitrī,
freed from all sins, becomes a partaker of happiness in this world.

5.191.s:
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'haṃ dvijottamāḥ ..
sāvitryāḥ kṛtsnaṃ māhātmyaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ pravadāmyaham .. 107 ..
5.191.d:
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं यत्पृष्टोऽहं द्विजोत्तमाः ..
सावित्र्याः कृत्स्नं माहात्म्यं किं भूयः प्रवदाम्यहम् .. 107 ..
5.191.m: All this, which I was asked, has been told to you, O best of brahmins— / the entire māhātmya of Sāvitrī. What more shall I speak?

5.191.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye sāvitrīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvinavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 192 ..
5.191.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सावित्रीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्विनवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 192 ..
5.191.m: Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-second chapter, titled "Description of the Māhātmya of Sāvitrī," in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the Skandamahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.192.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
evaṃ gatāyāṃ sāvitryāṃ sakopāyāṃ ca sūtaja ..
kiṃ kṛtaṃ tatra gāyatryā brahmādyaiścāpi kiṃ suraiḥ .. 1 ..
5.192.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
एवं गतायां सावित्र्यां सकोपायां च सूतज ..
किं कृतं तत्र गायत्र्या ब्रह्माद्यैश्चापि किं सुरैः .. 1 ..
5.192.m: The seers said: / When Sāvitrī had departed in anger in this way, O son of Sūta, / what was done there by Gāyatrī, and what by the gods headed by Brahmā? / 1

5.192.s:
etatsarvaṃ samācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ ..
kathaṃ śāpānvitā devāḥ saṃsthitāstatra maṇḍape .. 2 ..
5.192.d:
एतत्सर्वं समाचक्ष्व परं कौतूहलं हि नः ..
कथं शापान्विता देवाः संस्थितास्तत्र मण्डपे .. 2 ..
5.192.m: Tell us all this, for our curiosity is indeed great: / how did the gods, struck by curses, remain there in the pavilion? / 2

5.192.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
gatāyāmatha sāvitryāṃ śāpaṃ dattvā dvijottamāḥ ..
gāyatrī sahasotthāya vākyametadudairayat .. 3 ..
5.192.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
गतायामथ सावित्र्यां शापं दत्त्वा द्विजोत्तमाः ..
गायत्री सहसोत्थाय वाक्यमेतदुदैरयत् .. 3 ..
5.192.m: Sūta said: / When Sāvitrī had departed after giving her curse, O best of brahmins, / Gāyatrī suddenly arose and uttered this statement: / 3

5.192.s:
sāvitryā yadvacaḥ proktaṃ tanna śakyaṃ kathaṃcana ..
anyathā kartumevātha sarvairapi surāsuraiḥ .. 4 ..
5.192.d:
सावित्र्या यद्वचः प्रोक्तं तन्न शक्यं कथंचन ..
अन्यथा कर्तुमेवाथ सर्वैरपि सुरासुरैः .. 4 ..
5.192.m: What was spoken by Sāvitrī cannot in any way / be rendered otherwise, even by all the gods and asuras together. / 4

5.192.s:
mahāsatī mahābhāgā sāvitrī sā pativratā ..
pūjyā ca sarvadevānāṃ jyeṣṭhā śreṣṭhā ca sadgaṇaiḥ .. 5 ..
5.192.d:
महासती महाभागा सावित्री सा पतिव्रता ..
पूज्या च सर्वदेवानां ज्येष्ठा श्रेष्ठा च सद्गणैः .. 5 ..
5.192.m: Sāvitrī is a great satī, most fortunate, devoted to her husband, / worshipful to all the gods, the eldest, and the most exalted with good hosts. / 5

5.192.s:
paraṃ strīṇāṃ svabhāvo'yaṃ sarvāsāṃ surasattamāḥ..
api sahyo vajrapātaḥ sapatnyā na punaḥ kathā ..6..
5.192.d:
परं स्त्रीणां स्वभावोऽयं सर्वासां सुरसत्तमाः..
अपि सह्यो वज्रपातः सपत्न्या न पुनः कथा ..6..
5.192.m: Yet this is the nature of all women, O best of gods: / even a thunderbolt strike can be endured, but never mention of a co-wife! / 6

5.192.s:
matkṛte ye'tra śapitā sāvitryā brāhmaṇāḥ surāḥ ..
teṣāmahaṃ kariṣyāmi śaktyā sādhāraṇāṃ svayam .. 7 ..
5.192.d:
मत्कृते येऽत्र शपिता सावित्र्या ब्राह्मणाः सुराः ..
तेषामहं करिष्यामि शक्त्या साधारणां स्वयम् .. 7 ..
5.192.m: Those brahmins and gods who have been cursed here by Sāvitrī on my account, / for them I myself will make a mitigation according to my power. / 7

5.192.s:
apūjyo'yaṃ vidhiḥ proktastayā maṃtrapuraḥsaraḥ ..
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ viprādīnāṃ suro ttamāḥ .. 8 ..
5.192.d:
अपूज्योऽयं विधिः प्रोक्तस्तया मंत्रपुरःसरः ..
सर्वेषामेव वर्णानां विप्रादीनां सुरो त्तमाः .. 8 ..
5.192.m: This rite accompanied by mantras was declared by her to be devoid of worship / for all castes, beginning with the brahmins, O best of gods. / 8

5.192.s:
brahmasthāneṣu sarveṣu samaye dharaṇītale ..
na brahmaṇā vinā kiṃcitkṛtyaṃ siddhimupaiṣyati .. 9 ..
5.192.d:
ब्रह्मस्थानेषु सर्वेषु समये धरणीतले ..
न ब्रह्मणा विना किंचित्कृत्यं सिद्धिमुपैष्यति .. 9 ..
5.192.m: In all the abodes of Brahmā at this time on the surface of the earth, / no ritual action will attain success without Brahmā. / 9

5.192.s:
kṛṣṇārcane ca yatpuṇyaṃ yatpuṇyaṃ liṃga pūjane ..
tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ sadā vai brahmadarśanāt ..
bhaviṣyati na sandeho viśeṣātsarvaparvasu .. 6.193.10 ..
5.192.d:
कृष्णार्चने च यत्पुण्यं यत्पुण्यं लिंग पूजने ..
तत्फलं कोटिगुणितं सदा वै ब्रह्मदर्शनात् ..
भविष्यति न सन्देहो विशेषात्सर्वपर्वसु .. 6.193.10 ..
5.192.m: Whatever merit lies in worshipping Kṛṣṇa, and whatever merit in worshipping the liṅga, / that fruit will always be multiplied ten-millionfold from the darśana of Brahmā; / there is no doubt, especially on all sacred festival days. / 10

5.192.s:
tvaṃ ca viṣṇo tayā prokto martyajanma yadā'psyasi ..
tatrāpi parabhṛtyatvaṃ pareṣāṃ te bhaviṣyati ..11..
5.192.d:
त्वं च विष्णो तया प्रोक्तो मर्त्यजन्म यदाऽप्स्यसि ..
तत्रापि परभृत्यत्वं परेषां ते भविष्यति ..11..
5.192.m: And you, O Viṣṇu, were told by her: 'When you attain mortal birth, / there too you will have the state of being a servant to others.' / 11

5.192.s:
tatkṛtvā rūpadvitayaṃ tatra janma tvamāpsyasi ..
yattayā kathito vaṃśo mamāyaṃ gopasaṃjñitaḥ ..
tatra tvaṃ pāvanārthāya ciraṃ vṛddhimavāpsyasi .. 12 ..
5.192.d:
तत्कृत्वा रूपद्वितयं तत्र जन्म त्वमाप्स्यसि ..
यत्तया कथितो वंशो ममायं गोपसंज्ञितः ..
तत्र त्वं पावनार्थाय चिरं वृद्धिमवाप्स्यसि .. 12 ..
5.192.m: Having assumed a pair of forms, you will obtain birth there; / in this lineage of mine called the cowherds, of which she spoke, / there, for its purification, you will attain growth for a long time. / 12

5.192.s:
ekaḥ kṛṣṇābhidhānastu dvitīyo'rjunasaṃjñitaḥ ..
tasyātmano'rjunākhyasya sārathyaṃ tvaṃ kariṣyasi .. 13 ..
5.192.d:
एकः कृष्णाभिधानस्तु द्वितीयोऽर्जुनसंज्ञितः ..
तस्यात्मनोऽर्जुनाख्यस्य सारथ्यं त्वं करिष्यसि .. 13 ..
5.192.m: One will be named Kṛṣṇa, while the second will be named Arjuna; / of that self of yours named Arjuna, you will act as the charioteer. / 13

5.192.s:
tenākṛtye'pi raktāste gopā yāsyaṃti ślāghyatām ..
sarveṣāmeva lokānāṃ devānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ .. 14 ..
5.192.d:
तेनाकृत्येऽपि रक्तास्ते गोपा यास्यंति श्लाघ्यताम् ..
सर्वेषामेव लोकानां देवानां च विशेषतः .. 14 ..
5.192.m: Because of that, though delighting in improper deeds, those cowherds will attain praiseworthiness / among all people, and especially among the gods. / 14

5.192.s:
yatrayatra ca vatsyaṃti madvaṃ śaprabhavānarāḥ ..
tatratatra śriyo vāso vane'pi prabhaviṣyati .. 15 ..
5.192.d:
यत्रयत्र च वत्स्यंति मद्वं शप्रभवानराः ..
तत्रतत्र श्रियो वासो वनेऽपि प्रभविष्यति .. 15 ..
5.192.m: Wherever men born of my lineage will dwell, / in every such place will be the abode of Śrī, even in a forest. / 15

5.192.s:
bhobhoḥ śakra bhavānukto yattayā kopayuktayā ..
parājayaṃ ripoḥ prāpya kārā gāre patiṣyati .. 16 ..
5.192.d:
भोभोः शक्र भवानुक्तो यत्तया कोपयुक्तया ..
पराजयं रिपोः प्राप्य कारा गारे पतिष्यति .. 16 ..
5.192.m: O Śakra, as for what was spoken to you by her filled with anger, / that having suffered defeat by your enemy you will fall into a prison: / 16

5.192.s: tanmuktiṃ te svayaṃ brahmā madvākyena kariṣyati .. 17 ..
5.192.d: तन्मुक्तिं ते स्वयं ब्रह्मा मद्वाक्येन करिष्यति .. 17 ..
5.192.m: Brahmā himself will bring about your release by my word. / 17

5.192.s:
tataḥ praviṣṭaḥ saṃgrāme na parājayamāpsyasi ..
tvaṃ vahne sarvabhakṣaśca yatprokto ruṣṭayā tayā .. 18 ..
5.192.d:
ततः प्रविष्टः संग्रामे न पराजयमाप्स्यसि ..
त्वं वह्ने सर्वभक्षश्च यत्प्रोक्तो रुष्टया तया .. 18 ..
5.192.m: Thereafter, having entered the battle, you will not meet with defeat. / O Fire, as for your being spoken of by her in her anger as an all-devourer: / 18

5.192.s:
tadamedhyamapi prāyaḥ spṛṣṭaṃ te'rccirbhiragrataḥ ..
medhyatāṃ yāsyati kṣipraṃ tataḥ pūjāmavāptyasi .. 19 ..
svāhā nāma ca bhāryā yā devānsantarpayiṣyati ..
svadhā cā'pi pitṝnsarvānmama vākyādasaṃśayam ..6.193.2...
5.192.d:
तदमेध्यमपि प्रायः स्पृष्टं तेऽर्च्चिर्भिरग्रतः ..
मेध्यतां यास्यति क्षिप्रं ततः पूजामवाप्त्यसि .. 19 ..
स्वाहा नाम च भार्या या देवान्सन्तर्पयिष्यति ..
स्वधा चाऽपि पितॄन्सर्वान्मम वाक्यादसंशयम् ..6.193.2...
5.192.m:
Even that which is impure, when touched by your flames ahead, / will quickly attain purity; thereafter you will obtain worship. / 19
The wife named Svāhā will satisfy the gods, / and Svadhā will satisfy all the ancestors, beyond doubt, by my word. / 20

5.192.s:
yadrudra priyayā sārdhaṃ viyogaḥ kathitastayā ..
tasyāḥ śreṣṭha tarā cānyā tava bhāryā bhaviṣyati ..
gaurīnāmeti vikhyātā himācalasutā śubhā .. 21 ..
5.192.d:
यद्रुद्र प्रियया सार्धं वियोगः कथितस्तया ..
तस्याः श्रेष्ठ तरा चान्या तव भार्या भविष्यति ..
गौरीनामेति विख्याता हिमाचलसुता शुभा .. 21 ..
5.192.m: O Rudra, as for the separation from your beloved that was spoken of by her: / another wife, far superior to her, will become yours, / renowned by the name Gaurī, the auspicious daughter of the Himālaya. / 21

5.192.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhenāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye gāyatrīvarapradānonāma trinavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 193 .. ..
5.192.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठेनागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये गायत्रीवरप्रदानोनाम त्रिनवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 193 .. ..
5.192.m: Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-third chapter, titled "The Granting of Boons by Gāyatrī," in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the Skandamahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.193.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ sā tānvarāndattvā sarveṣāṃ śāpabhāginām ..
maunavrataparā bhūtvā niviṣṭā'tha dharātale .. 1 ..
5.193.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं सा तान्वरान्दत्त्वा सर्वेषां शापभागिनाम् ..
मौनव्रतपरा भूत्वा निविष्टाऽथ धरातले .. 1 ..
5.193.m: Sūta said: / Having thus granted those boons to all who had shared in the curses, / she undertook the vow of silence and then sat upon the ground. / 1

5.193.s:
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve tāpasāśca maharṣayaḥ ..
sādhusādhviti tāṃ procya tataḥ procuridaṃ vacaḥ .. 2 ..
5.193.d:
ततो देवगणाः सर्वे तापसाश्च महर्षयः ..
साधुसाध्विति तां प्रोच्य ततः प्रोचुरिदं वचः .. 2 ..
5.193.m: Then all the hosts of gods, the ascetics, and the great seers / said to her, "Well done! Well done!" and then spoke these words: / 2

5.193.s:
etāṃ devīprasādena brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
pūjayiṣyaṃti martye'tra sarve lokāḥ samāhitāḥ .. 3 ..
5.193.d:
एतां देवीप्रसादेन ब्राह्मणानां विशेषतः ..
पूजयिष्यंति मर्त्येऽत्र सर्वे लोकाः समाहिताः .. 3 ..
5.193.m: "By the grace of the goddess, especially towards brahmins, / all people here in the mortal world will worship her with focused minds. / 3

5.193.s:
brahmāṇaṃ pūjayitvā tu paścādenāṃ sureśvarīm ..
pūjayiṣyaṃti ye martyāste tu yāṃti parāṃ gatim .. 4 ..
5.193.d:
ब्रह्माणं पूजयित्वा तु पश्चादेनां सुरेश्वरीम् ..
पूजयिष्यंति ये मर्त्यास्ते तु यांति परां गतिम् .. 4 ..
5.193.m: Having worshipped Brahmā, those mortals who subsequently / worship this ruler of the gods go to the supreme state. / 4

5.193.s:
yā kanyā patisaṃyogaṃ saṃprāpyātra samāhitā ..
tataḥ pādapraṇāmaṃ ca gāyatryāśca kariṣyati ..
patiṃ prajāpatiṃ prāpya sā bhaviṣyatyasaṃśayam .. 5 ..
5.193.d:
या कन्या पतिसंयोगं संप्राप्यात्र समाहिता ..
ततः पादप्रणामं च गायत्र्याश्च करिष्यति ..
पतिं प्रजापतिं प्राप्य सा भविष्यत्यसंशयम् .. 5 ..
5.193.m: Whatever maiden, having attained union with a husband, being composed in mind, / then performs prostration at the feet of Gāyatrī, / having obtained a husband like Prajāpati, she will undoubtedly flourish. / 5

5.193.s:
sarvakāmasukhopetā dhanadhānyasamanvitā ..
yā nārī durbhagā vaṃdhyā bhaviṣyati ca śobhanā .. 6 ..
5.193.d:
सर्वकामसुखोपेता धनधान्यसमन्विता ..
या नारी दुर्भगा वंध्या भविष्यति च शोभना .. 6 ..
5.193.m: Endowed with the happiness of all desires, possessed of wealth and grain, / a woman who was unfortunate or barren will also become blessed." / 6

5.193.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ gate paṃcottare śate ..
padmajānāṃ haraḥ prādādetatkathamanutta mam .. 7 ..
5.193.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
यदेतद्भवता प्रोक्तं गते पंचोत्तरे शते ..
पद्मजानां हरः प्रादादेतत्कथमनुत्त मम् .. 7 ..
5.193.m: The seers said: / Regarding what was spoken by you—that when one hundred and five / lotus-born [Brahmās] had passed, Hara granted this incomparable [gift] / 7

5.193.s:
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sa saṃtuṣṭaḥ kiṃvā'nyo'sti maheśvaraḥ ..
etaṃ naḥ saṃśayaṃ bhūyo yathāvadvaktumarhasi .. 8 ..
5.193.d:
ब्राह्मणेभ्यः स संतुष्टः किंवाऽन्योऽस्ति महेश्वरः ..
एतं नः संशयं भूयो यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि .. 8 ..
5.193.m: to the brahmins, pleased [with them]—is there perhaps another Maheśvara? / You ought to explain this doubt of ours once again as it truly is. / 8

5.193.s:
āyuṣyaṃ śaṃkarasyāpi yatpramāṇaṃ tathā hareḥ ..
brahmaṇo'pi samācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ .. 9 ..
5.193.d:
आयुष्यं शंकरस्यापि यत्प्रमाणं तथा हरेः ..
ब्रह्मणोऽपि समाचक्ष्व परं कौतूहलं हि नः .. 9 ..
5.193.m: Tell us the measure of the lifespan of Śaṃkara, / and likewise of Hari and of Brahmā, for our curiosity is indeed great. / 9

5.193.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ahaṃ vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi vistareṇa dvijottamāḥ ..
trayāṇāmapi cāyuṣyaṃ yatpramāṇaṃ vyavasthitam .. 6.194.10 ..
5.193.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अहं वः कीर्तयिष्यामि विस्तरेण द्विजोत्तमाः ..
त्रयाणामपि चायुष्यं यत्प्रमाणं व्यवस्थितम् .. 6.194.10 ..
5.193.m: Sūta said: / I shall describe to you in detail, O best of brahmins, / the measure established for the lifespans of all three: / 10

5.193.s:
nimeṣasya caturbhāgastruṭiḥ syāttaddvayaṃ lavaḥ ..
lavadvayaṃ kalā proktā kāṣṭhā tu daśapaṃcabhiḥ .. 11 ..
5.193.d:
निमेषस्य चतुर्भागस्त्रुटिः स्यात्तद्द्वयं लवः ..
लवद्वयं कला प्रोक्ता काष्ठा तु दशपंचभिः .. 11 ..
5.193.m: The fourth part of a nimeṣa is a truṭi; two of those are a lava; / two lavas are called a kalā, and a kāṣṭhā is fifteen [kalās]. / 11

5.193.s:
triṃśatkāṣṭhāṃ kalāmāhuḥ kṣaṇastriṃśatkalo mataḥ ..
muhūrtamānaṃ mauhūrtā vadaṃti dvādaśakṣaṇam .. 12 ..
5.193.d:
त्रिंशत्काष्ठां कलामाहुः क्षणस्त्रिंशत्कलो मतः ..
मुहूर्तमानं मौहूर्ता वदंति द्वादशक्षणम् .. 12 ..
5.193.m: Thirty kāṣṭhās they call a kalā; a kṣaṇa is considered thirty kalās; / astrologers state the measure of a muhūrta to be twelve kṣaṇas. / 12

5.193.s:
triṃśanmuhūrtamuddiṣṭamahorātraṃ manīṣibhiḥ ..
māsastriṃśadahorātrairdvau māsāvṛtusaṃjñitaḥ .. 13 ..
5.193.d:
त्रिंशन्मुहूर्तमुद्दिष्टमहोरात्रं मनीषिभिः ..
मासस्त्रिंशदहोरात्रैर्द्वौ मासावृतुसंज्ञितः .. 13 ..
5.193.m: Thirty muhūrtas are indicated by the wise as a day and night; / a month is made of thirty days and nights; two months are designated a season. / 13

5.193.s:
ṛtutrayaṃ cāyanaṃ ca ayane dve tu vatsaram ..
daivikaṃ ca bhavettacca hyahorātraṃ dvijottamāḥ .. 14 ..
5.193.d:
ऋतुत्रयं चायनं च अयने द्वे तु वत्सरम् ..
दैविकं च भवेत्तच्च ह्यहोरात्रं द्विजोत्तमाः .. 14 ..
5.193.m: Three seasons are a solstice, and two solstices are a year; / and that, O best of brahmins, is a single day and night of the gods. / 14

5.193.s:
uttaraṃ cāyanaṃ tatra dinaṃ rātristathā'param..
lakṣaiḥ saptadaśākhyaistu manuṣyāṇāṃ ca vatsaraiḥ .. 15 ..
5.193.d:
उत्तरं चायनं तत्र दिनं रात्रिस्तथाऽपरम्..
लक्षैः सप्तदशाख्यैस्तु मनुष्याणां च वत्सरैः .. 15 ..
5.193.m: There the northern solstice is the day, and the other is the night. / By seventeen lakhs of human years / 15

5.193.s:
aṣṭāviṃśatibhiścaiva sahasraistu tathā paraiḥ ..
ādyaṃ kṛtayugaṃ caiva tadbha viṣyati saddvijāḥ .. 16 ..
5.193.d:
अष्टाविंशतिभिश्चैव सहस्रैस्तु तथा परैः ..
आद्यं कृतयुगं चैव तद्भ विष्यति सद्द्विजाः .. 16 ..
5.193.m: and by another twenty-eight thousand, / the first, the Kṛtayuga, will be [measured], O good brahmins. / 16

5.193.s:
tato dvādaśabhirlakṣaiḥ ṣoḍaśānāṃ sahasrakaiḥ ..
tretāyugaṃ samādiṣṭaṃ dvitīyaṃ dvijasattamāḥ .. 17 ..
5.193.d:
ततो द्वादशभिर्लक्षैः षोडशानां सहस्रकैः ..
त्रेतायुगं समादिष्टं द्वितीयं द्विजसत्तमाः .. 17 ..
5.193.m: Then, by twelve hundred thousand and sixteen thousand [human years], / the Tretāyuga, the second [age], is declared, O best of brahmins.

5.193.s:
dvāparaṃ cāṣṭabhirlakṣaistṛ tīyaṃ parikīrtitam ..
catuḥṣaṣṭisahasraistu yathāvatparisaṃkhyayā .. 18 ..
5.193.d:
द्वापरं चाष्टभिर्लक्षैस्तृ तीयं परिकीर्तितम् ..
चतुःषष्टिसहस्रैस्तु यथावत्परिसंख्यया .. 18 ..
5.193.m: And the Dvāpara, the third, is proclaimed as eight hundred thousand / and sixty-four thousand, according to the proper reckoning.

5.193.s:
caturlakṣaṃ samādiṣṭaṃ yugaṃ kalisamudbhavam ..
dvātriṃśatā sahasraistu caturthaṃ tadvidurbudhāḥ .. 19..
caturyugasahasreṇa dinaṃ paitāmahaṃ bhavet ..
teṣāṃ triṃśaddinairmāso māsairdvādaśabhirvatsaro bhavet ..6.194.2...
5.193.d:
चतुर्लक्षं समादिष्टं युगं कलिसमुद्भवम् ..
द्वात्रिंशता सहस्रैस्तु चतुर्थं तद्विदुर्बुधाः .. 19..
चतुर्युगसहस्रेण दिनं पैतामहं भवेत् ..
तेषां त्रिंशद्दिनैर्मासो मासैर्द्वादशभिर्वत्सरो भवेत् ..6.194.2...
5.193.m:
Four hundred thousand and thirty-two thousand [years] / is declared for the age arising as Kali, the fourth; so the wise know it.
By a thousand sets of four yugas, a day of the Grandfather [Brahmā] is formed. / A month of theirs consists of thirty days; by twelve months a year is formed.

5.193.s:
brahmā teṣāṃ śataṃ yāvatsa jīvati pitāmahaḥ ..
sāṃprataṃ cāṣṭavarṣīyaḥ ṣaṇmāsaścaiva saṃsthitaḥ ..21..
5.193.d:
ब्रह्मा तेषां शतं यावत्स जीवति पितामहः ..
सांप्रतं चाष्टवर्षीयः षण्मासश्चैव संस्थितः ..21..
5.193.m: Brahmā, the Grandfather, lives for a hundred of these [years]. / At present he has stood for eight years and six months.

5.193.s:
pratipaddivasasyāsya prathamasya tathā gatam ..
yāmadvayaṃ śukravāre vartamāne mahātmanaḥ .. ..22..
5.193.d:
प्रतिपद्दिवसस्यास्य प्रथमस्य तथा गतम् ..
यामद्वयं शुक्रवारे वर्तमाने महात्मनः .. ..22..
5.193.m: Of this first day, the pratipad, there have passed / two yāmas on the current Friday for that great soul.

5.193.s: brahmaṇo varṣamātreṇa dinaṃ vaiṣṇavamucyate ..23..
5.193.d: ब्रह्मणो वर्षमात्रेण दिनं वैष्णवमुच्यते ..23..
5.193.m: By merely one year of Brahmā, a day of Viṣṇu is declared.

5.193.s:
sopi varṣaśataṃyāvadātmamānena jīvati ..
paṃcapacāśadādiṣṭāstasya jātasya vatsarāḥ .. 24 ..
5.193.d:
सोपि वर्षशतंयावदात्ममानेन जीवति ..
पंचपचाशदादिष्टास्तस्य जातस्य वत्सराः .. 24 ..
5.193.m: He too lives for a hundred years by his own reckoning. / Fifty-five years are declared [to have elapsed] since his birth,

5.193.s:
tithayaḥ paṃca yāmārddhaṃ somavāreṇa saṃgatam ..
vaiṣṇavena tu varṣeṇa dinaṃ māheśvaraṃ bhavet .. 25 ..
5.193.d:
तिथयः पंच यामार्द्धं सोमवारेण संगतम् ..
