वैष्णवेन तु वर्षेण दिनं माहेश्वरं भवेत् .. 25 ..
5.193.m: along with five tithis and half a yāma, on a Monday. / By a year of Viṣṇu, a day of Maheśvara is formed.

5.193.s:
śivo varṣaśataṃ yāvattena rūpeṇa ca sthitaḥ ..
yāvaducchvasitaṃ vaktraṃ sadāśivasamudbhavam .. 26 ..
5.193.d:
शिवो वर्षशतं यावत्तेन रूपेण च स्थितः ..
यावदुच्छ्वसितं वक्त्रं सदाशिवसमुद्भवम् .. 26 ..
5.193.m: Śiva remains in that form for up to a hundred years, / for as long as the breath exhalation of the mouth arising from Sadāśiva lasts.

5.193.s:
paścācchaktiṃ samabhyeti yāvanniśvasitaṃ bhavet ..
niśvāsocchvasitānāṃ ca sarveṣāmeva dehinām .. 27 ..
5.193.d:
पश्चाच्छक्तिं समभ्येति यावन्निश्वसितं भवेत् ..
निश्वासोच्छ्वसितानां च सर्वेषामेव देहिनाम् .. 27 ..
5.193.m: Afterward he approaches Śakti, for as long as there is an inhalation. / And of the inhalations and exhalations of all embodied beings,

5.193.s:
brahmaviṣṇuśivānāṃ ca gandharvoragarakṣasām ..
ekaviṃśatsahasrāṇi śataiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ śatāni ca .. 28 ..
5.193.d:
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवानां च गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् ..
एकविंशत्सहस्राणि शतैः षड्भिः शतानि च .. 28 ..
5.193.m: of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva, and of gandharvas, serpents, and rākṣasas, / twenty-one thousand and six hundred

5.193.s:
ahorātreṇa coktāni pramāṇe dvija sattamāḥ ..
ṣaḍbhirucchvāsaniśvāsaiḥ palamekaṃ pravartate .. 29 ..
5.193.d:
अहोरात्रेण चोक्तानि प्रमाणे द्विज सत्तमाः ..
षड्भिरुच्छ्वासनिश्वासैः पलमेकं प्रवर्तते .. 29 ..
5.193.m: are spoken of in the measure of a day and night, O best of brahmins. / By six exhalations and inhalations, one pala proceeds.

5.193.s:
nāḍī ṣaṣṭipalā proktā tāsāṃ ṣaṣṭyā dinaṃ niśā ..
niśvāsocchvasitānāṃ ca parisaṃkhyā na vidyate ..
sadāśivasamutthānāmetasmātso'kṣayaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 6.194.30 ..
5.193.d:
नाडी षष्टिपला प्रोक्ता तासां षष्ट्या दिनं निशा ..
निश्वासोच्छ्वसितानां च परिसंख्या न विद्यते ..
सदाशिवसमुत्थानामेतस्मात्सोऽक्षयः स्मृतः .. 6.194.30 ..
5.193.m: A nāḍī is declared to be sixty palas; by sixty of them, day and night [are formed]. / And of the inhalations and exhalations arising from Sadāśiva / there is no reckoning; therefore he is remembered as imperishable.

5.193.s:
anye'pi ye pragacchaṃti brahmajñānasamanvitāḥ ..
akṣayāste'pi jāyaṃte satyametanmayoditam .. 31 ..
5.193.d:
अन्येऽपि ये प्रगच्छंति ब्रह्मज्ञानसमन्विताः ..
अक्षयास्तेऽपि जायंते सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् .. 31 ..
5.193.m: Others also who depart endowed with knowledge of Brahman / also become imperishable; this that I have spoken is the truth.

5.193.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
yadyevaṃ sūtaputrātra brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ..
ātmavarṣaśate pūrṇe yāṃti nāśamasaṃśayam .. .. 32 ..
5.193.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
यद्येवं सूतपुत्रात्र ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः ..
आत्मवर्षशते पूर्णे यांति नाशमसंशयम् .. .. 32 ..
5.193.m: The seers said: / If it is so, O son of Sūta, here Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara, / when their own hundred years are completed, go to destruction without doubt.

5.193.s:
tatkathaṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ ca martyalokelpajīvinām ..
kathayaṃti ca ye muktiṃ vidvāṃsaścaiva sūtaja .. 33 ..
5.193.d:
तत्कथं मानुषाणां च मर्त्यलोकेल्पजीविनाम् ..
कथयंति च ये मुक्तिं विद्वांसश्चैव सूतज .. 33 ..
5.193.m: Then how is it that the learned proclaim liberation / for human beings who are short-lived in the mortal realm, O son of Sūta?

5.193.s: nūnaṃ teṣāṃ mṛṣā vādo mokṣamārgasamu dbhavaḥ .. 34 ..
5.193.d: नूनं तेषां मृषा वादो मोक्षमार्गसमु द्भवः .. 34 ..
5.193.m: Surely their doctrine concerning the path to liberation is false!

5.193.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
anādinidhanaḥ kālaḥ saṃkhyayā parivarjitaḥ ..
asaṃkhyātā gatā mokṣaṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ .. 35 ..
5.193.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अनादिनिधनः कालः संख्यया परिवर्जितः ..
असंख्याता गता मोक्षं ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः .. 35 ..
5.193.m: Sūta said: / Time is without beginning or end, and devoid of number. / Innumerable Brahmās, Viṣṇus, and Maheśvaras have attained liberation

5.193.s:
nije varṣaśate pūrṇe vālukāreṇavo yathā ..
nijamānena yā śraddhā brahmajñānasamudbhavā ..
teṣāṃ cenmānuṣāṇāṃ ca tanmuktiḥ syādasaṃśayam .. 36..
5.193.d:
निजे वर्षशते पूर्णे वालुकारेणवो यथा ..
निजमानेन या श्रद्धा ब्रह्मज्ञानसमुद्भवा ..
तेषां चेन्मानुषाणां च तन्मुक्तिः स्यादसंशयम् .. 36..
5.193.m: when their own hundred years were completed, like grains of sand. / If those human beings possess faith arising from knowledge of Brahman by their own reckoning, / their liberation will take place without a doubt.

5.193.s:
yathaite daṃśamaśakā mānuṣāṇāṃ ca kīṭakāḥ ..
jāyaṃte ca mriyaṃte ca gaṇyaṃte naiva kutracit ..
indrādīnāṃ tathā martyāḥ saṃbhāvyā jagatītale .. 37 ..
5.193.d:
यथैते दंशमशका मानुषाणां च कीटकाः ..
जायंते च म्रियंते च गण्यंते नैव कुत्रचित् ..
इन्द्रादीनां तथा मर्त्याः संभाव्या जगतीतले .. 37 ..
5.193.m: Just as these gadflies, mosquitoes, and worms of humans / are born and die and are not counted anywhere, / so mortals on the surface of the earth are to be regarded by Indra and the others.

5.193.s:
devānāṃ ca yathā martyāḥ kīṭasthāne ca saṃsthitāḥ ..
tathā devā api jñeyā brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ .. 38 ..
5.193.d:
देवानां च यथा मर्त्याः कीटस्थाने च संस्थिताः ..
तथा देवा अपि ज्ञेया ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः .. 38 ..
5.193.m: And just as mortals stand in the place of insects to the gods, / so also the gods are to be known [in relation] to Brahmā, whose birth is from the unmanifest.

5.193.s:
brahmaṇastu yathā devāḥ kīṭasthāne vyavasthitāḥ ..
tathā brahmāpi viṣṇośca kīṭasthāne vyavasthitaḥ .. 39 ..
5.193.d:
ब्रह्मणस्तु यथा देवाः कीटस्थाने व्यवस्थिताः ..
तथा ब्रह्मापि विष्णोश्च कीटस्थाने व्यवस्थितः .. 39 ..
5.193.m: Just as the gods stand in the place of insects to Brahmā, / so Brahmā too stands in the place of an insect to Viṣṇu.

5.193.s:
pitāmaho yathā viṣṇoḥ kīṭasthāne vyavasthitaḥ ..
tathā sa śivaśaktibhyāṃ parijñeyo dvijottamāḥ .. 6.194.40 ..
5.193.d:
पितामहो यथा विष्णोः कीटस्थाने व्यवस्थितः ..
तथा स शिवशक्तिभ्यां परिज्ञेयो द्विजोत्तमाः .. 6.194.40 ..
5.193.m: Just as the Grandfather stands in the place of an insect to Viṣṇu, / so he is to be recognized [in relation] to Śiva and Śakti, O best of brahmins.

5.193.s:
yathā viṣṇuḥ kṛmirjñeyastābhyāmeva dvijottamāḥ ..
sadāśivasya vijñeyau tathā tau kṛmirūpakau .. 41 ..
5.193.d:
यथा विष्णुः कृमिर्ज्ञेयस्ताभ्यामेव द्विजोत्तमाः ..
सदाशिवस्य विज्ञेयौ तथा तौ कृमिरूपकौ .. 41 ..
5.193.m: Just as Viṣṇu is to be known as a worm to those two, O best of brahmins, / so those two are to be known as having the form of worms in relation to Sadāśiva.

5.193.s:
evaṃ ca vividhairyajñaiḥ śraddhā pūtena cetasā ..
brahmajñānātparaṃ yāṃti sadāśivasamudbhavam .. 42 ..
5.193.d:
एवं च विविधैर्यज्ञैः श्रद्धा पूतेन चेतसा ..
ब्रह्मज्ञानात्परं यांति सदाशिवसमुद्भवम् .. 42 ..
5.193.m: And thus, through various sacrifices with a mind purified by faith, / they go beyond through knowledge of Brahman originating from Sadāśiva.

5.193.s:
agniṣṭomādibhiryajñaiḥ kṛtaiḥ saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇaiḥ ..
tadarthaṃ te divaṃ yāṃti bhuktvā bhogānpṛthagvidhān .. 43 ..
5.193.d:
अग्निष्टोमादिभिर्यज्ञैः कृतैः संपूर्णदक्षिणैः ..
तदर्थं ते दिवं यांति भुक्त्वा भोगान्पृथग्विधान् .. 43 ..
5.193.m: By sacrifices such as the Agniṣṭoma performed with full sacrificial fees, / they go to heaven for that purpose and, having enjoyed diverse pleasures,

5.193.s:
kṣaye ca punarāyāṃti sukṛtasya mahītale ..
brahmajñānātparaṃ prāpya punarjanma na vidyate .. 44 ..
5.193.d:
क्षये च पुनरायांति सुकृतस्य महीतले ..
ब्रह्मज्ञानात्परं प्राप्य पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते .. 44 ..
5.193.m: they return to the surface of the earth when their merit is exhausted. / Having attained the highest state through knowledge of Brahman, there is no rebirth.

5.193.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatrābhyāsaṃ samā caret ..
janmabhirbahubhiḥ paścācchanairmuktimavāpnuyāt .. 45 ..
5.193.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन तत्राभ्यासं समा चरेत् ..
जन्मभिर्बहुभिः पश्चाच्छनैर्मुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् .. 45 ..
5.193.m: Therefore, with every effort one should practice that. / After many births, one gradually attains liberation.

5.193.s:
ekajanmani saṃprāpto leśo jñānasya tasya ca ..
dvitīye dviguṇastasya tṛtīye trigu ṇo bhavet .. 46 ..
5.193.d:
एकजन्मनि संप्राप्तो लेशो ज्ञानस्य तस्य च ..
द्वितीये द्विगुणस्तस्य तृतीये त्रिगु णो भवेत् .. 46 ..
5.193.m: A particle of that knowledge attained in one birth / becomes doubled in the second, and tripled in the third.

5.193.s: ekottaro bhavedevaṃ sadā janmanijanmani .. 47 ..
5.193.d: एकोत्तरो भवेदेवं सदा जन्मनिजन्मनि .. 47 ..
5.193.m: Thus it increases by one always, birth after birth.

5.193.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
brahmajñānasya saṃprāptirmartyānāṃ jāyate katham ..
etannaḥ sarvamācakṣva yadi tvaṃ vetsi sūtaja .. 48 ..
5.193.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
ब्रह्मज्ञानस्य संप्राप्तिर्मर्त्यानां जायते कथम् ..
एतन्नः सर्वमाचक्ष्व यदि त्वं वेत्सि सूतज .. 48 ..
5.193.m: The seers said: / How does the attainment of the knowledge of Brahman arise for mortals? / Tell us all this, if you know, O son of Sūta.

5.193.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
kā śaktirmama vaktavye jñāne martyasamudbhave ..
svayameva na yo vetti sa parasya vadetkatham .. 49 ..
5.193.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
का शक्तिर्मम वक्तव्ये ज्ञाने मर्त्यसमुद्भवे ..
स्वयमेव न यो वेत्ति स परस्य वदेत्कथम् .. 49 ..
5.193.m: Sūta said: / What power is mine to speak on the knowledge arising in mortals? / He who does not know it himself, how can he tell another?

5.193.s:
upadeśaḥ paraṃ yo me pitrā datto dvijottamāḥ ..
tamahaṃ vaḥ pravakṣyāmi brahmajñānasamudbhavam .. 6.194.50 ..
5.193.d:
उपदेशः परं यो मे पित्रा दत्तो द्विजोत्तमाः ..
तमहं वः प्रवक्ष्यामि ब्रह्मज्ञानसमुद्भवम् .. 6.194.50 ..
5.193.m: Only the instruction that was given to me by my father, O best of brahmins, / arising from the knowledge of Brahman, that I will declare to you.

5.193.s:
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre hyasti tīrthadvayaṃ śubham ..
kumārikābhyāṃ vihitaṃ brahmajñānapradaṃ nṛṇām .. 51 ..
5.193.d:
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे ह्यस्ति तीर्थद्वयं शुभम् ..
कुमारिकाभ्यां विहितं ब्रह्मज्ञानप्रदं नृणाम् .. 51 ..
5.193.m: In the sacred field born of Hāṭakeśvara, there is indeed an auspicious pair of sacred fords, / constructed by two maidens, granting knowledge of Brahman to men.

5.193.s:
brāhmaṇyā caiva śūdryā ca kumārībhyāṃ vinirmitam ..
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ yastābhyāṃ snānamācaret .. 52 ..
5.193.d:
ब्राह्मण्या चैव शूद्र्या च कुमारीभ्यां विनिर्मितम् ..
अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां यस्ताभ्यां स्नानमाचरेत् .. 52 ..
5.193.m: It was created by two maidens—a brahmin girl and a śūdra girl. / Whoever performs a ritual ablution in both of them on the eighth or fourteenth day,

5.193.s:
paścātpūjayate bhakttyā prasiddhe siddhipāduke ..
sugupte gartamadhyasthe kumāryā paripūjite .. 53 ..
5.193.d:
पश्चात्पूजयते भक्त्त्या प्रसिद्धे सिद्धिपादुके ..
सुगुप्ते गर्तमध्यस्थे कुमार्या परिपूजिते .. 53 ..
5.193.m: and then worships with devotion the famous pairs of magical sandals, / well-hidden, situated in the middle of a pit, worshiped by the maiden,

5.193.s:
tasya saṃvatsarasyānte brahmajñānaṃ prajāyate ..
śaktyā vinihite te ca svadarśanavivṛddhaye .. 54 ..
5.193.d:
तस्य संवत्सरस्यान्ते ब्रह्मज्ञानं प्रजायते ..
शक्त्या विनिहिते ते च स्वदर्शनविवृद्धये .. 54 ..
5.193.m: for him, at the end of a year, knowledge of Brahman arises. / And they were placed by Śakti for the increase of the vision of herself,

5.193.s:
lokānāṃ muktikāmānāṃ brahmajñānasukhāvahe ..
mama tāto gatastatra tataśca jñānavānsthitaḥ .. 55 ..
5.193.d:
लोकानां मुक्तिकामानां ब्रह्मज्ञानसुखावहे ..
मम तातो गतस्तत्र ततश्च ज्ञानवान्स्थितः .. 55 ..
5.193.m: bringing the bliss of knowledge of Brahman to people who desire liberation. / My father went there, and from that he remained endowed with knowledge.

5.193.s:
tasyādeśādahaṃ tatra gataḥ saṃvatsaraṃ sthitaḥ ..
pāduke pūjayāmāsa tato jñānaṃ ca saṃsthitam .. 56 ..
5.193.d:
तस्यादेशादहं तत्र गतः संवत्सरं स्थितः ..
पादुके पूजयामास ततो ज्ञानं च संस्थितम् .. 56 ..
5.193.m: By his command I went there, remained for a year, / and worshiped the pair of sandals; then knowledge became established [in me].

5.193.s:
yatkiñcidvā śrutaṃ loke purāṇāgryaṃ vyavasthitam ..
vartamānaṃ bhaviṣyacca tadahaṃ vedmi bho dvijāḥ .. 57 ..
5.193.d:
यत्किञ्चिद्वा श्रुतं लोके पुराणाग्र्यं व्यवस्थितम् ..
वर्तमानं भविष्यच्च तदहं वेद्मि भो द्विजाः .. 57 ..
5.193.m: Whatever foremost Purāṇa is heard and established in the world, / present and future, all that I know, O brahmins.

5.193.s:
tatprasādādasaṃdigdhaṃ pramāṇaṃ cātra saṃsthitam ..
muktvaikaṃ vedapaṭhanaṃ sūtatvaṃ ca yato mayi .. 58 ..
5.193.d:
तत्प्रसादादसंदिग्धं प्रमाणं चात्र संस्थितम् ..
मुक्त्वैकं वेदपठनं सूतत्वं च यतो मयि .. 58 ..
5.193.m: By his favor it is undoubtedly established here as authoritative, / except for the recitation of the Vedas alone, since sūtahood is in me.

5.193.s:
tasyāpi vedmi sarvārthaṃ bhartṛyajño yathā muniḥ ..
asmādatraiva gacchadhvaṃ yadi mukteḥ prayojanam .. .. 59 ..
5.193.d:
तस्यापि वेद्मि सर्वार्थं भर्तृयज्ञो यथा मुनिः ..
अस्मादत्रैव गच्छध्वं यदि मुक्तेः प्रयोजनम् .. .. 59 ..
5.193.m: Even of that, I know the entire meaning like the sage Bhartṛyajña. / Therefore, go to that very place if liberation is your purpose.

5.193.s:
kimetaiḥ svargadaiḥ satraiḥ punarāvṛttikārakaiḥ ..
ārādhayadhvaṃ te gatvā pāduke siddhide nṛṇām ..
yena saṃvatsarasyānte brahmajñānaṃ prajāyate .. .. 6.194.60 ..
5.193.d:
किमेतैः स्वर्गदैः सत्रैः पुनरावृत्तिकारकैः ..
आराधयध्वं ते गत्वा पादुके सिद्धिदे नृणाम् ..
येन संवत्सरस्यान्ते ब्रह्मज्ञानं प्रजायते .. .. 6.194.60 ..
5.193.m: "What is the use of these sacrificial sessions that bestow heaven, which cause rebirth? / Go and worship those sandals that grant perfection to men, / by which, at the end of a year, knowledge of Brahman is born."

5.193.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
sādhusādhu mahābhāga hyupadeśaḥ kṛto mahān ..
tena saṃtāritāḥ sarve vayaṃ saṃsārasāgarāt .. 61 ..
5.193.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
साधुसाधु महाभाग ह्युपदेशः कृतो महान् ..
तेन संतारिताः सर्वे वयं संसारसागरात् .. 61 ..
5.193.m: The seers said: / "Bravo, bravo, O highly fortunate one! Truly a great teaching has been given; / by it we have all been carried across the ocean of worldly existence.

5.193.s:
yāsyāmo'pi vayaṃ tatra satre dvādaśavārṣike ..
samāpte'sminna saṃdehaḥ sarve ca kṛtaniścayāḥ .. 62 ..
5.193.d:
यास्यामोऽपि वयं तत्र सत्रे द्वादशवार्षिके ..
समाप्तेऽस्मिन्न संदेहः सर्वे च कृतनिश्चयाः .. 62 ..
5.193.m: We too will go there when this twelve-year sacrificial session / is concluded, without a doubt; and all of us have made our resolve."

5.193.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye brahmajñānaprāptyarthaṃ kumārikātīrthadvayagartakṣetrasthapādukāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturṇavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 194 ..
5.193.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये ब्रह्मज्ञानप्राप्त्यर्थं कुमारिकातीर्थद्वयगर्तक्षेत्रस्थपादुकामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुर्णवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. .. 194 ..
5.193.m: Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-fourth chapter, named 'The Description of the māhātmya of the Sandals situated in the Garta-kṣetra of the Two Kumārikā Sacred Fords for the Sake of Attaining Knowledge of Brahman', in the māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.194.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
śūdrī ca brāhmaṇī cāpi ye tvayā parikīrtite ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre tīrthadvayamanuttamam .. 1 ..
5.194.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
शूद्री च ब्राह्मणी चापि ये त्वया परिकीर्तिते ..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे तीर्थद्वयमनुत्तमम् .. 1 ..
5.194.m: The seers said: / "The Śūdrī and also the Brāhmaṇī, who were extolled by you / as two unexcelled sacred fords born in the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara—

5.194.s:
tatkathaṃ tatra saṃjātaṃ kena vā tadvinirmitam ..
etacca sarvamācakṣva vistareṇa mahāmate .. 2 ..
5.194.d:
तत्कथं तत्र संजातं केन वा तद्विनिर्मितम् ..
एतच्च सर्वमाचक्ष्व विस्तरेण महामते .. 2 ..
5.194.m: how did that come to be there, or by whom was it made? / Tell all of this at length, O highly wise one!

5.194.s:
pādukābhyāṃ samutpattiḥ śrutā'smābhiḥ purā tava ..
vada taccāpi māhātmyaṃ tābhyāṃ caiva samudbhavam .. 3 ..
5.194.d:
पादुकाभ्यां समुत्पत्तिः श्रुताऽस्माभिः पुरा तव ..
वद तच्चापि माहात्म्यं ताभ्यां चैव समुद्भवम् .. 3 ..
5.194.m: The origin through the sandals was previously heard by us from you; / tell that māhātmya as well, and the arising from them!"

5.194.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
purāsīnnāgaro vipraśchāṃdogya iti viśrutaḥ ..
yasyā'nvaye'pi viprendrāśchāndogyā iti viśrutāḥ .. 4 ..
5.194.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
पुरासीन्नागरो विप्रश्छांदोग्य इति विश्रुतः ..
यस्याऽन्वयेऽपि विप्रेन्द्राश्छान्दोग्या इति विश्रुताः .. 4 ..
5.194.m: Sūta said: / "Formerly there was a Nāgara brahmin renowned as Chāndogya, / in whose lineage too the foremost brahmins were renowned as the Chāndogyas.

5.194.s:
sāmavedavidastasya gṛhasthāśramadharmiṇaḥ ..
paścime vayasi prāpte kanyā jātā suśobhanā .. 5 ..
5.194.d:
सामवेदविदस्तस्य गृहस्थाश्रमधर्मिणः ..
पश्चिमे वयसि प्राप्ते कन्या जाता सुशोभना .. 5 ..
5.194.m: To him, a knower of the Sāmaveda, observant of the duties of the householder stage of life, / when he reached old age, a very beautiful daughter was born,

5.194.s:
sarvairapi guṇairyuktā sarvalakṣaṇa lakṣitā ..
saptaraktā trigaṃbhīrā pañcasūkṣmā'bṛhatkaṭiḥ .. 6 ..
5.194.d:
सर्वैरपि गुणैर्युक्ता सर्वलक्षण लक्षिता ..
सप्तरक्ता त्रिगंभीरा पञ्चसूक्ष्माऽबृहत्कटिः .. 6 ..
5.194.m: endowed with all virtues, marked with every auspicious sign, / red in seven parts, deep in three, fine in five, not broad in the waist,

5.194.s:
padmapatraviśālākṣī laṃbakeśī suśobhanā ..
biṃboṣṭhī hrasvalomā ca pūrṇacandrasamaprabhā .. .. 7 ..
5.194.d:
पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षी लंबकेशी सुशोभना ..
बिंबोष्ठी ह्रस्वलोमा च पूर्णचन्द्रसमप्रभा .. .. 7 ..
5.194.m: with large eyes like lotus petals, long hair, very lovely, / with bimba-fruit lips, fine body hair, and splendor equal to the full moon.

5.194.s:
tasyā nāma pitā cakre brāhmaṇīti dvijottamāḥ ..
yasmātsā brāhmaṇairdattā maṇḍapānte supūjitaiḥ .. 8 ..
5.194.d:
तस्या नाम पिता चक्रे ब्राह्मणीति द्विजोत्तमाः ..
यस्मात्सा ब्राह्मणैर्दत्ता मण्डपान्ते सुपूजितैः .. 8 ..
5.194.m: Her father gave her the name 'Brāhmaṇī', O best of the twice-born, / because she was given [as a gift] by well-worshiped brahmins inside the pavilion

5.194.s:
paścime vayasi prāpte apatyarahitasya ca ..
vavṛdhe sā ca tanvaṅgī candralekhā yathā tathā .. 9 ..
5.194.d:
पश्चिमे वयसि प्राप्ते अपत्यरहितस्य च ..
ववृधे सा च तन्वङ्गी चन्द्रलेखा यथा तथा .. 9 ..
5.194.m: to him who had reached old age and was devoid of offspring. / And she of slender limbs grew just like the crescent moon

5.194.s:
śuklapakṣe tu saṃprāpte janalocanatuṣṭidā ..
yasminnahani saṃjātā chāndogyasya mahātmanaḥ ..
ānartādhipatestasmiṃstādṛgrūpā sutā'bhavat .. 6.195.10 ..
5.194.d:
शुक्लपक्षे तु संप्राप्ते जनलोचनतुष्टिदा ..
यस्मिन्नहनि संजाता छान्दोग्यस्य महात्मनः ..
आनर्ताधिपतेस्तस्मिंस्तादृग्रूपा सुताऽभवत् .. 6.195.10 ..
5.194.m: when the bright fortnight has arrived, delighting the eyes of men. / On the very day that she was born to the noble Chāndogya, / a daughter of similar beauty was born to the king of Ānarta,

5.194.s:
yasyāḥ kāyaprabhaugheṇa sarvaṃ tatsūtikāgṛham ..
niśāgame'pi saṃjātaṃ ratnaughairiva suprabham ..
tatastasyāḥ pitā nāma cakre ratnavatīti ca .. 11 ..
5.194.d:
यस्याः कायप्रभौघेण सर्वं तत्सूतिकागृहम् ..
निशागमेऽपि संजातं रत्नौघैरिव सुप्रभम् ..
ततस्तस्याः पिता नाम चक्रे रत्नवतीति च .. 11 ..
5.194.m: by the mass of whose bodily radiance the entire lying-in chamber / became bright with light, as if with masses of jewels, even when night came. / Therefore her father gave her the name Ratnavatī.

5.194.s:
atha sakhyaṃ samāpannā brāhmaṇyā saha sā śubhā ..
nairantaryeṇa tābhyāṃ ca viyogo naiva jāyate .. .. 12 ..
5.194.d:
अथ सख्यं समापन्ना ब्राह्मण्या सह सा शुभा ..
नैरन्तर्येण ताभ्यां च वियोगो नैव जायते .. .. 12 ..
5.194.m: Then that auspicious girl formed a friendship with Brāhmaṇī, / and between the two of them there was never any separation.

5.194.s:
ekāśanaṃ tathā śayyā ekānnena ca bhojanam ..
aṣṭame'bde ca saṃjāte pitā tasyā dvijottamāḥ .. 13 ..
5.194.d:
एकाशनं तथा शय्या एकान्नेन च भोजनम् ..
अष्टमेऽब्दे च संजाते पिता तस्या द्विजोत्तमाः .. 13 ..
5.194.m: They had a single seat, likewise a bed, and ate together of the same food. / When the eighth year arrived, O best of the twice-born,

5.194.s:
vivāhaṃ cintayāmāsa pradānāya vare tathā ..
sā jñātvā ceṣṭitaṃ tasya piturduḥkhasamanvitā .. 14 ..
5.194.d:
विवाहं चिन्तयामास प्रदानाय वरे तथा ..
सा ज्ञात्वा चेष्टितं तस्य पितुर्दुःखसमन्विता .. 14 ..
5.194.m: her father considered marriage, to bestow her upon a groom. / Learning of that intention of her father, filled with sorrow

5.194.s:
sakhyā viyogabhītā ca proce ratnavatī tadā ..
aśrupūrṇekṣaṇā dīnā bāṣpagadgadayā girā .. 15 ..
5.194.d:
सख्या वियोगभीता च प्रोचे रत्नवती तदा ..
अश्रुपूर्णेक्षणा दीना बाष्पगद्गदया गिरा .. 15 ..
5.194.m: and terrified of separation from her friend, Ratnavatī then spoke, / her eyes full of tears, distressed, with a voice choked with sobs:

5.194.s:
sakhi tāto vivāhaṃ me prakariṣyati sāṃpratam ..
vivāhitāyāśca sakhyaṃ na bhaviṣyati karhicit .. 16 ..
5.194.d:
सखि तातो विवाहं मे प्रकरिष्यति सांप्रतम् ..
विवाहितायाश्च सख्यं न भविष्यति कर्हिचित् .. 16 ..
5.194.m: "O friend, father will arrange my marriage now, / and for a married woman, friendship will never be possible!"

5.194.s:
vajrapātopamaṃ vākyaṃ tasyāḥ śrutvā sakhī ca sā ..
ruroda kaṇṭhamāśliṣya snehavyākulitendriyā .. 17 ..
5.194.d:
वज्रपातोपमं वाक्यं तस्याः श्रुत्वा सखी च सा ..
रुरोद कण्ठमाश्लिष्य स्नेहव्याकुलितेन्द्रिया .. 17 ..
5.194.m: Hearing her words like the fall of a thunderbolt, that friend also / wept, embracing her neck, her senses agitated by affection.

5.194.s:
atha tadruditaṃ śrutvā mātā tasyā mṛgāvatī ..
sasaṃbhramā samāgatya vākyametaduvāca ha .. 18 ..
5.194.d:
अथ तद्रुदितं श्रुत्वा माता तस्या मृगावती ..
ससंभ्रमा समागत्य वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 18 ..
5.194.m: Then, hearing that weeping, her mother, Mṛgāvatī, / arrived in agitation and indeed spoke these words:

5.194.s:
kimarthaṃ rudyate putri kena te vipriyaṃ kṛtam ..
karomi nigrahaṃ yena tasyādyaiva durātmanaḥ .. 19 ..
.. ratnavatyuvāca .. ..
śṛṇu me supriyātīva brāhmaṇī prāṇasaṃmatā ..
vivāhaṃ prāpya kalyāṇī prayāsyati patergṛham ..6.195.2...
5.194.d:
किमर्थं रुद्यते पुत्रि केन ते विप्रियं कृतम् ..
करोमि निग्रहं येन तस्याद्यैव दुरात्मनः .. 19 ..
.. रत्नवत्युवाच .. ..
शृणु मे सुप्रियातीव ब्राह्मणी प्राणसंमता ..
विवाहं प्राप्य कल्याणी प्रयास्यति पतेर्गृहम् ..6.195.2...
5.194.m:
"Why are you weeping, daughter? Who has caused you displeasure, / so that I may punish that wicked soul this very day?"
Ratnavatī said: / "Listen to me: my dear Brāhmaṇī, cherished like life itself, / having obtained marriage, the blessed girl will go to her husband's house.

5.194.s:
anayā rahitāhaṃ ca na jīvāmi kathaṃcana ..
etasmātkāraṇāddevi prarodimi suduḥkhitā .. 21 ..
5.194.d:
अनया रहिताहं च न जीवामि कथंचन ..
एतस्मात्कारणाद्देवि प्ररोदिमि सुदुःखिता .. 21 ..
5.194.m: And deprived of her, I cannot live by any means; / for this reason, O queen, I weep, deeply distressed."

5.194.s:
.. mṛgāvatyuvāca .. ..
yadyevaṃ putri yatra tvaṃ prayāsyasi patergṛhe ..
tasya rājñastu yo vipraḥ paurohitye vyavasthitaḥ .. 22 ..
5.194.d:
.. मृगावत्युवाच .. ..
यद्येवं पुत्रि यत्र त्वं प्रयास्यसि पतेर्गृहे ..
तस्य राज्ञस्तु यो विप्रः पौरोहित्ये व्यवस्थितः .. 22 ..
5.194.m: Mṛgāvatī said: / "If it is so, daughter, to whichever husband's house you will go, / whichever brahmin is established in the royal priesthood of that king,

5.194.s:
tasya putrāya dāsyāmi sakhīmenāṃ tava priyām ..
tatrāpi yena te saṃgo bhaviṣyatyanayā saha .. 23 ..
5.194.d:
तस्य पुत्राय दास्यामि सखीमेनां तव प्रियाम् ..
तत्रापि येन ते संगो भविष्यत्यनया सह .. 23 ..
5.194.m: to his son I will give this dear friend of yours, / so that there too you will have companionship with her."

5.194.s:
evamuktvā tato rājñī chādogyaṃ dvijasattamam ..
samānīyābravīdenaṃ vinayāvanatā sthitā ..24..
5.194.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततो राज्ञी छादोग्यं द्विजसत्तमम् ..
समानीयाब्रवीदेनं विनयावनता स्थिता ..24..
5.194.m: Having spoken thus, the queen then summoned Chāndogya, the best of the twice-born, / and bowed in humility, she said to him:

5.194.s:
iyaṃ tava sutā brahmansutāyā mama supriyā ..
na viyogaṃ sahatyasyā muhūrtamapi bhāminī .. 258 ..
tathā tava sutāyāśca suteyaṃ mama supriyā ..
tasmātkuru vaco mahyaṃ yacca vakṣyāmi suvrata ..26..
yasya me dīyate kanyā kadācinnṛpateriyam ..
purodhāstasya yo viprastasmai deyā nijā sutā ..27..
yena na syānmitho bhedastābhyāṃ dvijavarottama ..
ekasthāne sthitābhyāṃ ca prasā dāttava sattama .. 28 ..
.. chāṃdogya uvāca .. ..
nāgaro nāgaraṃ muktvā yo'nyasmai saṃprayacchati ..
kanyakāṃ yaḥ pragṛhṇāti vivāhārthaṃ kathaṃcana ... ..29..
sa paṃktidūṣakaḥ pāpānnāgaro na bhavediha ..
tasmānnāhaṃ pradāsyāmi kathaṃcinnijakanyakām ..
anyasmai nāgaraṃ muktvā niścayo'yaṃ mayā kṛtaḥ .. .. 6.195.30 ..
5.194.d:
इयं तव सुता ब्रह्मन्सुताया मम सुप्रिया ..
न वियोगं सहत्यस्या मुहूर्तमपि भामिनी .. 258 ..
तथा तव सुतायाश्च सुतेयं मम सुप्रिया ..
तस्मात्कुरु वचो मह्यं यच्च वक्ष्यामि सुव्रत ..26..
यस्य मे दीयते कन्या कदाचिन्नृपतेरियम् ..
पुरोधास्तस्य यो विप्रस्तस्मै देया निजा सुता ..27..
येन न स्यान्मिथो भेदस्ताभ्यां द्विजवरोत्तम ..
एकस्थाने स्थिताभ्यां च प्रसा दात्तव सत्तम .. 28 ..
.. छांदोग्य उवाच .. ..
नागरो नागरं मुक्त्वा योऽन्यस्मै संप्रयच्छति ..
कन्यकां यः प्रगृह्णाति विवाहार्थं कथंचन ... ..29..
स पंक्तिदूषकः पापान्नागरो न भवेदिह ..
तस्मान्नाहं प्रदास्यामि कथंचिन्निजकन्यकाम् ..
अन्यस्मै नागरं मुक्त्वा निश्चयोऽयं मया कृतः .. .. 6.195.30 ..
5.194.m:
"This daughter of yours, O brahmin, is very dear to my daughter; / this proud girl cannot bear separation from her even for a moment.
Likewise, this daughter of mine is very dear to your daughter; / therefore, fulfill my word which I shall speak, O you of noble vows!
To whichever king this maiden of mine is ever given, / to whichever brahmin is his priest, your own daughter should be given,
so that there may be no estrangement between them, O best of the foremost twice-born, / and they may remain in one place, by your favor, O excellent one!"
Chāndogya said: / "A Nāgara who, bypassing a Nāgara, gives to another, / or who accepts a maiden for marriage by any means,
he is a defiler of the row [of diners] through sin; he cannot be a Nāgara here. / Therefore I shall never give my daughter / to another, bypassing a Nāgara: this resolve has been made by me."

5.194.s:
.. brāhmaṇyuvāca .. ..
nāhaṃ patiṃ prayāsyāmi kumārī brahmacāriṇī ..
deyā priyā sakhī yatra tāvadyāsyāmi tatra ca .. 31 ..
yadi tāta balānmahyaṃ vivāhaṃ tvaṃ kariṣyasi ..
viṣaṃ vā bhakṣayiṣyāmi sādhayiṣyāmi pāvakam .. 32 ..
śastreṇa vā haniṣyāmi svadehaṃ tāta niścayam ...
evaṃ jñātvā tu tāta tvaṃ yatkṣamaṃ tatsamācara .. 33 ..
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasyāstaṃ niścayaṃ jñātvā sa vipro duḥkhasaṃyutaḥ ..
strīhatyāpāpa bhītastu tāṃ tyaktvā svagṛhaṃ yayau .. 34 ..
sāpi reme tayā sārdhaṃ ratnavatyā dvijottamāḥ ..
saṃhṛṣṭahṛdayā nityaṃ saṃtyaktapitṛsauhṛdā .. 35 ..
yauvanaṃ sā tu saṃprāptā rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi .. 36 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye chāndogyabrāhmaṇakanyāvṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma pañcanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 195 ..
5.194.d:
.. ब्राह्मण्युवाच .. ..
नाहं पतिं प्रयास्यामि कुमारी ब्रह्मचारिणी ..
देया प्रिया सखी यत्र तावद्यास्यामि तत्र च .. 31 ..
यदि तात बलान्मह्यं विवाहं त्वं करिष्यसि ..
विषं वा भक्षयिष्यामि साधयिष्यामि पावकम् .. 32 ..
शस्त्रेण वा हनिष्यामि स्वदेहं तात निश्चयम् ...
एवं ज्ञात्वा तु तात त्वं यत्क्षमं तत्समाचर .. 33 ..
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्यास्तं निश्चयं ज्ञात्वा स विप्रो दुःखसंयुतः ..
स्त्रीहत्यापाप भीतस्तु तां त्यक्त्वा स्वगृहं ययौ .. 34 ..
सापि रेमे तया सार्धं रत्नवत्या द्विजोत्तमाः ..
संहृष्टहृदया नित्यं संत्यक्तपितृसौहृदा .. 35 ..
यौवनं सा तु संप्राप्ता रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि .. 36 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये छान्दोग्यब्राह्मणकन्यावृत्तान्तवर्णनंनाम पञ्चनवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 195 ..
5.194.m:
Brāhmaṇī said: / "I will not go to a husband; as an unmarried girl observing celibacy, / wherever my dear friend is given, there only will I go!
If by force you arrange my marriage, father, / I will consume poison or resort to fire,
or I will surely destroy my body with a weapon, father! / Knowing this, father, do what is proper!"
Sūta said: / Knowing that resolve of hers, that brahmin, filled with grief / and fearing the sin of killing a woman, abandoned her and went to his own home.
She too delighted together with that Ratnavatī, O best of the twice-born, / her heart ever joyous, having renounced affection for her father.
She, for her part, reached youth, peerless in beauty on earth.
Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-fifth chapter, titled 'Description of the Account of the Daughter of the Chāndogya Brahmin', in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious and great Skandapurāṇa.

5.195.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
atha tāṃ yauvanopetāṃ svasutāṃ prekṣya pārthivaḥ ..
anaupamyena rūpeṇa saṃyuktāṃ varavarṇinīm ..
ānartaścintayāmāsa kanyakāṃ pradadāmyaham .. 1 ..
5.195.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अथ तां यौवनोपेतां स्वसुतां प्रेक्ष्य पार्थिवः ..
अनौपम्येन रूपेण संयुक्तां वरवर्णिनीम् ..
आनर्तश्चिन्तयामास कन्यकां प्रददाम्यहम् .. 1 ..
5.195.m: Sūta said: / Then, beholding his own daughter endowed with youth, / blessed with matchless beauty, a woman of exquisite complexion, / Ānarta reflected: 'To whom shall I give this maiden?

5.195.s:
anarhāya ca yo dadyā dvarāya nijakanyakām ..
kāryakāraṇalobhena narakaṃ sa pragacchati .. 2 ..
5.195.d:
अनर्हाय च यो दद्या द्वराय निजकन्यकाम् ..
कार्यकारणलोभेन नरकं स प्रगच्छति .. 2 ..
5.195.m: Whoever gives his own maiden to an unworthy bridegroom, / out of greed for some purpose or motive, goes straight to hell.

5.195.s:
evaṃ ciṃtayatastasya mahānkālo vyavasthitaḥ ..
na paśyati ca tadyogyaṃ kaṃcidvaramanuttamam .. 3 ..
5.195.d:
एवं चिंतयतस्तस्य महान्कालो व्यवस्थितः ..
न पश्यति च तद्योग्यं कंचिद्वरमनुत्तमम् .. 3 ..
5.195.m: While he was reflecting thus, a long time passed, / and he did not see any peerless bridegroom worthy of her.

5.195.s:
atha saṃpreṣayāmāsa sarvabhūtāśrayeṣu ye ..
citrakarmaṇi vikhyātānnarāṃścitrakarāṃstadā .. 4 ..
5.195.d:
अथ संप्रेषयामास सर्वभूताश्रयेषु ये ..
चित्रकर्मणि विख्यातान्नरांश्चित्रकरांस्तदा .. 4 ..
5.195.m: Then he dispatched painters famous for their skill in painting, / men who resided in all kinds of dwellings.

5.195.s:
gacchadhvaṃ mama vākyena sarvā nbhūmitale nṛpān ..
likhitvā paṭṭamadhye tu darśayadhvaṃ tataḥ param .. 5 ..
5.195.d:
गच्छध्वं मम वाक्येन सर्वा न्भूमितले नृपान् ..
लिखित्वा पट्टमध्ये तु दर्शयध्वं ततः परम् .. 5 ..
5.195.m: 'Go at my command and, having painted all the kings / on the face of the earth upon canvases, show them then

5.195.s:
sutāyā mama yenā'sau dṛṣṭvā'bhīṣṭaṃ narādhipam ..
patyarthaṃ varayetsādhvī mama doṣo bhavenna hi .. 6 ..
5.195.d:
सुताया मम येनाऽसौ दृष्ट्वाऽभीष्टं नराधिपम् ..
पत्यर्थं वरयेत्साध्वी मम दोषो भवेन्न हि .. 6 ..
5.195.m: to my daughter, so that, seeing the ruler of men she desires, / that virtuous girl may choose him for her husband; thus no fault shall be mine.'

5.195.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sarve citrakarāstadā ..
prasthitā dharaṇīpṛṣṭhe pārthivānāṃ gṛheṣu ca .. 7 ..
5.195.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सर्वे चित्रकरास्तदा ..
प्रस्थिता धरणीपृष्ठे पार्थिवानां गृहेषु च .. 7 ..
5.195.m: Hearing those words of his, all the painters then / departed across the surface of the earth and into the palaces of kings.

5.195.s:
te likhitvā mahīpālā nyauvanasthānvayo'nvitān ..
rūpaudāryaguṇopetāndarśayāmāsuragrataḥ ..
ratnavatyāḥ krameṇaiva tasya bhūpasya śāsanāt .. 8 ..
5.195.d:
ते लिखित्वा महीपाला न्यौवनस्थान्वयोऽन्वितान् ..
रूपौदार्यगुणोपेतान्दर्शयामासुरग्रतः ..
रत्नवत्याः क्रमेणैव तस्य भूपस्य शासनात् .. 8 ..
5.195.m: Having depicted rulers in the bloom of their youth, endowed with noble age, / endowed with beauty, generosity, and virtues, they presented them before / Ratnavatī in due order, in accordance with that king's command.

5.195.s:
atha teṣāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ madhye rājā vṛhadbalaḥ ..
daśārṇādhipatirbhavyaḥ patyarthaṃ ca vṛtastayā .. 9 ..
5.195.d:
अथ तेषां तु सर्वेषां मध्ये राजा वृहद्बलः ..
दशार्णाधिपतिर्भव्यः पत्यर्थं च वृतस्तया .. 9 ..
5.195.m: Then, from among them all, King Bṛhadbala, / the handsome ruler of Daśārṇa, was chosen by her as her husband.

5.195.s:
tadā''nartādhipo hṛṣṭaḥ preṣayāmāsa taṃ prati ..
vivāhārthaṃ suvijñāya vākya metaduvāca ha .. 6.196.10 ..
5.195.d:
तदा'ऽनर्ताधिपो हृष्टः प्रेषयामास तं प्रति ..
विवाहार्थं सुविज्ञाय वाक्य मेतदुवाच ह .. 6.196.10 ..
5.195.m: Thereupon the ruler of Ānarta, delighted, having fully understood, / sent [messengers] to him for the marriage and spoke these words:

5.195.s:
gacchadhvaṃ mama vākyena daśārṇādhipatiṃ prati ..
vācyaḥ sa vinayādgatvā vivāhārthaṃ mamāṃtikam .. 11 ..
5.195.d:
गच्छध्वं मम वाक्येन दशार्णाधिपतिं प्रति ..
वाच्यः स विनयाद्गत्वा विवाहार्थं ममांतिकम् .. 11 ..
5.195.m: 'Go at my command to the ruler of Daśārṇa; / having approached with humility, he is to be addressed: 'For the marriage, come into my presence,

5.195.s:
samāgaccha nijāṃ kanyāṃ yena yacchāmyahaṃ tava ..
nāmnā ratnavatīṃ khyātāṃ trailokyasyāpi sundarīm .. 12 ..
5.195.d:
समागच्छ निजां कन्यां येन यच्छाम्यहं तव ..
नाम्ना रत्नवतीं ख्यातां त्रैलोक्यस्यापि सुन्दरीम् .. 12 ..
5.195.m: so that I may bestow upon you my own daughter, / renowned by the name Ratnavatī, the beauty even of the three worlds.''

5.195.s:
gatvā sa satvaraṃ tatra yatra rājā bṛhadbalaḥ ..
provāca sakalaṃ vākyamānartādhipateḥ sphuṭam .. 13 ..
5.195.d:
गत्वा स सत्वरं तत्र यत्र राजा बृहद्बलः ..
प्रोवाच सकलं वाक्यमानर्ताधिपतेः स्फुटम् .. 13 ..
5.195.m: Having gone quickly thither, where King Bṛhadbala was, / [the messenger] clearly declared the entire speech of the lord of Ānarta.

5.195.s:
so'pi tatsahasā śrutvā teṣāṃ vākyamanuttamam ..
paramāṃ tuṣṭimāsādya prasthitastatpuraṃ prati ..
sainyena mahatā yuktaścaturaṃgeṇa pārthivaḥ .. 14 ..
5.195.d:
सोऽपि तत्सहसा श्रुत्वा तेषां वाक्यमनुत्तमम् ..
परमां तुष्टिमासाद्य प्रस्थितस्तत्पुरं प्रति ..
सैन्येन महता युक्तश्चतुरंगेण पार्थिवः .. 14 ..
5.195.m: He too, immediately hearing their excellent words, / attained the highest satisfaction and set forth toward that city, / that king accompanied by a vast fourfold army.

5.195.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye daśārṇādhipaterbṛhadbalasyānarteśapuraṃ pratyāgamanavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṇṇavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 196 ..
5.195.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये दशार्णाधिपतेर्बृहद्बलस्यानर्तेशपुरं प्रत्यागमनवर्णनंनाम षण्णवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 196 ..
5.195.m: Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-sixth chapter, titled 'Description of the Arrival of Bṛhadbala, the Ruler of Daśārṇa, at the City of the Lord of Ānarta', in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious and great Skandapurāṇa.

5.196.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etasminneva kāle tu nāgaro dvijasattamāḥ ..
viśvāvasuriti khyāto vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ .. 1 ..
5.196.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु नागरो द्विजसत्तमाः ..
विश्वावसुरिति ख्यातो वेदवेदांगपारगः .. 1 ..
5.196.m: Sūta said: / At that very time, O best of brahmins, there lived a Nāgara [brahmin] / named Viśvāvasu, who was fully versed in the Vedas and Vedāṅgas.

5.196.s:
paścime vayasi prāpte tasya putro babhūva ha ..
parāvasuriti khyātastasya prāṇasamaḥ sadā .. 2 ..
5.196.d:
पश्चिमे वयसि प्राप्ते तस्य पुत्रो बभूव ह ..
परावसुरिति ख्यातस्तस्य प्राणसमः सदा .. 2 ..
5.196.m: When he had reached an advanced age, a son was born to him / known as Parāvasu, who was ever dear to him as his own life.

5.196.s:
sa vedādhyayanaṃ cakre yauvane samupasthite ..
vayasyaiḥ saṃmataiḥ sārdhaṃ sadā hāsya parāyaṇaiḥ .. 3 ..
5.196.d:
स वेदाध्ययनं चक्रे यौवने समुपस्थिते ..
वयस्यैः संमतैः सार्धं सदा हास्य परायणैः .. 3 ..
5.196.m: When his youth arrived, he engaged in Vedic study / alongside trusted companions of his own age, who were always devoted to jesting.

5.196.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya māghamāsa upasthite ..
rātrau so'dhyayanaṃ cakra upādhyāyagṛhaṃ gataḥ .. 4 ..
5.196.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य माघमास उपस्थिते ..
रात्रौ सोऽध्ययनं चक्र उपाध्यायगृहं गतः .. 4 ..
5.196.m: Then, at a certain time when the month of Māgha had arrived, / having gone to his teacher's house, he studied at night.

5.196.s:
niśīthe sa samutthāya sarvairmi traiśca rakṣitaḥ ..
veśyāgṛhaṃ samāsādya prasupto veśyayā saha .. 5 ..
5.196.d:
निशीथे स समुत्थाय सर्वैर्मि त्रैश्च रक्षितः ..
वेश्यागृहं समासाद्य प्रसुप्तो वेश्यया सह .. 5 ..
5.196.m: Rising at midnight, protected by all his friends, / he went to a courtesan's house and fell asleep with the courtesan,

5.196.s:
jalapūrṇaṃ samādhāya jalapātraṃ samīpagam ..
nijācamanayogyaṃ ca jalapānārthameva ca .. 6 ..
5.196.d:
जलपूर्णं समाधाय जलपात्रं समीपगम् ..
निजाचमनयोग्यं च जलपानार्थमेव च .. 6 ..
5.196.m: having placed nearby a water-pot full of water, / suitable for his own ācamana and for drinking water.

5.196.s:
niśāśeṣe tu saṃprāpte sa pipāsāsamākulaḥ ..
nidrālasyasamopetaḥ śayyāṃ tyaktvā samutthitaḥ .. 7 ..
5.196.d:
निशाशेषे तु संप्राप्ते स पिपासासमाकुलः ..
निद्रालस्यसमोपेतः शय्यां त्यक्त्वा समुत्थितः .. 7 ..
5.196.m: When the rest of the night was drawing to an end, afflicted by thirst, / overcome with the sluggishness of sleep, he left the bed and rose.

5.196.s:
veśyāyā madyapātraṃ tu hyadhastātsaṃ vyavasthitam ..
tadādāya papau madyaṃ jalabhrāṃtyā yadaiva saḥ .. 8 ..
5.196.d:
वेश्याया मद्यपात्रं तु ह्यधस्तात्सं व्यवस्थितम् ..
तदादाय पपौ मद्यं जलभ्रांत्या यदैव सः .. 8 ..
5.196.m: The courtesan's vessel of wine stood just below; / taking that, mistaking it for water, he drank the wine.

5.196.s:
tadā madyaṃ parijñāya pātraṃ tyaktvā suduḥkhitaḥ ..
vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gatvā pralāpānakaro dbahūn .. 9 ..
5.196.d:
तदा मद्यं परिज्ञाय पात्रं त्यक्त्वा सुदुःखितः ..
वैराग्यं परमं गत्वा प्रलापानकरो द्बहून् .. 9 ..
5.196.m: Then, realizing it was wine, he dropped the vessel, deeply grieved; / having attained extreme revulsion, he uttered many laments:

5.196.s:
aho nidrānvitenādya kiṃ mayā vikṛtaṃ kṛtam ..
yadadya madyamāpītaṃ jalabhrāṃtyā vigarhitam.. 6.197.10 ..
5.196.d:
अहो निद्रान्वितेनाद्य किं मया विकृतं कृतम् ..
यदद्य मद्यमापीतं जलभ्रांत्या विगर्हितम्.. 6.197.10 ..
5.196.m: 'Alas! Overcome with sleep today, what deformed deed have I done, / in that today, mistaking it for water, I drank reprehensible wine!

5.196.s:
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kathaṃ śuddhirbhavenmama ..
prāyaścittaṃ kariṣyāmi yadyapi syātsuduṣkaram .. 11 ..
5.196.d:
किं करोमि क्व गच्छामि कथं शुद्धिर्भवेन्मम ..
प्रायश्चित्तं करिष्यामि यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुष्करम् .. 11 ..
5.196.m: What shall I do? Where shall I go? How can my purification come to be? / I will perform an expiation, even if it be extremely difficult to do!'

5.196.s:
evaṃ niścitya manasā prabhāte samupasthite ..
śaṃkhatīrthaṃ samāsādya kṛtvā snānaṃ tathā param .. 12 ..
5.196.d:
एवं निश्चित्य मनसा प्रभाते समुपस्थिते ..
शंखतीर्थं समासाद्य कृत्वा स्नानं तथा परम् .. 12 ..
5.196.m: Having resolved thus in his mind, when morning had arrived, / he went to the Śaṅkhatīrtha and performed the supreme ritual ablution.

5.196.s:
saśikhaṃ vapanaṃ paścātkārayitvā tvarāvitaḥ ..
gataśca tiṣṭhate yatra brahmaghoṣaparāyaṇaḥ .. 13 ..
5.196.d:
सशिखं वपनं पश्चात्कारयित्वा त्वरावितः ..
गतश्च तिष्ठते यत्र ब्रह्मघोषपरायणः .. 13 ..
5.196.m: Then, having hastily caused his head to be shaved along with the topknot, / he went to where, devoted to the chanting of the Veda,

5.196.s:
upādhyāyaḥ saśiṣyaśca brahmasthānaṃ samāśritaḥ ..
sa gatvā dūrataḥ sthitvā saṃniviṣṭo yathāntyajaḥ ..14..
5.196.d:
उपाध्यायः सशिष्यश्च ब्रह्मस्थानं समाश्रितः ..
स गत्वा दूरतः स्थित्वा संनिविष्टो यथान्त्यजः ..14..
5.196.m: the teacher along with his disciples was situated at the place of holy study. / Having gone there and standing afar off, he sat down like an outcaste.

5.196.s:
śmaśrumūrdhajahīnastu yadā mitrairvilokitaḥ ..
tadā hāsyāddhato mūrdhni hastāgraiśca muhurmuhuḥ .. 15 ..
5.196.d:
श्मश्रुमूर्धजहीनस्तु यदा मित्रैर्विलोकितः ..
तदा हास्याद्धतो मूर्ध्नि हस्ताग्रैश्च मुहुर्मुहुः .. 15 ..
5.196.m: When he was seen by his friends shorn of beard and hair, / they struck him on the head again and again with their fingertips in laughter.

5.196.s:
upādhyāyastu taṃ dṛṣṭvā dīnaṃ bāṣpapariplutam ..
śmaśrumūrdhajasaṃtyaktaṃ tataḥ provāca sādaram ..16..
5.196.d:
उपाध्यायस्तु तं दृष्ट्वा दीनं बाष्पपरिप्लुतम् ..
श्मश्रुमूर्धजसंत्यक्तं ततः प्रोवाच सादरम् ..16..
5.196.m: Seeing him wretched, overflowing with tears, / and stripped of beard and hair, the teacher then respectfully said:

5.196.s:
kimadya vatsa dūre tvamupaviṣṭastu dainyadhṛk ..
ehi me saṃnidhau brūhi parābhūto'si kena vā .. 17 ..
5.196.d:
किमद्य वत्स दूरे त्वमुपविष्टस्तु दैन्यधृक् ..
एहि मे संनिधौ ब्रूहि पराभूतोऽसि केन वा .. 17 ..
5.196.m: 'Child, why are you sitting afar today, wearing a miserable look? / Come into my presence and speak: by whom have you been overcome?'

5.196.s:
.. parāvasuruvāca .. ..
ayogyo'haṃ guro jātaḥ sevāyāstava sāṃpratam ..
veśyāyā maṃdirasthena jñātvā nijakamaṃḍalum .. 18 ..
5.196.d:
.. परावसुरुवाच .. ..
अयोग्योऽहं गुरो जातः सेवायास्तव सांप्रतम् ..
वेश्याया मंदिरस्थेन ज्ञात्वा निजकमंडलुम् .. 18 ..
5.196.m: Parāvasu said: / 'O guru, I have now become unworthy of serving you. / Staying in the house of a courtesan, thinking it to be my own kamaṇḍalu,

5.196.s:
veśyāyā madyapātraṃ tu madyapūrṇaṃ pragṛhya ca ..
tasmāddehi vibho mahyaṃ prāyaścittaṃ viśuddhaye .. 19 ..
5.196.d:
वेश्याया मद्यपात्रं तु मद्यपूर्णं प्रगृह्य च ..
तस्माद्देहि विभो मह्यं प्रायश्चित्तं विशुद्धये .. 19 ..
5.196.m: I took the courtesan's vessel of wine, full of liquor, [and drank it]. / Therefore, O lord, grant me an expiation for purification!

5.196.s: dharmadroṇeṣu yatproktaṃ tatkariṣyāmyasaṃśayam .. 6.197.20 ..
5.196.d: धर्मद्रोणेषु यत्प्रोक्तं तत्करिष्याम्यसंशयम् .. 6.197.20 ..
5.196.m: Whatever is prescribed in the sacred law-codes, I shall perform without a doubt.'

5.196.s:
atha taṃ baṭavaḥ procurvayasyāstasya ye sthitāḥ ..
hāsyaṃ kṛtvā prakāmāśca veśyā yā gurusaṃnidhau ..21 ..
5.196.d:
अथ तं बटवः प्रोचुर्वयस्यास्तस्य ये स्थिताः ..
हास्यं कृत्वा प्रकामाश्च वेश्या या गुरुसंनिधौ ..21 ..
5.196.m: Then the students, who were his companions standing there, / having laughed to their hearts' content, said before the teacher:

5.196.s:
yā eṣā nṛpateḥ kanyā khyātā ratnāvatī jane ..
asyāḥ stanau gṛhītvā tvamadharaṃ pibasi drutam ..
tataste syādviśuddhiśca nānyathā prabhaviṣyati .. 22 ..
5.196.d:
या एषा नृपतेः कन्या ख्याता रत्नावती जने ..
अस्याः स्तनौ गृहीत्वा त्वमधरं पिबसि द्रुतम् ..
ततस्ते स्याद्विशुद्धिश्च नान्यथा प्रभविष्यति .. 22 ..
5.196.m: 'She who is the king's daughter, known among people as Ratnāvatī— / if you quickly seize her breasts and drink from her lower lip, / then your purification will be accomplished; it cannot happen otherwise!'

5.196.s:
.. parāvasuruvāca .. ..
na vayasyā narmakālo viṣame mama saṃsthite ..
mamopari yadi sneho vālamitratvasaṃbhavaḥ ..
tadānīya dvijānanyānvadadhvaṃ niṣkṛtiṃ mama .. 23 ..
5.196.d:
.. परावसुरुवाच .. ..
न वयस्या नर्मकालो विषमे मम संस्थिते ..
ममोपरि यदि स्नेहो वालमित्रत्वसंभवः ..
तदानीय द्विजानन्यान्वदध्वं निष्कृतिं मम .. 23 ..
5.196.m: Parāvasu said: / 'O companions, this is no time for jest, when I am in dire straits. / If you have affection for me, born of childhood friendship, / then bring other brahmins and declare my expiation!'

5.196.s:
atha te narmamutsṛjya tadduḥkhena ca duḥkhitāḥ ..
viśvāvasuṃ samāsādya tadvṛttāṃtamathābruvan ..24..
5.196.d:
अथ ते नर्ममुत्सृज्य तद्दुःखेन च दुःखिताः ..
विश्वावसुं समासाद्य तद्वृत्तांतमथाब्रुवन् ..24..
5.196.m: Then, abandoning their jesting and grieved by his distress, / they approached Viśvāvasu and reported the matter to him.

5.196.s:
so'pi teṣāṃ samākarṇya tatkarṇakaṭukaṃ vacaḥ ..
sabhāryaḥ prayayau tatra yatra putro vyavasthitaḥ .. 25 ..
5.196.d:
सोऽपि तेषां समाकर्ण्य तत्कर्णकटुकं वचः ..
सभार्यः प्रययौ तत्र यत्र पुत्रो व्यवस्थितः .. 25 ..
5.196.m: He too, hearing those words that were harsh to his ears, / went together with his wife to where his son was staying.

5.196.s:
duḥkhena mahatā yuktaḥ skhalamānaḥ padepade ..
vṛddhabhāvāttathā śokātputrākṛtyasamudbhavāt .. 26 ..
5.196.d:
दुःखेन महता युक्तः स्खलमानः पदेपदे ..
वृद्धभावात्तथा शोकात्पुत्राकृत्यसमुद्भवात् .. 26 ..
5.196.m: Overcome with great sorrow, stumbling at every step / due to old age and also grief arising from his son's improper deed,

5.196.s:
tatastau procatuḥ putraṃ bāṣpagadgadayā girā ..
daṃpatī bahuśokārtau hā putra kimidaṃ kṛtam ..
so'pi sarvaṃ samācakhyau tābhyāṃ vṛtāṃtamātmanaḥ .. 27 ..
5.196.d:
ततस्तौ प्रोचतुः पुत्रं बाष्पगद्गदया गिरा ..
दंपती बहुशोकार्तौ हा पुत्र किमिदं कृतम् ..
सोऽपि सर्वं समाचख्यौ ताभ्यां वृतांतमात्मनः .. 27 ..
5.196.m: the two of them, husband and wife, tormented by intense sorrow, then said to their son in voices choked with tears: / 'Ah, son, what has been done?' He too narrated the whole story of his to both of them:

5.196.s:
prāyaścittaṃ kariṣyāmi tasmādātmaviśuddhaye ..
tato viśvāvasurviprānsmārtāñchrutisamanvitān ..
tadarthamānayāmāsa vedavidyāvicakṣaṇān .. 28 ..
5.196.d:
प्रायश्चित्तं करिष्यामि तस्मादात्मविशुद्धये ..
ततो विश्वावसुर्विप्रान्स्मार्ताञ्छ्रुतिसमन्वितान् ..
तदर्थमानयामास वेदविद्याविचक्षणान् .. 28 ..
5.196.m: 'Therefore, I shall perform an expiation for my own purification.' / Then Viśvāvasu, for that purpose, summoned brahmins versed in Smṛti and endowed with Śruti, who were experts in the knowledge of the Vedas.

5.196.s:
tataḥ parāvasusteṣāṃ puraḥ sthitvā kṛtāṃjaliḥ ..
provāca svāditaṃ madyaṃ mayā rātrāvajānatā ..
veśyā bhāṃḍaṃ samādāya jñātvā nijakamaṃḍalum .. 29 ..
evaṃ jñātvā yadarhaṃ ca prāyaścittaṃ pradīyatām ..
yena me jāyate śuddhiḥ prasādādvo dvijottamāḥ ..6.197.3...
5.196.d:
ततः परावसुस्तेषां पुरः स्थित्वा कृतांजलिः ..
प्रोवाच स्वादितं मद्यं मया रात्रावजानता ..
वेश्या भांडं समादाय ज्ञात्वा निजकमंडलुम् .. 29 ..
एवं ज्ञात्वा यदर्हं च प्रायश्चित्तं प्रदीयताम् ..
येन मे जायते शुद्धिः प्रसादाद्वो द्विजोत्तमाः ..6.197.3...
5.196.m:
Then Parāvasu, standing before them with joined palms, / said: 'Liquor was tasted by me at night unknowingly, / having taken the vessel of a courtesan, thinking it was my own water-pot.
Knowing this, let an appropriate expiation be prescribed, / by which my purification may take place through your grace, O best of brahmins.'

5.196.s:
evamuktāstatastena viprāste smṛtivādinaḥ ..
dharmaśāstraṃ samālokya tataḥ procuśca taṃ dvijāḥ .. 31 ..
5.196.d:
एवमुक्तास्ततस्तेन विप्रास्ते स्मृतिवादिनः ..
धर्मशास्त्रं समालोक्य ततः प्रोचुश्च तं द्विजाः .. 31 ..
5.196.m: Addressed thus by him, those brahmins, exponents of the Smṛti, / then consulted the Dharmaśāstra and said to him:

5.196.s:
atimānādatikrodhātsnehādvā yadi vā bhayāt ..
prāyaścittamanarhaṃ tu dadattatpāpamaśnute .. 32 ..
5.196.d:
अतिमानादतिक्रोधात्स्नेहाद्वा यदि वा भयात् ..
प्रायश्चित्तमनर्हं तु ददत्तत्पापमश्नुते .. 32 ..
5.196.m: 'Giving an unsuitable expiation out of excessive pride, excessive anger, / affection, or even fear, one incurs that sin.

5.196.s:
prāyaścittaṃ pradāsyāmastasmādyuktaṃ vayaṃ tava ..
yadi śaknoṣi tatkartuṃ tatkuruṣva samāhitaḥ .. 33 .. ..
5.196.d:
प्रायश्चित्तं प्रदास्यामस्तस्माद्युक्तं वयं तव ..
यदि शक्नोषि तत्कर्तुं तत्कुरुष्व समाहितः .. 33 .. ..
5.196.m: Therefore, we will prescribe for you the proper expiation. / If you are able to perform it, then do so with a composed mind.'

5.196.s:
.. parāvasuruvāca .. ..
karomi vo na cedvākyaṃ tatpṛcchāmi kuto dvijāḥ ..
nāhaṃ kenāpi saṃdṛṣṭo madyapānaṃ samācaran .. 34 ..
5.196.d:
.. परावसुरुवाच .. ..
करोमि वो न चेद्वाक्यं तत्पृच्छामि कुतो द्विजाः ..
नाहं केनापि संदृष्टो मद्यपानं समाचरन् .. 34 ..
5.196.m: Parāvasu said: / 'If I do not carry out your word, then why should I ask, O brahmins? / I was not seen drinking liquor by anyone.

5.196.s:
tasmādbrūta yathārhaṃ me prāyaścittaṃ viśuddhaye ..
api prāṇaharaṃ raudraṃ no cetpāpamavāpsyatha .. 35 ..
5.196.d:
तस्माद्ब्रूत यथार्हं मे प्रायश्चित्तं विशुद्धये ..
अपि प्राणहरं रौद्रं नो चेत्पापमवाप्स्यथ .. 35 ..
5.196.m: Therefore, declare an expiation suitable for my purification, / even if it takes life or is terrible; otherwise you will incur sin.'

5.196.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
budhyamāno dvijo yastu madyapānaṃ samācaret ..
tāvanmātraṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca taptaṃ pītvā viśudhyati .. 36 ..
5.196.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
बुध्यमानो द्विजो यस्तु मद्यपानं समाचरेत् ..
तावन्मात्रं हिरण्यं च तप्तं पीत्वा विशुध्यति .. 36 ..
5.196.m: The brahmins said: / 'A twice-born who intentionally drinks liquor / becomes purified only by drinking that same quantity of molten gold.

5.196.s:
ajñānato yadā pītaṃ madyaṃ vipreṇa karhicit ..
agnitulyaṃ ghṛtaṃ pītvā tāvanmātraṃ viśudhyati .. .. 37 ..
5.196.d:
अज्ञानतो यदा पीतं मद्यं विप्रेण कर्हिचित् ..
अग्नितुल्यं घृतं पीत्वा तावन्मात्रं विशुध्यति .. .. 37 ..
5.196.m: When liquor is drunk unknowingly by a brahmin at any time, / he is purified by drinking that same quantity of ghee hot as fire.

5.196.s:
evaṃ te sarvamākhyātaṃ prāyaścittaṃ viśuddhaye ..
yadi śaktoṣi cetkartuṃ kuruṣva tvaṃ dvijottama .. 38 ..
5.196.d:
एवं ते सर्वमाख्यातं प्रायश्चित्तं विशुद्धये ..
यदि शक्तोषि चेत्कर्तुं कुरुष्व त्वं द्विजोत्तम .. 38 ..
5.196.m: Thus has the entire expiation been explained to you for purification. / If you are able to perform it, do so, O best of brahmins.'

5.196.s:
.. parāvasuruvāca .. ..
gaṃḍūṣamekaṃ madyasya mayā pītaṃ dvijottamāḥ ..
tāvanmātraṃ pibāmyeva ghṛtaṃ vahnisamaṃ kṛtam .. 39 ..
5.196.d:
.. परावसुरुवाच .. ..
गंडूषमेकं मद्यस्य मया पीतं द्विजोत्तमाः ..
तावन्मात्रं पिबाम्येव घृतं वह्निसमं कृतम् .. 39 ..
5.196.m: Parāvasu said: / 'A single mouthful of liquor was drunk by me, O best of brahmins; / I shall certainly drink that same amount of ghee heated equal to fire,

5.196.s:
yuṣmadādeśato'dyaiva svaśarīraviśuddhaye ..
viśvāvasuśca tacchrutvā vajrapātopamaṃ vacaḥ .. 6.197.40 ..
5.196.d:
युष्मदादेशतोऽद्यैव स्वशरीरविशुद्धये ..
विश्वावसुश्च तच्छ्रुत्वा वज्रपातोपमं वचः .. 6.197.40 ..
5.196.m: by your command this very day, for the purification of my body.' / And Viśvāvasu, hearing that word resembling a thunderbolt's strike,

5.196.s:
viprāṇāṃ cātha putrasya tadovāca suduḥkhitaḥ ..
kṛtvāśrumokṣaṇaṃ bhūri bāṣpagadgadayā girā .. 41 ..
5.196.d:
विप्राणां चाथ पुत्रस्य तदोवाच सुदुःखितः ..
कृत्वाश्रुमोक्षणं भूरि बाष्पगद्गदया गिरा .. 41 ..
5.196.m: shedding copious tears, then spoke exceedingly grieved / to the brahmins and to his son in a voice choked with tears:

5.196.s:
sarvasvamapi dāsyāmi putrasyāsya viśuddhaye ..
prāyaścittaṃ samācartuṃ na dāsyāmi kathaṃcana .. 42 ..
5.196.d:
सर्वस्वमपि दास्यामि पुत्रस्यास्य विशुद्धये ..
प्रायश्चित्तं समाचर्तुं न दास्यामि कथंचन .. 42 ..
5.196.m: 'I will give away even all my possessions for the purification of this son; / I will by no means allow him to perform this expiation.

5.196.s:
aśrāddheyo vipāṃkteyaḥ saputro vā bhavāmyaham..
sthānaṃ vā saṃtyajāmyetatputra maivaṃ samācara .. 43 ..
5.196.d:
अश्राद्धेयो विपांक्तेयः सपुत्रो वा भवाम्यहम्..
स्थानं वा संत्यजाम्येतत्पुत्र मैवं समाचर .. 43 ..
5.196.m: Let me become unfit for ancestral rites or outcasted from dining, together with my son, / or I shall abandon this place! Son, do not do such a thing!'

5.196.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya piturvighnakaraṃ param ..
prāyaścittasya sasnehaṃ putro vacanamabravīt .. 44 ..
5.196.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य पितुर्विघ्नकरं परम् ..
प्रायश्चित्तस्य सस्नेहं पुत्रो वचनमब्रवीत् .. 44 ..
5.196.m: Hearing that speech of his father causing an absolute obstacle / to the expiation, the son spoke affectionately:

5.196.s:
tyaja tāta mama snehaṃ mā vighnaṃ me samācara ..
prāyaścittaṃ kariṣyāmi niścayo'yaṃ mayā kṛtaḥ .. 45 ..
5.196.d:
त्यज तात मम स्नेहं मा विघ्नं मे समाचर ..
प्रायश्चित्तं करिष्यामि निश्चयोऽयं मया कृतः .. 45 ..
5.196.m: 'Father, abandon your affection for me; do not create an obstacle for me. / I will perform the expiation; this resolution has been made by me.'

5.196.s:
..mātovāca .. ..
yadi putra tvayā kāryaṃ prāyaścittaṃ viśuddhaye ..
tadahaṃ patinā sārdhaṃ pravekṣyāmi puro'nalam .. 46 ..
5.196.d:
..मातोवाच .. ..
यदि पुत्र त्वया कार्यं प्रायश्चित्तं विशुद्धये ..
तदहं पतिना सार्धं प्रवेक्ष्यामि पुरोऽनलम् .. 46 ..
5.196.m: The mother said: / 'Son, if the expiation must be performed by you for purification, / then I, together with your father, will enter the fire beforehand.

5.196.s:
tvāṃ draṣṭuṃ naiva śakromi pibaṃtamagnivadghṛtam ..
paścātprāṇaparityaktaṃ satyenā tmānamālabhe .. 47 ..
5.196.d:
त्वां द्रष्टुं नैव शक्रोमि पिबंतमग्निवद्घृतम् ..
पश्चात्प्राणपरित्यक्तं सत्येना त्मानमालभे .. 47 ..
5.196.m: I cannot at all bear to see you drinking ghee like fire / and subsequently abandoned by life; I swear on truth by myself.'

5.196.s:
.. pitovāca .. ..
yuktaṃ putrānayā proktaṃ mātrā tava hitaṃ tathā ..
mamāpi saṃmataṃ hyetatkariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ .. 48 .. ..
5.196.d:
.. पितोवाच .. ..
युक्तं पुत्रानया प्रोक्तं मात्रा तव हितं तथा ..
ममापि संमतं ह्येतत्करिष्यामि न संशयः .. 48 .. ..
5.196.m: The father said: / 'What was spoken by this mother of yours is proper, son, and likewise for your benefit; / indeed, this is also approved by me, and I shall do so without doubt.'

5.196.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etasminnaṃtare sarve suhṛdastasya ye sthitāḥ 1.
tacchrutvā taṃ samāyātā vṛttāṃtaṃ duḥkhasaṃyutāḥ .. 49 ..
procuśca vividhairvākyaiḥ sapatnīkaṃ vibhāvasum ..
putraśokena saṃtaptaṃ maraṇe kṛtaniścayam ..6.197.5...
5.196.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे सर्वे सुहृदस्तस्य ये स्थिताः 1.
तच्छ्रुत्वा तं समायाता वृत्तांतं दुःखसंयुताः .. 49 ..
प्रोचुश्च विविधैर्वाक्यैः सपत्नीकं विभावसुम् ..
पुत्रशोकेन संतप्तं मरणे कृतनिश्चयम् ..6.197.5...
5.196.m:
Sūta said: / In the meantime, all his friends who were there, / hearing that account, arrived full of sorrow.
And they addressed with diverse words Viśvāvasu along with his wife, / who was burning with grief for his son and had resolved upon death,

5.196.s:
putraṃ prabodhayāmāsuḥ prāyaścittanivṛttaye ..
tadā na śaknuvaṃti sma nivartayitumaṃ jasā .. 51 ..
5.196.d:
पुत्रं प्रबोधयामासुः प्रायश्चित्तनिवृत्तये ..
तदा न शक्नुवंति स्म निवर्तयितुमं जसा .. 51 ..
5.196.m: and they admonished the son to desist from the expiation; / at that time they were not able to turn him back at all,

5.196.s: tāvubhau ca pitāputrau prāṇatyāgakṛtādarau .. 52 ..
5.196.d: तावुभौ च पितापुत्रौ प्राणत्यागकृतादरौ .. 52 ..
5.196.m: since both of them, father and son, were intent on abandoning their lives.

5.196.s:
tato vāstupadaṃ jagmuḥ sarvajño yatra tiṣṭhati ..
bhartṛyajño mahābhāgaḥ sarvasaṃdeha vārakaḥ .. 53 ..
5.196.d:
ततो वास्तुपदं जग्मुः सर्वज्ञो यत्र तिष्ठति ..
भर्तृयज्ञो महाभागः सर्वसंदेह वारकः .. 53 ..
5.196.m: Then they went to the residential quarter where stayed the all-knowing / illustrious Bhartṛyajña, the dispeller of all doubts.

5.196.s:
tasya sarvaṃ samācakhyuḥ parāvasusamudbhavam ..
vṛttāṃtaṃ madyapānotthaṃ yanmitraistasya kīrtitam .. 54 ..
5.196.d:
तस्य सर्वं समाचख्युः परावसुसमुद्भवम् ..
वृत्तांतं मद्यपानोत्थं यन्मित्रैस्तस्य कीर्तितम् .. 54 ..
5.196.m: They reported to him everything that had occurred concerning Parāvasu, / the incident arising from drinking liquor which had been told by his friends,

5.196.s:
prāyaścittaṃ tu hāsyena yacca smārtaiḥ prakīrtitam ..
viśvāvasośca saṃkalpaṃ vahnisādhanasaṃbhavam .. 55 ..
5.196.d:
प्रायश्चित्तं तु हास्येन यच्च स्मार्तैः प्रकीर्तितम् ..
विश्वावसोश्च संकल्पं वह्निसाधनसंभवम् .. 55 ..
5.196.m: and the expiation that was declared in jest, and that declared by the Smṛti experts, / and Viśvāvasu's resolution arising from entering fire,

5.196.s:
sapatnīkasya mitrāṇāṃ yacca duḥkhamupasthitam ..
nivedya tattathā procurbhū yo'pivinayānvitam .. 56 ..
5.196.d:
सपत्नीकस्य मित्राणां यच्च दुःखमुपस्थितम् ..
निवेद्य तत्तथा प्रोचुर्भू योऽपिविनयान्वितम् .. 56 ..
5.196.m: and the grief that had befallen his friends together with his wife. / Having reported that as it was, they spoke again with humility:

5.196.s:
atītaṃ vartamānaṃ ca bhaviṣyadvāpi yadbhavet ..
na te'styaviditaṃ kiṃcitsarvaṃ jānīmahe vayam .. 57 ..
5.196.d:
अतीतं वर्तमानं च भविष्यद्वापि यद्भवेत् ..
न तेऽस्त्यविदितं किंचित्सर्वं जानीमहे वयम् .. 57 ..
5.196.m: 'Past, present, or whatever may be future, / nothing is unknown to you; we know all this.

5.196.s:
etacca nagaraṃ sarvaṃ viśvāvasukṛte'dhunā ..
saṃśayaṃ paramaṃ prāptaṃ tena prāptāstavāṃtikam .. 58 ..
5.196.d:
एतच्च नगरं सर्वं विश्वावसुकृतेऽधुना ..
संशयं परमं प्राप्तं तेन प्राप्तास्तवांतिकम् .. 58 ..
5.196.m: And this whole city is now thrown into supreme doubt / on account of Viśvāvasu; therefore we have come into your presence.

5.196.s:
tasmādbrūhi mahābhāga yadyastyaparameva hi ..
prāyaścittaṃ dvijasyāsya madyapānaviśuddhaye .. 59 ..
5.196.d:
तस्माद्ब्रूहि महाभाग यद्यस्त्यपरमेव हि ..
प्रायश्चित्तं द्विजस्यास्य मद्यपानविशुद्धये .. 59 ..
5.196.m: Therefore tell us, O illustrious one, if there is indeed any other / expiation for this twice-born for purification from drinking liquor.

5.196.s:
na te hyaviditaṃ kiṃcittava vedasamudbhavam ..
bhartṛyajño vihasyoccaistato vacanamabravīt .. 6.197.60 ..
5.196.d:
न ते ह्यविदितं किंचित्तव वेदसमुद्भवम् ..
भर्तृयज्ञो विहस्योच्चैस्ततो वचनमब्रवीत् .. 6.197.60 ..
5.196.m: Indeed, nothing arising from the Veda is unknown to you.' / Thereupon Bhartṛyajña laughed out loud and spoke these words:

5.196.s:
brāhmaṇasyāsya śuddhyarthamapyayupāyaḥ sukhāvahaḥ ..
vidyamāno'pi nāstyeva matireṣā sthitā mama .. 61 ..
5.196.d:
ब्राह्मणस्यास्य शुद्ध्यर्थमप्ययुपायः सुखावहः ..
विद्यमानोऽपि नास्त्येव मतिरेषा स्थिता मम .. 61 ..
5.196.m: 'For the purification of this brahmin, an easy means does exist, / yet it does not exist at all; such is my settled opinion.'

5.196.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. .. pūrvāparavirodhe navākyametanmahāmate ..
kathamasti kathaṃ nāsti tasmāttvaṃ vaktumarhasi ..
vismayo'yaṃ mahāñjātaḥ sarveṣāṃ ca dvijanmanām .. 62 ..
5.196.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. .. पूर्वापरविरोधे नवाक्यमेतन्महामते ..
कथमस्ति कथं नास्ति तस्मात्त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि ..
विस्मयोऽयं महाञ्जातः सर्वेषां च द्विजन्मनाम् .. 62 ..
5.196.m: The brahmins said: / 'This statement is contradictory between its former and latter parts, O noble-minded one! / How does it exist, and how does it not exist? Therefore you ought to speak. / A great amazement has arisen among all the twice-born.'

5.196.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
japacchidraṃ tapaśchidraṃ yacchidraṃ yajñakarmaṇi ..
sarvaṃ bhavati niśchidraṃ yasya cecchaṃti brāhmaṇāḥ .. 63 ..
5.196.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
जपच्छिद्रं तपश्छिद्रं यच्छिद्रं यज्ञकर्मणि ..
सर्वं भवति निश्छिद्रं यस्य चेच्छंति ब्राह्मणाः .. 63 ..
5.196.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / 'A flaw in recitation, a flaw in austerity, whatever flaw there is in a sacrificial rite— / all becomes flawless if the brahmins desire it so.

5.196.s:
acchidramiti yadvākyaṃ vadaṃti kṣitidevatāḥ ..
viśeṣānnāgarodbhūtāstattathaiva na cānyathā ..64..
5.196.d:
अच्छिद्रमिति यद्वाक्यं वदंति क्षितिदेवताः ..
विशेषान्नागरोद्भूतास्तत्तथैव न चान्यथा ..64..
5.196.m:
The words that the gods on earth speak, saying, 'It is faultless,'
especially those born among the Nāgaras, are truly so and not otherwise. // 64

5.196.s:
tathā ca brahmaśālāyāṃ saṃsthitairyadudāhṛtam ..
nānyathā tatparijñeyaṃ hāsyenāpi smṛtiṃ vinā .. 65 ..
sa eṣa hāsyabhāvena prokto mitraiḥ parāvasuḥ .. 66 ..
5.196.d:
तथा च ब्रह्मशालायां संस्थितैर्यदुदाहृतम् ..
नान्यथा तत्परिज्ञेयं हास्येनापि स्मृतिं विना .. 65 ..
स एष हास्यभावेन प्रोक्तो मित्रैः परावसुः .. 66 ..
5.196.m:
And likewise, what was uttered by those assembled in the hall of Brahmā
must not be considered otherwise, even if said in jest, without a smṛti text. // 65 //
This same Parāvasu was told in jest by his companions: // 66

5.196.s:
ratnavatyāḥ stanau gṛhya yadyāsvādayate'dharam..
tadbhaviṣyati me śuddhirmadyapāna samudbhavā .. 67 ..
5.196.d:
रत्नवत्याः स्तनौ गृह्य यद्यास्वादयतेऽधरम्..
तद्भविष्यति मे शुद्धिर्मद्यपान समुद्भवा .. 67 ..
5.196.m:
'If, clasping the breasts of Ratnavatī, you taste her lower lip,
then my purification from drinking liquor shall come to pass.' // 67

5.196.s:
tadupāyo mayā prokto viprasyāsya sukhāvahaḥ ..
parāśaramatenaiva karoti yadi śudhyati .. 68 ..
5.196.d:
तदुपायो मया प्रोक्तो विप्रस्यास्य सुखावहः ..
पराशरमतेनैव करोति यदि शुध्यति .. 68 ..
5.196.m:
That remedy has been stated by me, bringing happiness to this vipra;
if he acts according to the view of Parāśara, he will become pure." // 68

5.196.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
yadyetacchuṇute rājā vākyamīrṣyāparāyaṇaḥ ..
tatsarveṣāṃ vadhaṃ kuryādviprāṇāmanyathā bhavet .. 69 ..
5.196.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
यद्येतच्छुणुते राजा वाक्यमीर्ष्यापरायणः ..
तत्सर्वेषां वधं कुर्याद्विप्राणामन्यथा भवेत् .. 69 ..
5.196.m:
The brahmins said:
"If the king, filled with jealousy, hears these words,
then he may kill all the vipras; an untoward outcome would ensue. // 69

5.196.s:
tasmātkarotu cābhīṣṭameṣa vipraḥ parāvasuḥ ..
mātāpitṛsamopeto vayaṃ yāsyāmahe gṛham .. 6.197.70 ..
5.196.d:
तस्मात्करोतु चाभीष्टमेष विप्रः परावसुः ..
मातापितृसमोपेतो वयं यास्यामहे गृहम् .. 6.197.70 ..
5.196.m:
Therefore let this vipra Parāvasu, together with his mother and father,
do what he desires; we shall go home." // 70

5.196.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
sa rājā nītimānvijñaḥ sarvadharmaparāyaṇaḥ ..
bhakto devadvijānāṃ ca sarvaśāstra vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 71 ..
5.196.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
स राजा नीतिमान्विज्ञः सर्वधर्मपरायणः ..
भक्तो देवद्विजानां च सर्वशास्त्र विचक्षणः .. 71 ..
5.196.m:
Bhartṛyajña said:
"That king is prudent, wise, devoted to all duties,
a devotee of the gods and the twice-born, and skilled in all scriptures. // 71

5.196.s: tasmānmayā samaṃ sarve nāgarāyāṃtu tadgrahe .. 72 ..
5.196.d: तस्मान्मया समं सर्वे नागरायांतु तद्ग्रहे .. 72 ..
5.196.m: Therefore let all the Nāgaras go with me to his house. // 72

5.196.s:
madhyagaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā tadvaktreṇa ca tatpuraḥ ..
kathayaṃtu ca vṛttāṃtaṃ madyapāna samudbhavam.. 73 ..
5.196.d:
मध्यगं पुरतः कृत्वा तद्वक्त्रेण च तत्पुरः ..
कथयंतु च वृत्तांतं मद्यपान समुद्भवम्.. 73 ..
5.196.m:
Placing the mediator in front, let them narrate before him through his mouth
the account arising from the drinking of liquor, // 73

5.196.s:
parāvasośca yatproktaṃ vayasyairhāsyamāśritaiḥ ..
parāśarasamutthaṃ ca yadvākyaṃ tatsmṛteḥ param .. 74 ..
5.196.d:
परावसोश्च यत्प्रोक्तं वयस्यैर्हास्यमाश्रितैः ..
पराशरसमुत्थं च यद्वाक्यं तत्स्मृतेः परम् .. 74 ..
5.196.m:
both what was spoken to Parāvasu by his friends resorting to jest,
and the statement derived from Parāśara, which is higher than that smṛti. // 74

5.196.s:
tacchrutvā yadi bhūpāla īrṣyā lobhasamanvitaḥ ..
bhaviṣyati tato'haṃ taṃ dhārayiṣyāmi satpathe .. 75 ..
5.196.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा यदि भूपाल ईर्ष्या लोभसमन्वितः ..
भविष्यति ततोऽहं तं धारयिष्यामि सत्पथे .. 75 ..
5.196.m:
If, upon hearing that, the ruler of the earth becomes possessed of jealousy and greed,
then I shall keep him upon the right path." // 75

5.196.s:
.. sūtauvāca .. ..
tataste nāgarāḥ sarve santoṣaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ ..
sādhuvādaiḥ samabhyarcya bhartṛyajñaṃ pṛthagvidhaiḥ .. 76 ..
5.196.d:
.. सूतौवाच .. ..
ततस्ते नागराः सर्वे सन्तोषं परमं गताः ..
साधुवादैः समभ्यर्च्य भर्तृयज्ञं पृथग्विधैः .. 76 ..

5.196.s:
tenaiva sahitaṃ tūrṇaṃ madhye kṛtvā ca madhyagam ..
garttātīrthasamudbhūtaṃ vedavedāṃgapāragam .. 77 ..
5.196.d:
तेनैव सहितं तूर्णं मध्ये कृत्वा च मध्यगम् ..
गर्त्तातीर्थसमुद्भूतं वेदवेदांगपारगम् .. 77 ..
5.196.m:
and swiftly putting the mediator in their midst together with him—
[the mediator] born at Gartātīrtha, master of the Vedas and the Vedāṅgas, // 77

5.196.s:
smṛtijñaṃ lakṣaṇajñaṃ tamāhitāgniṃ yaśasvinam ..
yaṣṭāraṃ bahuyajñānāṃ bhartṛyajñamate sthitam .. 78 ..
5.196.d:
स्मृतिज्ञं लक्षणज्ञं तमाहिताग्निं यशस्विनम् ..
यष्टारं बहुयज्ञानां भर्तृयज्ञमते स्थितम् .. 78 ..
5.196.m:
knower of the smṛti, knower of signs, a maintainer of the sacred fire, renowned,
a performer of many sacrifices, steadfast in the view of Bhartṛyajña, // 78

5.196.s:
ānartenāpi bhūpena svargabhraṣṭena vai purā ..
karṇotpalājanitreṇa yaśca pūrvaṃ cirantanaḥ .. 79 ..
5.196.d:
आनर्तेनापि भूपेन स्वर्गभ्रष्टेन वै पुरा ..
कर्णोत्पलाजनित्रेण यश्च पूर्वं चिरन्तनः .. 79 ..
5.196.m:
who had formerly been established in this place out of respect for vipras
by King Ānarta, who had fallen from heaven and was the father of Karṇotpalā—an ancient elder— // 79

5.196.s:
camatkārapure nyastaḥ sthāne'sminvipragauravāt ..
yena sidhyaṃti kāryāṇi sarveṣāṃ ca dvijanmanām .. 6.197.80 ..
5.196.d:
चमत्कारपुरे न्यस्तः स्थानेऽस्मिन्विप्रगौरवात् ..
येन सिध्यंति कार्याणि सर्वेषां च द्विजन्मनाम् .. 6.197.80 ..
5.196.m: in Camatkārapura, by whom the purposes of all twice-born men are accomplished, // 80

5.196.s:
tathā caiva tu cānyāni camatkārapurasya ca ..
haribhadrābhidhānaṃ taṃ bhartṛyajñasamanvitam .. 81 ..
5.196.d:
तथा चैव तु चान्यानि चमत्कारपुरस्य च ..
हरिभद्राभिधानं तं भर्तृयज्ञसमन्वितम् .. 81 ..
5.196.m:
as well as other affairs of Camatkārapura—
having taken him, named Haribhadra, together with Bhartṛyajña, // 81

5.196.s:
kṛtvā te nāgarāḥ sarve rājadvāramupāgatāḥ ..
parāvasuṃ samādāya mātāpitṛsamanvitam .. 82 ..
5.196.d:
कृत्वा ते नागराः सर्वे राजद्वारमुपागताः ..
परावसुं समादाय मातापितृसमन्वितम् .. 82 ..
5.196.m:
all those Nāgaras arrived at the royal gate,
taking Parāvasu along with his mother and father. // 82

5.196.s:
atha dvāḥstho drutaṃ gatvā bhūpatestānnyavedayat ..
brāhmaṇānbhartṛyajñena haribhadreṇa saṃyutān .. 83 ..
5.196.d:
अथ द्वाःस्थो द्रुतं गत्वा भूपतेस्तान्न्यवेदयत् ..
ब्राह्मणान्भर्तृयज्ञेन हरिभद्रेण संयुतान् .. 83 ..
5.196.m:
Then the doorkeeper, going quickly, announced to the lord of the earth
the brahmins accompanied by Bhartṛyajña and Haribhadra. // 83

5.196.s:
ānarto'pi ca tāñchrutvā rājadvārasamāgatān ..
purodhasā samāyuktaḥ saṃmukhaṃ prayayau tadā .. 84 ..
5.196.d:
आनर्तोऽपि च ताञ्छ्रुत्वा राजद्वारसमागतान् ..
पुरोधसा समायुक्तः संमुखं प्रययौ तदा .. 84 ..
5.196.m:
Ānarta too, hearing that they had arrived at the palace gate,
accompanied by his family priest, then went out to meet them. // 84

5.196.s:
dattvārghaṃ madhuparkaṃ ca viṣṭaraṃ gāṃ tathā nṛpaḥ ..
prathamaṃ bhartṛyajñāya haribhadrāya vai tataḥ .. 85 ..
5.196.d:
दत्त्वार्घं मधुपर्कं च विष्टरं गां तथा नृपः ..
प्रथमं भर्तृयज्ञाय हरिभद्राय वै ततः .. 85 ..
5.196.m:
Having offered the guest-offering, the madhuparka, a seat, and a cow, the king,
first to Bhartṛyajña and then to Haribhadra, // 85

5.196.s:
caturṇāṃ mudgahastānāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ dvijanmanām ..
ādyaṛgyajuḥsāmnāṃ ca pragṛhyāśīrvacaḥ param .. 86 ..
5.196.d:
चतुर्णां मुद्गहस्तानां तथान्येषां द्विजन्मनाम् ..
आद्यऋग्यजुःसाम्नां च प्रगृह्याशीर्वचः परम् .. 86 ..
5.196.m:
to the four Mudgahastas and likewise to the other twice-born men,
and receiving the supreme blessing of the primary Ṛg-, Yajur-, and Sāma-[vedas], // 86

5.196.s:
sabhāmaṃḍapamāsādya sarvānsamupaveśayat ..
varāsaneṣu haimeṣu yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ .. 97 ..
tathā teṣūpaviṣṭeṣu sarveṣu pṛthivīpatiḥ ..
upaviśya dharāpṛṣṭhe kṛtāṃjalira bhāṣata .. 88 ..
dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi yanme gṛhamupāgataḥ ..
sarvo'yaṃ nāgaro loko bhartṛyajñasamanvitaḥ .. 89 ..
tadādiśatu māṃ loko yatkṛtyaṃ prakaromi vaḥ..
adeyamapi yacchāmi gṛhāyātasya sāṃpratam .. 6.197.90 ..
agamyamapi yāsyāmi kariṣye'kṛtyameva ca ..
tacchrutvā haribhadraḥ sa samutthāya tvarānvitaḥ .. 91 ..
papracchādyāṃstadarthaṃ ca bahvṛcāṃstadanaṃtaram ..
adhvaryūṃścaiva chāṃdogyānanujñātaśca taistadā .. 92 ..
prāṇarudrānvadaṃtvādyā jīvasūktaṃ ca bahvṛcāḥ ..
eṣāṃ caiva pṛthivyādisavanaṃ yatpurā kṛtam .. 93 ..
5.196.d:
सभामंडपमासाद्य सर्वान्समुपवेशयत् ..
वरासनेषु हैमेषु यथावदनुपूर्वशः .. 97 ..
तथा तेषूपविष्टेषु सर्वेषु पृथिवीपतिः ..
उपविश्य धरापृष्ठे कृतांजलिर भाषत .. 88 ..
धन्योऽस्म्यनुगृहीतोऽस्मि यन्मे गृहमुपागतः ..
सर्वोऽयं नागरो लोको भर्तृयज्ञसमन्वितः .. 89 ..
तदादिशतु मां लोको यत्कृत्यं प्रकरोमि वः..
अदेयमपि यच्छामि गृहायातस्य सांप्रतम् .. 6.197.90 ..
अगम्यमपि यास्यामि करिष्येऽकृत्यमेव च ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा हरिभद्रः स समुत्थाय त्वरान्वितः .. 91 ..
पप्रच्छाद्यांस्तदर्थं च बह्वृचांस्तदनंतरम् ..
अध्वर्यूंश्चैव छांदोग्याननुज्ञातश्च तैस्तदा .. 92 ..
प्राणरुद्रान्वदंत्वाद्या जीवसूक्तं च बह्वृचाः ..
एषां चैव पृथिव्यादिसवनं यत्पुरा कृतम् .. 93 ..
5.196.m:
approached the assembly pavilion and seated them all
on excellent golden seats properly in order of precedence. // 87
When all of them were thus seated, the lord of the earth
sat down on the ground and, with joined palms, spoke: // 88
"I am blessed, I am favored, that all these N競争gara people,
accompanied by Bhartṛyajña, have arrived at my home. // 89
Therefore let the people command me as to what duty I may perform for you;
I shall give even what should not be given to one who has now come to my house. // 90
I shall go even where one must not go, and I shall do even what should not be done."
Hearing that, Haribhadra stood up with haste, // 91
inquired of the foremost [scholars] concerning that matter, then of the Ṛgvedins,
the Adhvaryus, and the Chandogas; and authorized by them at that time, [said:] // 92
"Let the foremost [scholars] recite the Prāṇarudras, and the Ṛgvedins the Jīvasūkta;
and the soma pressing beginning with the earth that was performed formerly for them, // 93

5.196.s:
paṭhantvadhvaryavaḥ sarve chāṃdogyāśca pṛthakpṛthak ..
madhucyutena saṃyuktaṃ prapaṭhantu ca siddhaye .. 94 ..
bhartṛyajñamatenaivaṃ tena proktā dvijottamāḥ ..
papracchuścaiva tatsarvaṃ yatproktaṃ tena dhīmatā .. .. 95 ..
tataḥ pāṭhāvasāne tu madhyagaḥ prāha sādaram ..
parāvasusamudbhūtaṃ vṛttāṃtaṃ tasya bhūpateḥ .. 96 ..
yathā tenā''savaḥ pīto yathā mitraiḥ prajalpitam ..
prāyaścittaṃ samādiṣṭaṃ yathā smārtairghṛtodbhavam .. 97 ..
5.196.d:
पठन्त्वध्वर्यवः सर्वे छांदोग्याश्च पृथक्पृथक् ..
मधुच्युतेन संयुक्तं प्रपठन्तु च सिद्धये .. 94 ..
भर्तृयज्ञमतेनैवं तेन प्रोक्ता द्विजोत्तमाः ..
पप्रच्छुश्चैव तत्सर्वं यत्प्रोक्तं तेन धीमता .. .. 95 ..
ततः पाठावसाने तु मध्यगः प्राह सादरम् ..
परावसुसमुद्भूतं वृत्तांतं तस्य भूपतेः .. 96 ..
यथा तेना'ऽसवः पीतो यथा मित्रैः प्रजल्पितम् ..
प्रायश्चित्तं समादिष्टं यथा स्मार्तैर्घृतोद्भवम् .. 97 ..
5.196.m:
let all the Adhvaryus and the Chandogas recite separately;
let them recite along with the Madhucyuta for success." // 94
Instructed thus in accordance with Bhartṛyajña's view, the best of twice-born
recited all that which had been declared by that wise man. // 95
Then, at the end of the recitation, the mediator respectfully told
the king the account concerning Parāvasu: // 96
how liquor was drunk by him, how his companions spoke in jest,
how an expiation involving ghee was enjoined by the smṛti scholars, // 97

5.196.s:
bhartṛyajñena cānītā yathā sarve dvijātayaḥ ..
tacchrutvā pārthivo hṛṣṭaḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭo'bravīt .. 98 ..
5.196.d:
भर्तृयज्ञेन चानीता यथा सर्वे द्विजातयः ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा पार्थिवो हृष्टः कृतांजलिपुटोऽब्रवीत् .. 98 ..
5.196.m:
and how all the twice-born were brought by Bhartṛyajña.
Hearing that, the king, delighted, said with folded hands: // 98

5.196.s:
dhanyohaṃ kṛtapuṇyo'smi yasya me nāgarairdvijaiḥ ..
vipratrayaprarakṣārthaṃ prasādo'yaṃ mahānkṛtaḥ .. 99 ..
5.196.d:
धन्योहं कृतपुण्योऽस्मि यस्य मे नागरैर्द्विजैः ..
विप्रत्रयप्ररक्षार्थं प्रसादोऽयं महान्कृतः .. 99 ..
5.196.m:
"Blessed am I, one of accomplished merit, for whom the N競争gara twice-born
have shown this great grace in order to preserve three vipras. // 99

5.196.s:
dhanyā me kanyakā ceyaṃ rakṣayiṣyati ca svayam ..
brāhmaṇatritayaṃ hyetanmaraṇe kṛtaniścayam .. 6.197.100 ..
5.196.d:
धन्या मे कन्यका चेयं रक्षयिष्यति च स्वयम् ..
ब्राह्मणत्रितयं ह्येतन्मरणे कृतनिश्चयम् .. 6.197.100 ..
5.196.m:
Blessed too is this maiden of mine, who will herself save
this triad of brahmins who are resolved upon death." // 100

5.196.s:
athā'sāvānayāmāsa tāṃ kanyāṃ tatkṣaṇāddvijāḥ ..
upaviṣṭaṃ sabhāmadhye brāhmaṇebhyo nyavedayat .. 101 ..
5.196.d:
अथाऽसावानयामास तां कन्यां तत्क्षणाद्द्विजाः ..
उपविष्टं सभामध्ये ब्राह्मणेभ्यो न्यवेदयत् .. 101 ..
5.196.m:
Then he brought that maiden immediately, O twice-born;
seated in the midst of the assembly, he presented her to the brahmins: // 101

5.196.s:
eṣā kanyā mayānītā yuṣmadvākyāddvijottamāḥ ..
bhartṛyajñena yatproktaṃ tatkarotu ca sa dvijaḥ .. 102 ..
5.196.d:
एषा कन्या मयानीता युष्मद्वाक्याद्द्विजोत्तमाः ..
भर्तृयज्ञेन यत्प्रोक्तं तत्करोतु च स द्विजः .. 102 ..
5.196.m:
"This maiden has been brought by me at your word, O best of twice-born;
let that twice-born do what has been spoken by Bhartṛyajña." // 102

5.196.s:
tatastatra samānīya brāhmaṇa taṃ parāvasum ..
bhartṛyajña idaṃ vākyaṃ kanyāyāḥ purato'bravīt .. 103 ..
5.196.d:
ततस्तत्र समानीय ब्राह्मण तं परावसुम् ..
भर्तृयज्ञ इदं वाक्यं कन्यायाः पुरतोऽब्रवीत् .. 103 ..
5.196.m:
Then, having brought that brahmin Parāvasu there,
Bhartṛyajña spoke these words in front of the maiden: // 103

5.196.s:
imāṃ tvaṃ kanyakāṃ citte jananīṃ yadi manyase ..
adharāsvādanaṃ kurvaṃstataḥ siddhimavāpsyasi .. 104 ..
5.196.d:
इमां त्वं कन्यकां चित्ते जननीं यदि मन्यसे ..
अधरास्वादनं कुर्वंस्ततः सिद्धिमवाप्स्यसि .. 104 ..
5.196.m:
"If in your heart you consider this maiden to be your mother,
then, in tasting her lower lip, you will attain success. // 104

5.196.s:
anurāgaparo bhūtvā yadyāsvādanatatparaḥ ..
bhaviṣyati tato raktaṃ tava vaktre parāvaso .. 105 ..
5.196.d:
अनुरागपरो भूत्वा यद्यास्वादनतत्परः ..
भविष्यति ततो रक्तं तव वक्त्रे परावसो .. 105 ..
5.196.m:
If you engage in the tasting while being overcome with passion,
then blood will appear in your mouth, O Parāvasu. // 105

5.196.s: śuddhasya tvatha dugdhaṃ ca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ .. 106 ..
5.196.d: शुद्धस्य त्वथ दुग्धं च भविष्यति न संशयः .. 106 ..
5.196.m: If you are pure, however, there will be milk; there is no doubt. // 106

5.196.s:
stanābhyāṃ tava hastābhyāṃ sparśātkṣīraṃ bhavedyadi ..
tatte śuddhiḥ parijñeyā raktaṃ vā na bhaviṣyati .. 107 ..
5.196.d:
स्तनाभ्यां तव हस्ताभ्यां स्पर्शात्क्षीरं भवेद्यदि ..
तत्ते शुद्धिः परिज्ञेया रक्तं वा न भविष्यति .. 107 ..
5.196.m:
If, by the touch of your hands, milk comes from her breasts,
then your purification should be understood, or there will be no blood." // 107

5.196.s:
evamuktvātha taṃ kanyāṃ tataḥ provāca sa dvijaḥ ..
enaṃ tvaṃ putravatpaśya putri brāhmaṇasattamam .. 108 ..
5.196.d:
एवमुक्त्वाथ तं कन्यां ततः प्रोवाच स द्विजः ..
एनं त्वं पुत्रवत्पश्य पुत्रि ब्राह्मणसत्तमम् .. 108 ..
5.196.m: Having spoken thus to him, that brahmin then said to the maiden: / "Daughter, look upon this best of brahmins as a son, 108

5.196.s:
yena śuddhimavāpnoti tvadoṣṭhāsvādane kṛte ..
sparśitābhyāṃ stanābhyāṃ ca prāyaścittaṃ yataḥ smṛtam .. 109 ..
5.196.d:
येन शुद्धिमवाप्नोति त्वदोष्ठास्वादने कृते ..
स्पर्शिताभ्यां स्तनाभ्यां च प्रायश्चित्तं यतः स्मृतम् .. 109 ..
5.196.m: so that he may attain purification when your lower lip has been tasted / and your two breasts touched; for that has been declared as his expiation 109

5.196.s:
etadasya dvijeṃdrasya vayasyairhāsyasaṃyutaiḥ ..
yena śuddhimavāpnoti no cenmṛtyumavāpsyati .. 6.197.110 ..
5.196.d:
एतदस्य द्विजेंद्रस्य वयस्यैर्हास्यसंयुतैः ..
येन शुद्धिमवाप्नोति नो चेन्मृत्युमवाप्स्यति .. 6.197.110 ..
5.196.m: for this best of brahmins by his companions with laughter, / by which he will obtain purification; otherwise, he will meet with death." 110

5.196.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
sā tatheti pratijñāya savrīḍaṃ tamuvāca ha ..
ehi vatsa kuruṣva tvaṃ prāyaścittaṃ viśuddhaye .. 111 ..
5.196.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
सा तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय सव्रीडं तमुवाच ह ..
एहि वत्स कुरुष्व त्वं प्रायश्चित्तं विशुद्धये .. 111 ..
5.196.m: Sūta said: / Assenting to that, saying "So be it," she said to him with bashfulness: / "Come, my child, perform the expiation for purification! 111

5.196.s:
mātṛbhāvaṃ samādhāya mayā tvaṃ kalpitaḥ sutaḥ ..
so'pi tāṃ mātṛvanmatvā tasyāḥ sāṃnidhyamāgataḥ .. 112 ..
5.196.d:
मातृभावं समाधाय मया त्वं कल्पितः सुतः ..
सोऽपि तां मातृवन्मत्वा तस्याः सांनिध्यमागतः .. 112 ..
5.196.m: Adopting the feeling of a mother, I have conceived of you as a son." / He too, regarding her as a mother, came into her presence, 112

5.196.s:
spṛṣṭavāṃśca stanau tasyāḥ sarvalokasya paśyataḥ ..
spṛṣṭābhyāṃ ca stanābhyāṃ ca tatkṣaṇāddvijasattamāḥ .. 113 ..
5.196.d:
स्पृष्टवांश्च स्तनौ तस्याः सर्वलोकस्य पश्यतः ..
स्पृष्टाभ्यां च स्तनाभ्यां च तत्क्षणाद्द्विजसत्तमाः .. 113 ..
5.196.m: and touched her two breasts while all the people were watching. / And from the two breasts that were touched, O best of brahmins, at that very instant 113

5.196.s: kṣīradhāre viniṣkrāṃte kundeṃduhimasaṃnibhe .. [. 114 ..
5.196.d: क्षीरधारे विनिष्क्रांते कुन्देंदुहिमसंनिभे .. [. 114 ..
5.196.m: two streams of milk issued forth, resembling jasmine, the moon, and snow. 114

5.196.s:
athauṣṭhāsvādanaṃ yāvattasyāḥ sa kurute dvijaḥ ..
tāvatkṣīraṃ viniṣkrāṃtaṃ tādṛgrūpaṃ tadānanāt .. 115 ..
5.196.d:
अथौष्ठास्वादनं यावत्तस्याः स कुरुते द्विजः ..
तावत्क्षीरं विनिष्क्रांतं तादृग्रूपं तदाननात् .. 115 ..
5.196.m: Then, as soon as that brahmin tasted her lip, / even so milk of like appearance flowed forth from her mouth. 115

5.196.s:
etasminnaṃtare sarvaistālā dattā dvijātibhiḥ ..
rājñā'yaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ śuddho vadamānairmuhurmuhuḥ .. 116 ..
5.196.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे सर्वैस्ताला दत्ता द्विजातिभिः ..
राज्ञाऽयं ब्राह्मणः शुद्धो वदमानैर्मुहुर्मुहुः .. 116 ..
5.196.m: Meanwhile, claps were given by all the twice-born, / who repeatedly said: "O King, this brahmin is pure!" 116

5.196.s:
so'pi pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tāṃ ca kanyāṃ muhurmuhuḥ [.
namaskṛtya kṣamasveti tvaṃ mātaḥ putravatsale .. 117 ..
5.196.d:
सोऽपि प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य तां च कन्यां मुहुर्मुहुः [.
नमस्कृत्य क्षमस्वेति त्वं मातः पुत्रवत्सले .. 117 ..
5.196.m: He too, having circumambulated that maiden again and again, / bowed down and said: "Forgive me, O mother fond of your son!" 117

5.196.s:
taddṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryamānarto vismayānvitaḥ ..
śaśaṃsa bhatṛyajñaṃ taṃ prāyaścittapradāyakam .. 118 ..
5.196.d:
तद्दृष्ट्वा महदाश्चर्यमानर्तो विस्मयान्वितः ..
शशंस भतृयज्ञं तं प्रायश्चित्तप्रदायकम् .. 118 ..
5.196.m: Seeing that great wonder, Ānarta, filled with astonishment, / praised that Bhartṛyajña who had prescribed the expiation: 118

5.196.s:
aho'tīva subhā gyo'haṃ yasya me gṛhamāgatāḥ ..
īdṛśā brāhmaṇāḥ sarve camatkārapurodbhavāḥ .. 119 ..
5.196.d:
अहोऽतीव सुभा ग्योऽहं यस्य मे गृहमागताः ..
ईदृशा ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे चमत्कारपुरोद्भवाः .. 119 ..
5.196.m: "Ah, I am exceedingly fortunate, since to my house have come / such brahmins, all sprung from Camatkārapura! 119

5.196.s:
tathā caitādṛśī kanyā hyasāmānyapravartinī ..
ratnāvatī mahābhāgā satyaśaucasamanvitā .. 6.197.120 ..
5.196.d:
तथा चैतादृशी कन्या ह्यसामान्यप्रवर्तिनी ..
रत्नावती महाभागा सत्यशौचसमन्विता .. 6.197.120 ..
5.196.m: And likewise such a maiden, behaving in an extraordinary manner, / the highly fortunate Ratnāvatī, endowed with truth and purity! 120

5.196.s:
tathā'yaṃ naiva sāmānyo brāhmaṇaśca parāvasuḥ ..
yaścedṛśīṃ samāsādya kanyāṃ no vikṛtaḥ sthitaḥ .. .. 121 ..
5.196.d:
तथाऽयं नैव सामान्यो ब्राह्मणश्च परावसुः ..
यश्चेदृशीं समासाद्य कन्यां नो विकृतः स्थितः .. .. 121 ..
5.196.m: And likewise this brahmin Parāvasu is by no means ordinary, / who, having approached such a maiden, remained without perturbation!" 121

5.196.s:
evamuktvā visṛjyātha tānviprānpārthivottamāḥ ..
tāṃ ca kanyāṃ samādāya tataścāṃtaḥpuraṃ yayau .. 122 ..
5.196.d:
एवमुक्त्वा विसृज्याथ तान्विप्रान्पार्थिवोत्तमाः ..
तां च कन्यां समादाय ततश्चांतःपुरं ययौ .. 122 ..
5.196.m: Having spoken thus and dismissed those brahmins, O best of kings, / he took that maiden and then went to the inner apartments. 122

5.196.s:
atha te nāgarāḥ sarve maryādāṃ cakrire tataḥ ..
adyaprabhṛti yā veśyā sthāne'sminvāsameṣyati .. 123 ..
5.196.d:
अथ ते नागराः सर्वे मर्यादां चक्रिरे ततः ..
अद्यप्रभृति या वेश्या स्थानेऽस्मिन्वासमेष्यति .. 123 ..
5.196.m: Then all those citizens (Nāgaras) made a regulation: / "From this day forward, whatever courtesan shall dwell in this place, 123

5.196.s:
tayā naiva gṛhe dhāryaṃ surāmāṃsaṃ kathaṃcana ..
dūṣayaṃti sadā duṣṭā nāgarāṇāṃ sutāniha .. 124 ..
5.196.d:
तया नैव गृहे धार्यं सुरामांसं कथंचन ..
दूषयंति सदा दुष्टा नागराणां सुतानिह .. 124 ..
5.196.m: she must never keep liquor or meat in her house. / The wicked ones always corrupt the sons of the Nāgaras here. 124

5.196.s:
atha vyavasthāmutkramya yā hi taddhārayiṣyati ..
sā daṇḍyāsmācca nirvāsyā pretya syātpāpabhāginī .. 125 ..
5.196.d:
अथ व्यवस्थामुत्क्रम्य या हि तद्धारयिष्यति ..
सा दण्ड्यास्माच्च निर्वास्या प्रेत्य स्यात्पापभागिनी .. 125 ..
5.196.m: Now, whoever transgresses this rule and keeps it, / she shall be punished, banished from here, and share in sin in the hereafter." 125

5.196.s: audumbaryā madhyagena dattaṃ tālatrayaṃ tadā .. 126 ..
5.196.d: औदुम्बर्या मध्यगेन दत्तं तालत्रयं तदा .. 126 ..
5.196.m: Then three claps were given by the one standing in the center of the Audumbarī. 126

5.196.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye parāvasuprāyaścittavidhānavṛttāṃtavarṇanaṃnāma saptanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 197 ..
5.196.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये परावसुप्रायश्चित्तविधानवृत्तांतवर्णनंनाम सप्तनवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 197 ..
5.196.m: Thus ends the one hundred ninety-seventh chapter, entitled "Description of the Account of Parāvasu's Expiation Procedure" in the māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvarakṣetra, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the glorious Skandapurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. 197
